words.en: An intermediary is a person who acts as a link between people or groups in order to try to bring about an agreement or reconciliation.

words.tr: adj. 人与人之间的；人际关系的；
words.ex: Good interpersonal skills help people work together.
words.ex_cn: 良好的人际交往能力有助于人们合作。
words.en: relating to relationships or communication between people

words.ex: She invited all her kin to the family reunion.
words.ex_cn: 她邀请了所有亲属参加家庭聚会。
words.en: Your kin are your relatives.

words.tr:
n. 亲属；血缘关系
adj. 同源的；类似的
words.ex: He visited his kindred during the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 他在假期里探望了他的亲属。
words.en: If two people or things are kindred, they are similar in some way, often because they are related.

words.ex: He traced his lineage back to ancient kings.
words.ex_cn: 他追溯了自己的家系到古代的国王。
words.en: Your lineage is the series of families from which you are directly descended.

words.ex: I received a notification on my phone.
words.ex_cn: 我收到了手机上的一条通知。
words.en: A notification is a message, sound, or symbol that tells you that something has happened or that you need to do something.

words.tr: n. 演说者；演讲者；雄辩家；
words.ex: He is a famous orator who speaks at large events.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位在大型活动中演讲的著名演说者。
words.en: An orator is a person who delivers speeches or lectures, especially one who is skilled at doing so.

words.tr:
n. 朋友；伙伴
v. 结为伙伴
words.ex: He is my best pal.
words.ex_cn: 他是我最好的朋友。
words.en: A pal is a friend or companion.

words.ex: The patriarch leads his large family with wisdom.
words.ex_cn: 这位族长以智慧领导他的大家庭。
words.en: A patriarch is a man who is the head of a family or tribe, or a highly respected man in a particular field.

words.tr: adj. （男性）家长制的；族长制的；父权制的
words.ex: He lives in a patriarchal family where the father makes all the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他生活在一个父亲做所有决定的父权家庭中。
words.en: Relating to, characteristic of, or denoting a system of society or government controlled by men.

words.ex: The dog has a long pedigree from champion lines.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗有着来自冠军血统的悠久血统。
words.en: A pedigree is the recorded ancestry or lineage of a person or animal, often used to indicate purity of breed or high social status.

words.ex: He used a pretext to leave the meeting early.
words.ex_cn: 他找了个借口提前离开了会议。
words.en: A pretext is a false reason that you give for doing something, usually something bad, in order to hide the real reason.

words.tr: interj. （无线电通信中）收到，明白（用于确认收到信息）；
words.ex: Roger, we will land in five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 收到，我们五分钟内降落。
words.en: used in radio communications to indicate that a message has been received and understood

words.ex: My sibling plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的兄弟/姐妹每个周末都踢足球。
words.en: A sibling is a brother or sister.

words.ex: He showed snobbery when he laughed at her old shoes.
words.ex_cn: 当他嘲笑她的旧鞋子时，表现出了势利。
words.en: Snobbery is the attitude or behavior of someone who thinks they are better than other people because they are more intelligent, more cultured, or of a higher social class than others.

words.ex: He is a sociable man who likes to talk with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢和朋友聊天的外向的人。
words.en: A sociable person is friendly and enjoys being with other people.

words.ex: Social problems affect many families.
words.ex_cn: 社会问题影响许多家庭。
words.en: Social means relating to society or to the way society is organized.

words.ex: The bright light was a stimulus for the baby to open his eyes.
words.ex_cn: 明亮的光线是让婴儿睁开眼睛的刺激物。
words.en: Something that causes growth or activity.

words.tr: adj. 无意识的；无知觉的；
words.ex: He was unconscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他失去了意识。
words.en: If someone is unconscious, they are not awake, usually because they have had a severe injury or illness.

words.ex: There are untold stories behind this war.
words.ex_cn: 这场战争背后有着数不清的故事。
words.en: If you refer to an amount as untold, you are emphasizing that it is very large, usually so large that it cannot be measured or counted.

words.tr: n. 发声；嗓音；说出的话
words.ex: The baby's vocalization made her mother smile.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿的发声让她的妈妈笑了。
words.en: The act or process of producing sounds with the voice, especially in speech or song.

words.tr: adj. 健谈的；滔滔不绝的
words.ex: He is a voluble speaker who talks all day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个健谈的人，整天说个不停。
words.en: If you describe someone as voluble, you mean that they talk a lot with great energy and enthusiasm.

chapters.name: 多彩生活 居家度日 重点词

words.tr: v. 容纳；适应；为...提供住宿；
words.ex: The hotel can accommodate 200 guests.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店能容纳200位客人。
words.en: If a building or space can accommodate someone or something, it has enough room for them.

words.ex: He uses soap to cleanse his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥皂洗手。
words.en: To cleanse something means to make it extremely clean, especially by using a special substance or process.

words.tr:
n. 杂乱；混乱
v. 弄乱
words.ex: The table is full of clutter.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上堆满了杂物。
words.en: If things or people clutter a place, they fill it in an untidy way.

words.tr:
v. 发劈啪声；发尖而轻的爆裂声
n. 劈啪响；裂纹
words.ex: The fire crackles in the hearth.
words.ex_cn: 壁炉里的火噼啪作响。
words.en: If something crackles, it makes a rapid series of short, sharp noises.

words.ex: The rain dampened the sound of the drums.
words.ex_cn: 雨减弱了鼓声。
words.en: To dampen something means to make it slightly wet, or to make it less strong or intense.

words.ex: The basement was dank and cold.
words.ex_cn: 地下室又潮又冷。
words.en: Unpleasantly damp and cold.

words.ex: We decorate the room for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们为派对装饰房间。
words.en: To make something look more attractive by putting things on it or around it.

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.ex: Humans domesticated dogs thousands of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 人类几千年前就驯养了狗。
words.en: To domesticate an animal or plant means to bring it under human control in order to provide food, power, or company.

words.ex: He wrote a draft of the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送之前写了这封信的草稿。
words.en: A draft is a preliminary version of a piece of writing, or a current of air in a room or other confined space. It can also refer to the act of selecting someone for a particular purpose or task, especially in sports or the military.

words.ex: This bag is durable and lasts for years.
words.ex_cn: 这个包很耐用，可以用很多年。
words.en: Something that is durable is strong and lasts a long time without breaking or becoming weaker.

words.ex: He dwells in a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一所小房子里。
words.en: If you dwell on something, especially something unpleasant, you think, speak, or write about it a lot or for quite a long time.

words.ex: The old estate has large gardens and a beautiful mansion.
words.ex_cn: 这个古老的庄园有大片花园和一座美丽的豪宅。
words.en: An estate is all the money and property that someone owns, especially everything that is left when they die.

words.ex: He is facing a difficult decision.
words.ex_cn: 他正面对一个艰难的决定。
words.en: Facing can refer to the material that covers the outside of a building or structure, or it can mean to confront or deal with a problem or situation.

words.tr: v. 布置家具；配备；供给；提供
words.ex: He will furnish the apartment with new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 他将为公寓配备新家具。
words.en: To furnish a place means to put furniture and other things into it.

words.tr:
n. 家庭；
adj. 家庭的；
words.ex: This household has three children.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭有三个孩子。
words.en: A household is all the people in a family or group who live together in a house.

words.ex: The lamp illuminate the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: To illuminate something means to shine light on it and to make it brighter and more visible.

words.ex: The inhabitant lives in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 这位居民住在一所小房子里。
words.en: An inhabitant of a place is one of the people who live there.

words.ex: She intersperses flowers in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里分散地种着花。
words.en: To place something at intervals among other things.

words.tr:
n. 脏乱；杂乱；
v. 弄糟；
words.ex: The room was a mess after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对后房间一片狼藉。
words.en: A mess is a situation that is confused and full of problems, or something that is dirty or untidy.

words.tr: n. 臼；研钵；灰浆；迫击炮
words.ex: The chef used a mortar to grind the spices.
words.ex_cn: 厨师用臼来研磨香料。
words.en: Mortar is a mixture of sand, water, and cement or lime that is used to hold bricks or stones together. It is also a type of gun that fires explosive shells at a high angle.

words.tr: v. 安顿；安居；安卧；坐落于
words.ex: The baby nestles close to her mother.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿依偎在妈妈身边。
words.en: To settle or lie comfortably within or against something.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.tr: v. 重新刷新；翻新；整修
words.ex: They will refurbish the old house next month.
words.ex_cn: 他们下个月将翻新这栋老房子。
words.en: To refurbish something means to clean it, decorate it, and provide it with new equipment or facilities, especially so that it is more attractive or more useful.

words.ex: The removal of the old tree made the yard bigger.
words.ex_cn: 移除那棵老树让院子变大了。
words.en: The act of removing something or someone from a place or position.

words.ex: They will renovate the old house next month.
words.ex_cn: 他们下个月将翻新那栋老房子。
words.en: To renovate means to restore something to a good state of repair or to make it as good as new.

words.ex: They reside in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一所小房子里。
words.en: If someone resides somewhere, they live there or are staying there.

words.tr:
adj. 居住的；常驻的；
n. 常住居民；
words.ex: The resident population grew last year.
words.ex_cn: 居住人口去年增加了。
words.en: A resident is someone who lives in a particular place or a person who has their home in a place.

words.ex: The magic show riveted the children's attention.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演吸引了孩子们的注意力。
words.en: A rivet is a short metal pin or bolt for holding together two plates of metal, its headless end being beaten out or pressed down when in place. As a verb, to rivet means to attract and hold the attention of someone completely.

words.tr:
n. 褶边；褶饰
v. 弄皱；弄乱；扰乱
words.ex: The dress has a pink ruffle at the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子的底部有一条粉色的褶边。
words.en: To ruffle something means to disturb its smoothness or neatness, making it uneven or messy.

words.tr:
v. 刮；擦；刮出刺耳声；勉强通过
n. 刮；擦；擦痕；刮擦声
words.ex: He scraped his knee on the rough ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在粗糙的地面上擦伤了膝盖。
words.en: To remove something from a surface using a sharp or rough edge, or to injure a part of the body by rubbing it against a rough surface.

words.tr: n. 自卫；自保；自我保护
words.ex: The animal acted out of self-preservation when it ran away from the predator.
words.ex_cn: 当动物从捕食者身边逃跑时，它是出于自卫。
words.en: Self-preservation is the instinctive behavior that protects an organism from harm or death.

words.ex: He showed self-restraint when he did not shout at the driver.
words.ex_cn: 当他没有对司机大喊时，他表现出了自制力。
words.en: Self-restraint is the ability to control your emotions and desires, especially in difficult situations.

words.tr:
n. 长条；条状；
v. 剥去；剥夺；
words.ex: He cut a strip of paper to wrap the gift.
words.ex_cn: 他剪了一条纸来包装礼物。
words.en: To remove a layer from something, or to take off your clothes.

words.ex: The room was stuffy and hard to breathe in.
words.ex_cn: 房间闷热得让人难以呼吸。
words.en: If you describe a place as stuffy, you mean that it is unpleasantly warm and has no fresh air.

words.tr: v. 捐赠；订阅；订购；签署；认购（股份）
words.ex: He decided to subscribe $50 to the charity each month.
words.ex_cn: 他决定每月向慈善机构捐赠50美元。
words.en: If you subscribe to a magazine or a service, you pay to receive it regularly.

words.ex: The ground began to subside after the heavy rain.
words.ex_cn: 大雨之后，地面开始下陷。
words.en: If a feeling or noise subsides, it becomes less strong or loud.

words.tr:
v. 转换；
n. 开关；
words.ex: He switched off the light before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前把灯关掉了。
words.en: A switch is a small control for an electrical device which you use to turn the device on or off.

words.tr:
v. （使）纠缠；使陷入；使混乱
n. 纠缠；混乱；纠纷
words.ex: The cat got into a tangle with the yarn.
words.ex_cn: 猫和毛线缠在一起了。
words.en: If something is tangled or tangles, it becomes twisted together in an untidy way.

words.ex: The bank keeps money in a vault.
words.ex_cn: 银行把钱存放在金库里。
words.en: A vault is an arched structure that forms a ceiling or roof, or a room, especially in a church, that has an arched ceiling or roof. It can also refer to a jump over something using your hands or a pole to push yourself off the ground.

words.tr:
v. 拂；掸；搅拌；急速地移动
n. 搅拌器；打蛋器
words.ex: She whisked the dust off the table.
words.ex_cn: 她拂去了桌子上的灰尘。
words.en: To move something or someone quickly and suddenly; to mix ingredients using a whisk.

words.tr:
n. 石灰水；白涂料；粉饰
v. 用石灰水粉刷；掩盖；粉饰
words.ex: They used whitewash to paint the fence white.
words.ex_cn: 他们用石灰水把篱笆刷成白色。
words.en: To whitewash something means to cover it with white paint or a similar substance. It can also mean to try to make something bad seem good by hiding the truth about it. In sports, to whitewash an opponent means to defeat them completely without allowing them to score.

chapters.name: 多彩生活 居家度日 认知词

words.tr:
n. 住所；居住处
v. 逗留；“abide”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: His abode is a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他的住所是一栋靠近湖边的小房子。
words.en: A place of residence; a home.

words.ex: The jar is airtight, so the food stays fresh.
words.ex_cn: 这个罐子是密封的，所以食物能保持新鲜。
words.en: If something is airtight, it is completely sealed so that no air can get in or out.

words.ex: The room is airy with windows on all sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间四面都有窗户，通风很好。
words.en: If a place or room is airy, it has a lot of fresh air because it is large or has a lot of windows.

words.tr:
adj. 半开的；微启的
adv. 微开地；半开地
words.ex: The door was ajar so I pushed it open.
words.ex_cn: 门半开着，所以我推开了它。
words.en: If a door is ajar, it is slightly open.

words.tr: n. 便利设施；舒适条件；公共设施；
words.ex: The apartment has good amenities like a gym and a swimming pool.
words.ex_cn: 这套公寓有健身房和游泳池等便利设施。
words.en: An amenity is something that makes a place more pleasant or comfortable to live in.

words.ex: She will beautify her garden with flowers.
words.ex_cn: 她将用花朵美化她的花园。
words.en: To make something more attractive or beautiful.

words.tr: n. 床上用品；寝具； v. “bed”的现在分词；
words.ex: She bought new bedding for her bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 她为卧室买了新的床上用品。
words.en: Bedding refers to the materials that are used on a bed for sleeping on, such as sheets and blankets.

words.tr:
n. 铺位；卧铺
v. 提供铺位；睡在铺上
words.ex: He slept in a bunk last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚睡在上铺。
words.en: A bunk is a narrow bed that is fixed to a wall, especially in a ship or caravan.

words.tr:
n. 煤仓；沙坑；掩体；地堡
v. 把球击入沙坑
words.ex: The ship has a large bunker to store coal.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船有一个大的煤仓来储存煤炭。
words.en: A bunker is a place, usually underground, that has been built with strong walls to protect it against heavy gunfire and bombing.

words.tr:
n. 藏物处；隐藏物；
v. 匿藏；
words.ex: The hunters found a cache of food under the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 猎人们在石头下发现了一个食物藏匿处。
words.en: A cache is a hidden store of things such as weapons or a supply of food.

words.ex: They used cement to build the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他们用水泥建造了这堵墙。
words.en: Cement is a powdery substance which is mixed with water and used for sticking things together or for making very hard surfaces.

words.ex: The old house had a dirty cesspit behind the garden.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子的花园后面有一个脏乱的化粪池。
words.en: A cesspit is a covered underground tank or a deep hole in the ground where sewage is collected and stored until it is removed.

words.tr: n. 小木屋；农舍式小屋；
words.ex: We stayed in a cozy chalet near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在山边一座温馨的小木屋里。
words.en: A chalet is a wooden house or cottage with a sloping roof, widely used in the mountains of Switzerland and other Alpine regions.

words.tr: n. 令人讨厌的或繁重的工作；
words.ex: Washing dishes is a boring chore.
words.ex_cn: 洗碗是一件烦人的琐事。
words.en: A chore is a task or piece of work that is often boring or unpleasant but needs to be done regularly.

words.tr:
n. 衣柜；壁橱；贮藏室
adj. 隐藏的
words.ex: He keeps his shirts in the closet.
words.ex_cn: 他把衬衫放在壁橱里。
words.en: A closet is a small room or space in a house or apartment where clothes, shoes, and other items are stored.

words.ex: She coddles her little brother too much.
words.ex_cn: 她太宠着她的弟弟了。
words.en: To treat someone in an indulgent or overprotective way.

words.tr: n. 大都市圈；集合城市
words.ex: The conurbation includes many nearby cities.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市群包括许多附近的城市。
words.en: A conurbation is a region comprising a number of cities, large towns, and other urban areas that, through population growth and physical expansion, have merged to form one continuous urban or industrially developed area.

words.ex: The birds perform a dance during courtship.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在求偶时会跳舞。
words.en: The period during which a couple develop a romantic relationship, especially with a view to marriage.

words.ex: She washed the crockery after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她晚饭后洗了餐具。
words.en: Crockery refers to plates, dishes, cups, and other similar items, especially ones made of earthenware or china.

words.tr: n. 土窖；地穴；教堂地下室
words.ex: He found a crypt under the old church.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧教堂下面发现了一个地窖。
words.en: A crypt is a room or chamber beneath a church, used as a burial place.

words.tr:
n. 短棒；短棍
v. 用棍棒打
words.ex: He picked up a cudgel to defend himself.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一根棍棒来自卫。
words.en: A short, thick stick used as a weapon; to beat with or as if with a cudgel.

words.ex: She put a cushion on the chair to make it comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个靠垫，让它更舒服。
words.en: A cushion is a soft bag of some ornamental material, stuffed with wool, hair, feathers, polyester staple fiber, non-woven material, or even paper torn into fragments. It may be used for sitting or kneeling upon, or to soften the hardness or angularity of a chair or couch.

words.ex: She placed the cutlery neatly on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她把餐具整齐地放在桌子上。
words.en: Cutlery refers to the tools used for eating or serving food, such as knives, forks, and spoons.

words.ex: He will defrost the chicken before cooking.
words.ex_cn: 他在烹饪前会解冻鸡肉。
words.en: To defrost something means to cause it to become unfrozen, especially food, by warming it.

words.ex: The denizen of the forest knows all the paths.
words.ex_cn: 森林的居民知道所有的路。
words.en: A denizen of a particular place is someone who lives there or is often there.

words.ex: He uses deodorant every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都用除臭剂。
words.en: A deodorant is a substance that you can use on your body to prevent or mask the smell of sweat.

words.ex: The bank is a depository for gold.
words.ex_cn: 这家银行是黄金的贮藏所。
words.en: A place where something is deposited for safekeeping.

words.tr: adj. 分离的； v. 脱离；拆卸；分离；“detach”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The house is detached from the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子与邻居的房子是分开的。
words.en: If someone is detached, they do not have any emotional interest in a situation and therefore can make fair decisions.

words.tr: n. 洗涤剂；洗衣粉；去垢剂；
words.ex: She uses detergent to wash the clothes.
words.ex_cn: 她用洗涤剂洗衣服。
words.en: A detergent is a substance that is used for cleaning things, especially clothes and dishes.

words.ex: She missed the quiet domesticity of her childhood home.
words.ex_cn: 她怀念童年家园的宁静家庭生活。
words.en: Domesticity refers to home or family life, especially the activities and duties involved in running a household.

words.ex: His domicile is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他的住所位于纽约。
words.en: A domicile is the place where a person lives or has their home.

words.tr:
adj. 溺爱的；宠爱的
v. 溺爱；宠爱；过分喜爱；“dote”的现在分词
words.ex: Her doting parents always buy her toys.
words.ex_cn: 她溺爱的父母总是给她买玩具。
words.en: If you say that someone is, for example, a doting mother, husband, or friend, you mean that they show a lot of love for someone.

words.tr:
n. 布帘；垂下的褶皱状
v. 盖上褶缀的布；将（织物）悬挂；懒散地垂着
words.ex: The blue drape covered the window completely.
words.ex_cn: 蓝色的布帘完全遮住了窗户。
words.en: To drape something means to arrange it in a loose, flowing way, especially fabric or clothing.

words.tr: n. 垂褶布（或织物）；布料
words.ex: The curtains are beautiful drapery in the living room.
words.ex_cn: 这些窗帘是客厅里漂亮的窗帘布。
words.en: Drapery refers to cloth or fabric that is hung or arranged in loose folds, often used for decoration or to create a particular effect in a room.

words.tr: adj. 通风的；有过堂风的；有冷风吹过的
words.ex: The room is drafty because the window is open.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间很通风，因为窗户开着。
words.en: If a place is drafty, it has currents of cold air blowing through it, usually because there are gaps in the structure that allow air to enter and exit freely.

words.tr:
n. 住宅；住所
v. 居住；栖身；沉湎于；“dwell”的现在分词
words.ex: He lives in a small dwelling near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一个小住所里。
words.en: A dwelling is a place where someone lives, such as a house or apartment.

words.ex: The children sat on the eaves to watch the rain.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐在屋檐下看雨。
words.en: The part of a roof that meets or overhangs the walls of a building.

words.ex: She embellished the dress with flowers.
words.ex_cn: 她用花朵装饰了这条裙子。
words.en: To embellish something means to make it more attractive by adding decorative details or features.

words.ex: He ensconced himself in the armchair with a book.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己安顿在扶手椅里看书。
words.en: If you ensconce yourself somewhere, you settle yourself there in a safe, comfortable, or secret place.

words.ex: The landlord will evict the tenant for not paying rent.
words.ex_cn: 房东会因为租客不付房租而将他驱逐。
words.en: To evict someone means to force them to leave a house or piece of land, usually because they have not paid the rent or have broken the law.

words.tr: n. 提取器；排气扇；抽油烟机；抽出器
words.ex: The extractor removes oil from the machine.
words.ex_cn: extractor 从机器中去除油。
words.en: An extractor is a device or machine that is used to remove something from something else, especially by using force or suction.

words.ex: The faucet is dripping.
words.ex_cn: 水龙头在滴水。
words.en: A faucet is a device that controls the flow of a liquid or gas from a pipe or container, especially one that you turn to start or stop the flow of water.

words.tr: n. 壁炉的栅栏；护舷；挡泥板；防卫物
words.ex: The ashes fell behind the fender.
words.ex_cn: 灰烬落在了壁炉的栅栏后面。
words.en: A fender is a barrier or cushion between a vehicle and the outside world, designed to absorb the shock of collision or to protect the vehicle's body from damage.

words.ex: The fireplace is lined with firebrick.
words.ex_cn: 壁炉内衬是耐火砖。
words.en: A firebrick is a brick made of fire clay, used for lining furnaces, fireplaces, and chimneys, capable of withstanding high temperatures.

words.tr:
n. 泛光灯；强光灯
v. 用泛光灯照亮
words.ex: The floodlight shines on the soccer field at night.
words.ex_cn: 探照灯在夜晚照耀着足球场。
words.en: A floodlight is a large, powerful light that is used to illuminate a wide area, especially outdoors.

words.tr:
n. 折痕；褶；
v. 折叠；
words.ex: The paper has a deep fold in the middle.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸中间有一道深深的折痕。
words.en: To bend something, especially paper or cloth, so that one part of it lies flat on top of another part; to be able to be bent in this way.

words.ex: He fondled the old photo gently.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻抚摸着那张旧照片。
words.en: To handle or touch (someone or something) in a tender and loving way.

words.ex: The car was parked in the forecourt.
words.ex_cn: 汽车停在前院。
words.en: A forecourt is an open area in front of a large building or petrol station.

words.tr: n. 衣饰上的绉边；褶皱
words.ex: The dress has a white frill at the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子的底部有一圈白色花边。
words.en: A frill is a strip of cloth with many folds in it, which is attached to something as a decoration.

words.ex: The house has a long frontage on the street.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子临街有一段很长的正面。
words.en: The frontage of a building is the part that faces towards a road or open space.

words.tr: n. 家具陈设；室内陈设品；
words.ex: The room has simple furnishings.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有简单的家具陈设。
words.en: The articles of furniture and other items that are used to make a room or building suitable for living or working in.

words.ex: The house has a red gable.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个红色的山墙。
words.en: The triangular upper part of a wall at the end of a ridged roof.

words.ex: He bought a new gadget to clean his kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新的小器具来清洁厨房。
words.en: A gadget is a small device or machine with a particular purpose.

words.ex: The bridge was supported by massive steel girders.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥由巨大的钢梁支撑。
words.en: A girder is a large iron or steel beam or compound structure used for building bridges and the framework of large buildings.

words.tr:
n. 紧身褡；腰带；围绕物
v. 以腰带束缚；围绕
words.ex: She wore a girdle to look slimmer.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条束腰裙来显得更苗条。
words.en: A girdle is a piece of women's underwear that fits tightly around the stomach, hips, and bottom.

words.tr:
v. 磨碎；磨擦；（使）烦躁；发出磨擦声
n. 炉栅；炉箅
words.ex: The food was grated into small pieces.
words.ex_cn: 食物被擦成了小块。
words.en: To grate means to reduce food to small shreds by rubbing it on a grater. It can also mean to make a harsh, scraping sound or to cause irritation or annoyance.

words.ex: The city improved its power grid to handle more electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改进了其电力输送网，以承载更多的电力。
words.en: A grid is a pattern of straight lines that cross each other to form squares. It is used to help you draw or to help you find places on a map.

words.ex: The nail fits into the groove.
words.ex_cn: 钉子卡在槽里。
words.en: A groove is a long, narrow space or cut in a surface, often made to guide the movement of something or to hold something in place. It can also refer to a settled routine or way of doing things that is hard to change.

words.tr: adj. 适合居住的；可居住的；
words.ex: The planet is habitable because it has water and air.
words.ex_cn: 这颗行星有水和空气，适合居住。
words.en: A place that is habitable is suitable or good enough for people to live in.

words.ex: He used a hacksaw to cut through the metal pipe.
words.ex_cn: 他用钢锯切割金属管。
words.en: A hacksaw is a tool for cutting metal, consisting of a narrow, fine-toothed blade stretched in a frame.

words.ex: She wore a hairpiece to cover her baldness.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了一顶假发来遮盖秃顶。
words.en: A hairpiece is a piece of false hair that some people wear on their head if they are bald or if they want to make their own hair seem longer or thicker.

words.ex: He lives in a small hamlet near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他住在山附近的一个小村庄里。
words.en: A hamlet is a small settlement, generally one smaller than a village, and strictly (in Britain) one without a church.

words.ex: He sleeps in a hammock under the tree.
words.ex_cn: 他睡在树下的吊床上。
words.en: A hammock is a piece of strong cloth or netting which is hung between two supports and used as a bed.

words.ex: The coat is on a hanger in the closet.
words.ex_cn: 外套挂在衣橱里的衣架上。
words.en: A hanger is a curved piece of wood, metal, or plastic that you use to hang clothes on.

words.tr: n. 绞刑；悬挂；帷幔；“hanging”的复数
words.ex: The old prison had many hangings in the 1800s.
words.ex_cn: 这座老监狱在19世纪有许多绞刑。
words.en: Hangings refer to decorative pieces of fabric that are hung on walls or windows to add beauty or to cover them.

words.ex: He wiped his nose with a hankie.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块手帕擦了擦鼻子。
words.en: A hankie is a small piece of cloth that you use for blowing your nose or wiping your eyes.

words.ex: He wiped his nose with a hanky.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块手帕擦了鼻子。
words.en: A hanky is a small piece of cloth that you use for wiping your nose or eyes.

words.ex: The furniture was made from hardboard.
words.ex_cn: 这件家具是用硬纸板做的。
words.en: Hardboard is a type of board made from compressed wood fibers, used especially in building and furniture making.

words.ex: He used a hatchet to cut wood.
words.ex_cn: 他用斧头砍木头。
words.en: A hatchet is a small axe with a short handle, used for chopping wood.

words.ex: He believes he will go to heaven after death.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自己死后会去天堂。
words.en: In some religions, heaven is the place where God or the gods live and where good people go after they die.

words.ex: He looked for his keys in the haystack.
words.ex_cn: 他在干草堆里找他的钥匙。
words.en: A haystack is a large pile of hay, often built outdoors and used to store hay for animals.

words.tr: n. 头饰；头巾；头发编梳的式样
words.ex: She wore an elaborate headdress for the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 她为婚礼戴了一顶精致的饰头巾。
words.en: A headdress is a decorative covering or ornament worn on the head.

words.ex: He adjusted the headrest to sit comfortably.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了头枕以便坐得舒服。
words.en: A headrest is a support for the head, especially one attached to the back of a seat in a car or airplane.

words.tr: n. 壁炉地面；炉床；炉边
words.ex: She sat by the hearth to keep warm.
words.ex_cn: 她坐在壁炉旁取暖。
words.en: The floor of a fireplace, often extending into a room and paved with brick, stone, or cement, used as a place to build fires or for sitting in front of a fire.

words.tr: n. 加热；供暖设备；采暖； v. 加热；“heat”的现在分词；
words.ex: The heating of the room takes five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 房间的加热需要五分钟。
words.en: The process of making something warm or hot, or the system that does this.

words.ex: The newspaper's headline said 'City Wins Championship'.
words.ex_cn: 报纸的大字标题写着‘城市赢得冠军’。
words.en: A headline is the title of a newspaper story, printed in large letters at the top of the story, especially on the front page.

words.tr: n. 藏身处；隐匿处；退隐处
words.ex: The kids found a hideaway in the woods.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在树林里发现了一个隐蔽的地方。
words.en: A hideaway is a place where someone goes because they want to be alone or because they want to hide from someone.

words.tr: n. 小孩吃饭时所用之高脚椅子
words.ex: The baby sits in the highchair to eat.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝坐在高脚椅上吃饭。
words.en: A highchair is a type of chair designed for babies and young children to sit in while eating. It is usually elevated to bring the child up to table height.

words.ex: He wore hobnail boots to walk on rough ground.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着钉鞋在崎岖的地面上行走。
words.en: A hobnail is a short nail with a thick head used to reinforce the soles of boots or shoes.

words.ex: The hod is cleaning the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 清洁工正在打扫教室。
words.en: A hod is a tool used by bricklayers to carry bricks or mortar.

words.ex: The wine was stored in a large hogshead.
words.ex_cn: 葡萄酒被存放在一个大酒桶里。
words.en: A large cask or barrel, especially one used for wine or beer, holding a specific volume.

words.ex: He lives on a small homestead with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在一个小农场里。
words.en: A homestead is a house and the land around it, especially a farm.

words.ex: He turned on the hoover to clean the carpet.
words.ex_cn: 他打开吸尘器清理地毯。
words.en: To clean something, especially a carpet, with a vacuum cleaner.

words.tr:
v. 急急忙忙地走
adv. 急匆匆地
words.ex: He hotfooted to the store when he ran out of milk.
words.ex_cn: 他一喝完牛奶就赶紧跑去了商店。
words.en: If you hotfoot it somewhere, you go there very quickly.

words.ex: The flowers grow in a hothouse.
words.ex_cn: 这些花在温室里生长。
words.en: A hothouse is a building made of glass in which plants that need protection from cold weather are grown.

words.tr: n. 电炉；烤盘；（炉灶上的）加热板
words.ex: He cooks soup on a hotplate.
words.ex_cn: 他用热板煮汤。
words.en: A hotplate is a portable device with a flat heated surface, used for cooking food or keeping it warm.

words.ex: The old man lives in a small hovel.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人住在一间小破屋里。
words.en: A hovel is a small, dirty, and often poorly built house or shelter.

words.ex: The rabbit lives in a small hutch.
words.ex_cn: 兔子住在一个小兔舍里。
words.en: A hutch is a type of cage or pen used to house small animals, especially rabbits, or a piece of furniture with shelves and a cupboard.

words.ex: The fire truck connected to the hydrant.
words.ex_cn: 消防车连接到消防栓。
words.en: A hydrant is an upright pipe with a spout, nozzle, or other outlet, usually in the street, for drawing water from a main or service line, especially for fighting fires.

words.ex: The lamp provides illumination in the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯为黑暗的房间提供照明。
words.en: The act of providing or casting light on something, or the state of being lit up; also, the clarification or elucidation of a subject or issue.

words.tr: adj. 适于居住的；可居住的
words.ex: The planet is not inhabitable because it is too hot.
words.ex_cn: 这颗行星不适合居住，因为它太热了。
words.en: Capable of being lived in; suitable for living in.

words.ex: He walks in step with his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友齐步走。
words.en: If people are in step, they are moving in time to a rhythm or in agreement with each other.

words.tr:
n. 狗舍；养狗场
v. 把…置于狗舍
words.ex: The dog sleeps in a kennel at night.
words.ex_cn: 狗晚上睡在狗窝里。
words.en: A kennel is a small hut made for a dog to sleep in, or a place where dogs are bred or looked after.

words.tr:
n. 漆；发胶
v. 涂漆
words.ex: He painted the box with red lacquer.
words.ex_cn: 他用红色漆漆了这个盒子。
words.en: A liquid that is painted onto surfaces to make them shiny and hard.

words.tr:
n. 杓子；长柄杓
v. 以杓舀取
words.ex: He used a ladle to scoop soup into the bowl.
words.ex_cn: 他用勺子把汤舀进碗里。
words.en: A ladle is a large, deep spoon with a long handle, used for serving soup, stew, or sauce.

words.tr:
n. 门闩；碰锁；弹簧锁
v. 用闩闩上；用碰锁锁上
words.ex: The door has a simple latch to keep it closed.
words.ex_cn: 这扇门有一个简单的门闩来保持关闭。
words.en: A latch is a fastening for a door or gate, consisting of a bar that is lifted from its catch, groove, or hole by a lever, or that slides or is pushed into place.

words.ex: The cat sat on the ledge of the window.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在窗户的架状突出物上。
words.en: A ledge is a narrow horizontal surface projecting from a wall, cliff, or other surface.

words.ex: Farming is his main livelihood.
words.ex_cn: 务农是他的主要生计。
words.en: A person's livelihood is the way they earn money in order to live.

words.ex: He turned the loft into a bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 他把阁楼改成了卧室。
words.en: A loft is a room or space directly under the roof of a building, used for accommodation or storage.

words.ex: The mother sang a lullaby to her baby.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈为她的宝宝唱了一首摇篮曲。
words.en: A lullaby is a quiet song which is intended to be sung to babies and young children to help them go to sleep.

words.tr:
n. 修指甲
v. 修指甲；修剪
words.ex: She got a manicure on Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 她在周六做了美甲。
words.en: A manicure is a cosmetic beauty treatment for the fingernails and hands performed at home or in a nail salon.

words.ex: He lives in a big mansion near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一座大宅子里。
words.en: A mansion is a very large, impressive house, especially one that is the home of a wealthy or important person.

words.ex: She placed the trophy on the mantelpiece.
words.ex_cn: 她把奖杯放在了壁炉台上。
words.en: A mantelpiece is a shelf above a fireplace, often used for displaying ornaments.

words.ex: They are discussing marital problems.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在讨论婚姻问题。
words.en: Marital is used to describe things relating to marriage.

words.tr:
v. 切碎；剁碎；装腔作势地小步走
n. 绞碎的肉
words.ex: He minces garlic for the sauce.
words.ex_cn: 他把大蒜剁碎用来做酱。
words.en: To mince means to cut food, especially meat, into very small pieces, or to walk or speak in an affected manner.

words.ex: He wears a mitten to keep his hand warm.
words.ex_cn: 他戴一只连指手套来暖手。
words.en: A mitten is a glove that has one section for the thumb and another section for all four fingers together, used to keep the hands warm in cold weather.

words.ex: The perfume contains natural musk.
words.ex_cn: 这种香水含有天然麝香。
words.en: A substance with a strong smell that is used in making perfumes, obtained from a type of deer.

words.tr:
n. 钢笔尖；尖头
v. 装尖头
words.ex: The nib of his pen is broken.
words.ex_cn: 他的钢笔笔尖坏了。
words.en: The pointed end part of a pen, which distributes the ink on the writing surface.

words.ex: The baby is sucking on the nipple.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在吸吮乳头。
words.en: A nipple is a small projection of the breast or bottle from which a baby suckles milk.

words.ex: The occupancy of the hotel is high during summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天酒店的占用率很高。
words.en: The act of occupying or the state of being occupied, especially the condition of being occupied by tenants or the period during which a property is occupied.

words.tr:
n. 挂锁；扣锁
v. 用挂锁锁上
words.ex: He secured the gate with a padlock.
words.ex_cn: 他用挂锁锁住了大门。
words.en: A padlock is a lock which is used for fastening two things together, for example two parts of a door or a lid on a container. It consists of a block of metal with a U-shaped bar attached to it. One end of the bar is released by turning a key in the lock.

words.ex: We had dinner on the patio.
words.ex_cn: 我们在庭院里吃了晚饭。
words.en: A patio is an outdoor space generally used for dining or recreation that adjoins a residence and is typically paved.

words.ex: Farmers use peat to improve soil quality.
words.ex_cn: 农民用泥炭来改善土壤质量。
words.en: Peat is a brown, soil-like material consisting of partly decomposed vegetable matter forming in wet conditions in bogs and fens, and used for fuel and as a mulch.

words.tr: n. 楼顶阁楼；楼顶房屋
words.ex: The penthouse offers a breathtaking view of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这间顶层公寓提供了城市令人惊叹的景色。
words.en: A penthouse is an apartment on the top floor or roof of a building, often luxurious and offering expansive views.

words.ex: The boy cleaned the dirty pigsty with a shovel.
words.ex_cn: 男孩用铲子清理了脏乱的猪圈。
words.en: A pigsty is a place where pigs are kept, which is often very dirty and untidy.

words.tr:
v. 撒尿
n. 小便
words.ex: He went outside to take a piss.
words.ex_cn: 他出去小便。
words.en: To urinate; to pass liquid waste from the body.

words.tr: n. 格子花呢；格子花呢披衣
words.ex: She wore a plaid skirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条格子裙去参加派对。
words.en: Plaid is a pattern consisting of crossed horizontal and vertical bands in two or more colors in woven cloth.

words.tr: n. 匾额；饰板；薄金属板；齿菌斑
words.ex: The plaque on the wall honors the founder of the school.
words.ex_cn: 墙上的匾额纪念这所学校的创始人。
words.en: A plaque is a flat piece of metal or stone with writing on it that is fixed to a wall or other structure to remind people of an important person or event.

words.tr:
n. 灰泥；
v. 涂以灰泥；敷以膏药；
words.ex: The wall was covered with white plaster.
words.ex_cn: 墙壁上覆盖着白色灰泥。
words.en: A substance applied to walls or ceilings to smooth or decorate them, or a medical dressing used to cover wounds.

words.tr:
n. 褶；褶状物
v. 使打褶
words.ex: She ironed the pleat in her skirt.
words.ex_cn: 她把裙子上的褶皱熨平了。
words.en: A pleat is a fold in a piece of cloth, made by doubling the material over on itself and then pressing or stitching it into place.

words.ex: The hotel has a plush lobby with velvet chairs.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有一个豪华的大堂，配有丝绒椅子。
words.en: Plush refers to something that is luxurious and expensive, or a type of fabric that is very soft and thick.

words.ex: He sits on the porch and drinks coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在门廊上喝咖啡。
words.en: A porch is a covered shelter projecting in front of the entrance of a building.

words.tr: n. 小袋；囊状袋；育儿袋；
words.ex: The kangaroo carries its baby in a pouch.
words.ex_cn: 袋鼠把幼崽放在小袋里。
words.en: A pouch is a small, flexible bag, typically made of leather or fabric, used for carrying small items.

words.tr: n. 仓库；贮藏室；存放处；智囊
words.ex: He saves his code in a GitHub repository.
words.ex_cn: 他把代码保存在 GitHub 仓库中。
words.en: A repository is a place where something is stored or can be found.

words.ex: His residence is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他的住所靠近公园。
words.en: A residence is a house or place where someone lives.

words.ex: He lives in a residential area near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一个住宅区。
words.en: Relating to or suitable for residence.

words.ex: The restoration of the old house took two years.
words.ex_cn: 这座老房子的修复花了两年时间。
words.en: The act of returning something to its original condition, or the state of being returned to its original condition.

words.ex: He always keeps his garden trim and neat.
words.ex_cn: 他总是把花园打理得整洁有序。
words.en: To trim something means to make it tidier or more level by cutting a small amount off it.

words.ex: He peeled the rind off the orange.
words.ex_cn: 他把橙子的外皮剥掉了。
words.en: The outer layer or skin of a fruit or cheese.

words.ex: Rinse the dishes with water before drying them.
words.ex_cn: 在晾干盘子之前用清水冲洗。
words.en: To rinse something means to wash it in clean water in order to remove soap or dirt.

words.ex: She put on rouge before the party.
words.ex_cn: 她在参加派对前涂了胭脂。
words.en: A red powder or cream used as a cosmetic for colouring the cheeks or lips.

words.ex: The children played on the rubble after the building fell.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物倒塌后，孩子们在碎石上玩耍。
words.en: Rubble is the broken pieces of stone, brick, etc., that are left when a building falls down or is destroyed.

words.tr:
n. 腰带；彩带；肩带；窗框
v. 系上腰带；装以窗框
words.ex: She wore a red sash around her waist.
words.ex_cn: 她腰上系着一条红色的丝带。
words.en: A sash is a long piece of cloth which people wear around their waist or over one shoulder, especially as part of a uniform or official dress. It can also refer to the frame of a window.

words.ex: She wore a warm scarf in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她在冬天戴了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: A scarf is a piece of cloth that you wear around your neck or head, usually to keep yourself warm.

words.tr:
adj. 僻静的；隐僻的； 退隐的
v. 隔离；隔绝；隐居；“seclude”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The cabin is secluded in the woods.
words.ex_cn: 小木屋坐落在树林中，十分僻静。
words.en: A secluded place is quiet, private, and not near people or things that disturb you.

words.tr:
n. 棚屋；简陋的小屋
v. 居住
words.ex: He lives in a small shack near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一间小木屋里。
words.en: A shack is a small, simple building, often made of wood or metal, which is not very well built or comfortable.

words.ex: The sword slid easily into its sheath.
words.ex_cn: 剑很容易地滑入鞘中。
words.en: A sheath is a close-fitting cover for the blade of a knife or sword, or a similar protective covering for something else.

words.tr: n. 撇取物；泛泛阅读者；剪嘴鸥科水禽
words.ex: He uses a skimmer to remove oil from the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他用捞勺从汤里捞出油。
words.en: A skimmer is a device used for removing substances from the surface of a liquid. It can also refer to a person who reads or looks through something quickly, or a type of bird that flies low over water to catch fish.

words.ex: The sponge lives in the ocean and filters water for food.
words.ex_cn: 这种海绵动物生活在海洋中，通过过滤水来获取食物。
words.en: A sponge is a piece of a soft, light, porous substance originally from the skeletons of marine creatures, used for washing, cleaning, or padding. As a verb, it means to wipe, rub, or clean with a sponge or to absorb something.

words.tr: n. （供人翻越田地处所设栅栏的）台阶；梯磴
words.ex: He climbed over the stile to get to the field.
words.ex_cn: 他翻过石阶进入田野。
words.en: A stile is a structure which provides people a passage through or over a fence or boundary via steps, ladders, or narrow gaps.

words.ex: The speech stoked anger among the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 这篇演讲激起了人群的愤怒。
words.en: To stoke a fire means to add fuel to it to make it burn more strongly. It can also mean to encourage or increase strong feelings or emotions.

words.ex: He fastened the strap around his wrist.
words.ex_cn: 他把带子系在手腕上。
words.en: A strap is a narrow piece of leather, cloth, or other material that is used to fasten, secure, or carry something, or to hold onto something.

words.ex: They live in a quiet suburb outside the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市外一个安静的市郊。
words.en: A suburb is a residential district located on the outskirts of a city.

words.ex: The suburbanite drives to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位郊区居民每天早上开车去上班。
words.en: A suburbanite is a person who lives in a suburb.

words.tr: n. 苏格兰格子呢；格子图案；独桅三角帆船
words.ex: He wore a tartan scarf in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天戴了一条格子围巾。
words.en: A tartan is a pattern consisting of criss-crossed horizontal and vertical bands in multiple colours, associated particularly with Scottish culture.

words.tr: n. （房屋、土地等的）租用期限；租赁；
words.ex: The tenancy lasts for one year.
words.ex_cn: 租期为一年。
words.en: The period of time for which a property is rented.

words.ex: The tenant pays rent every month.
words.ex_cn: 房客每个月支付租金。
words.en: A tenant is a person who rents land or property from a landlord.

words.ex: He crossed the threshold of adulthood at 18.
words.ex_cn: 他在18岁时进入了成年的起始点。
words.en: The threshold of something is the point at which it begins or changes.

words.ex: He walked over the wooden trestle.
words.ex_cn: 他走过木制的支架。
words.en: A trestle is a framework consisting of a horizontal beam supported by two pairs of sloping legs, used in pairs to support a flat surface such as a tabletop.

words.ex: He put the camera on a tripod.
words.ex_cn: 他把相机放在三脚架上。
words.en: A tripod is a three-legged stand or support, especially for a camera or telescope.

words.ex: He wears a tweed jacket to work.
words.ex_cn: 他上班穿一件花呢夹克。
words.en: Tweed is a type of rough, woolen cloth, typically woven in a twill pattern and used for suits and coats.

words.tr: v. （给椅子）装上椅套（或软垫等）
words.ex: He will upholster the old chair with new fabric.
words.ex_cn: 他将用新布料重新包裹那把旧椅子。
words.en: To provide furniture, especially seats, with padding, springs, webbing, and fabric or leather covers.

words.ex: He picked up a spoon, a common utensil.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起了一把勺子，一种常见的餐具。
words.en: An utensil is a tool that you use in your home, especially in the kitchen, for example, a knife, fork, or spoon.

words.ex: He poured wine into a large vat.
words.ex_cn: 他把葡萄酒倒进一个大桶里。
words.en: A vat is a large container used for holding liquids, especially in industrial processes.

words.ex: He poured the medicine into a small vial.
words.ex_cn: 他把药水倒进一个小瓶子里。
words.en: A vial is a very small glass bottle used especially to hold liquid medicines.

words.ex: The vicarage is next to the church.
words.ex_cn: 牧师住宅就在教堂旁边。
words.en: The residence provided by the church for a vicar.

words.ex: He wore a white waistcoat with his suit.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件白色背心搭配西装。
words.en: A waistcoat is a sleeveless garment that buttons down the front, typically worn over a shirt and under a jacket as part of a man's formal or business attire.

words.ex: He sells his wares at the market every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都在市场上卖他的商品。
words.en: Goods or merchandise that are for sale.

words.ex: She is weaning her baby off milk.
words.ex_cn: 她正在让宝宝戒掉牛奶。
words.en: To wean someone off something means to make them gradually stop using or depending on it, especially something harmful or unnecessary.

chapters.name: 多彩生活 休闲娱乐 重点词

words.tr: v. 戒绝；弃权；自我克制
words.ex: He abstains from eating sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他戒食糖。
words.en: If you abstain from something, you deliberately do not do it or have it, especially something you like or enjoy which might be considered bad for you.

words.ex: The game is addictive and hard to stop playing.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏令人上瘾，很难停止玩。
words.en: If a substance or activity is addictive, it makes you want more of it so that you become dependent on it.

words.ex: This phone is affordable for students.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机对学生来说价格合理。
words.en: If something is affordable, most people have enough money to buy it.

words.ex: The clown amuses the children with funny tricks.
words.ex_cn: 小丑用滑稽的把戏娱乐孩子们。
words.en: If something amuses you, it makes you want to laugh or smile.

words.ex: The crowd applauded after the performance.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众鼓掌了。
words.en: To applaud means to show approval or praise by clapping the hands.

words.tr: adj. 混杂的；什锦的；各样的
words.ex: He bought assorted candies at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店买了各种各样的糖果。
words.en: Assorted means consisting of various kinds mixed together.

words.tr:
n. 酒；酒宴；暴饮
v. 暴饮；痛饮
words.ex: He drinks too much booze at parties.
words.ex_cn: 他在聚会上喝太多酒。
words.en: To booze means to drink alcohol, especially in large quantities.

words.ex: The restaurant caters to vegetarians.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅满足素食者的需求。
words.en: To cater means to provide food and drink at an event, often as a business service, or to provide what is needed or wanted by a particular person or group.

words.ex: The smoke made him choke.
words.ex_cn: 烟让他窒息。
words.en: If you choke, or if something chokes you, you cannot breathe properly because there is not enough air or because something is blocking your throat.

words.tr: n. 强迫；强制；难以抗拒的冲动
words.ex: He felt a compulsion to check the door again.
words.ex_cn: 他感到一种必须再次检查门的强迫感。
words.en: A compulsion is a very strong desire to do something, which you find difficult to control.

words.ex: The car consumes a lot of gas.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车消耗很多汽油。
words.en: To consume something means to eat or drink it, or to use it up in some way.

words.ex: The store is open 24 hours for your convenience.
words.ex_cn: 商店24小时营业，以方便您。
words.en: The state of being able to proceed with something with little effort or difficulty.

words.ex: She ate a crisp apple for snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了一个脆苹果当点心。
words.en: Something that is crisp is hard, and makes a pleasant sound when you break it or crush it.

words.ex: She wore a dainty necklace with tiny pearls.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了一条小巧精致的珍珠项链。
words.en: If you describe something as dainty, you mean that it is small, delicate, and pretty.

words.ex: The stomach digests food into nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 胃将食物消化成营养物质。
words.en: To digest means to break down food in the stomach and intestines into substances that can be absorbed by the body. It can also mean to understand or assimilate information. As a noun, it refers to a compilation or summary of information.

words.tr:
n. 折扣；
v. 不全信；不重视；
words.ex: The store gave a 20% discount on all shoes.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有鞋子提供了20%的折扣。
words.en: A reduction in the usual price of something, or the act of reducing the price.

words.tr:
n. 展示；陈列；
v. 展示；陈列；
words.ex: The store has a big display of new phones.
words.ex_cn: 商店里有一个新手机的展示。
words.en: To display something means to put it in a place where people can see it easily, or to show it to people.

words.tr: adj. 可食用的；可以吃的；
words.ex: These mushrooms are edible and safe to eat.
words.ex_cn: 这些蘑菇是可食用的，安全可以吃。
words.en: Fit to be eaten as food.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.ex: The expense of the trip was higher than expected.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的费用比预期的要高。
words.en: An expense is the amount of money that you spend on something.

words.ex: Wearing blue jeans is fashionable now.
words.ex_cn: 现在穿牛仔裤很时髦。
words.en: Something that is fashionable is popular or approved of at a particular time.

words.tr: v. 感到；认为；“feel”的过去式和过去分词； n. 毛毡；毡制品；
words.ex: I felt happy when I saw my friend.
words.ex_cn: 当我见到我的朋友时，我感到开心。
words.en: If you feel a particular emotion or physical sensation, you experience it.

words.tr:
n. 连枷
v. 用连枷打；胡乱摆动；用力地挥动
words.ex: The farmer flails the wheat to separate the grains.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用连枷打小麦以分离谷粒。
words.en: A flail is a tool used for threshing grain, consisting of a long handle with a freely swinging stick or bar attached to it. As a verb, to flail means to wave or swing wildly; to thrash about.

words.tr:
n. 油炸馅饼
v. 挥霍；浪费
words.ex: He frittered away his inheritance on gambling.
words.ex_cn: 他把继承来的遗产挥霍在赌博上。
words.en: If someone fritters away time or money, they waste it on unimportant or unnecessary things.

words.tr:
v. 狼吞虎咽；吞并；火鸡咯咯叫
n. 火鸡叫声
words.ex: The dog will gobble up its food quickly.
words.ex_cn: 狗会很快把食物狼吞虎咽地吃掉。
words.en: To eat something quickly and eagerly, often making a noise.

words.tr:
v. 争论；讲价
n. 讨价还价；争论
words.ex: They haggle over the price of the car.
words.ex_cn: 他们为汽车的价格争论。
words.en: If you haggle, you argue about something, especially about the price of something you want to buy.

words.tr:
n. 肉丁；杂乱；#号
v. 切碎；弄糟；推敲
words.ex: He added hash to his breakfast plate.
words.ex_cn: 他把肉丁加到了早餐盘里。
words.en: Hash can refer to a dish of cooked meat cut into small pieces and recooked, usually with potatoes. In computing, a hash is a function that converts an input of letters and numbers into an encrypted output of a fixed length.

words.ex: The boys were caught doing horseplay in the hallway.
words.ex_cn: 这些男孩在走廊里打闹，被抓住了。
words.en: Rough, boisterous play.

words.ex: He imbibes coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都喝咖啡。
words.en: To imbibe means to drink, especially alcohol, or to absorb or take in something, such as knowledge or ideas.

words.tr:
n. 标签；
v. 用标签标明；
words.ex: The bottle has a label with the name of the drink.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子上有一个写着饮料名称的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, polymer, cloth, metal, or other material affixed to a container or article, on which is written or printed information or symbols about the product or item.

words.tr:
adj. 奢侈的；慷慨给予的；挥霍的；过多的
v. 浪费；挥霍；慷慨给予
words.ex: He threw a lavish party for his birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的生日举办了一场奢华的派对。
words.en: If you describe something as lavish, you mean that it is very elaborate and impressive and a lot of money has been spent on it. If you say that someone is lavish in the way they behave, you mean that they give, spend, or use a lot of something.

words.tr: adj. 美味的；甘美的；满足感官的；性感的
words.ex: The fruit was luscious and sweet.
words.ex_cn: 这种水果甘甜可口。
words.en: If you describe something as luscious, you mean that it is very pleasant to taste, smell, look at, or listen to.

words.tr:
n. 化妆舞会；伪装
v. 伪装；冒充
words.ex: We went to a masquerade last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去参加了一个化妆舞会。
words.en: A masquerade is a party or dance where people wear masks and costumes, or it refers to the act of pretending to be someone or something else.

words.tr: n. 迷宫；错综复杂的曲径；
words.ex: The children got lost in the maze.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在迷宫里迷路了。
words.en: A maze is a complex system of paths or passages in which it is easy to get lost.

words.tr:
adj. 甜熟的；醇香的；柔和的；成熟的；沉醉的
v. （使）成熟；（使颜色）柔和；（使酒）更加醇香
words.ex: The apple became mellow after a few days.
words.ex_cn: 几天后，苹果变软了。
words.en: If someone mellows or if something mellows them, they become kinder or less extreme in their behavior, often as a result of becoming older or more experienced.

words.ex: The outlay for the new computer was high.
words.ex_cn: 这台新电脑的花费很高。
words.en: An outlay is an amount of money that you have to spend in order to buy something or to start a project.

words.ex: The soup was palatable after adding salt.
words.ex_cn: 加了盐后，汤变得可口美味了。
words.en: If you describe food or drink as palatable, you mean that it tastes pleasant.

words.ex: The movie's premiere was held last night.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的首映昨晚举行。
words.en: The first public performance of a play, film, or other form of entertainment.

words.ex: She tried to prevail on him to change his mind.
words.ex_cn: 她试图劝服他改变主意。
words.en: If a proposal, principle, or opinion prevails, it gains influence or is accepted, often after a struggle or argument.

words.tr: adj. 普遍的；流行的；盛行的；
words.ex: Smoking is prevalent in that country.
words.ex_cn: 在那个国家，吸烟很普遍。
words.en: If a condition, practice, or belief is prevalent, it is common or widespread.

words.ex: The reception at the hotel was very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的接待非常友好。
words.en: The act of receiving or being received, especially in a formal or official context.

words.tr: v. 躺；靠在；向后倾斜（坐椅）
words.ex: He reclines on the sofa after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后躺在沙发上。
words.en: To recline means to lean or lie back in a relaxed position with the body supported.

words.ex: He scan the QR code with his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机扫描了二维码。
words.en: To look at something carefully or quickly in order to find out specific information or to examine something thoroughly.

words.tr:
v. 拖曳；搅乱；洗牌；移来移去
n. 拖着脚走；洗牌；混在一起
words.ex: He shuffle his feet across the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他拖着脚在地板上走。
words.en: To shuffle is to walk by dragging one's feet along or without lifting them fully from the ground. It also means to mix up the order of things, especially cards in a deck.

words.tr:
v. 煨；用文火炖；充满；即将爆发
n. 炖；即将发作
words.ex: The soup is simmering on the stove.
words.ex_cn: 汤正在炉子上慢炖。
words.en: To cook something slowly at a temperature slightly below boiling point.

words.tr:
n. 纸片；
v. 滑倒；溜走；
words.ex: She found a slip of paper on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她在桌子上发现了一张纸片。
words.en: If you slip, you accidentally slide and lose your balance.

words.tr:
n. 鼻烟；烛花
v. 用鼻子使劲吸；熄灭；断气
words.ex: He takes snuff every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都吸鼻烟。
words.en: Snuff is powdered tobacco that people take by sniffing it into their noses. It can also refer to the act of extinguishing a candle or the burnt part of a candle wick.

words.tr: adj. 味道不好的；让人不快的；难以接受的；
words.ex: The soup was unpalatable and too salty.
words.ex_cn: 这汤味道不好，太咸了。
words.en: If you describe an idea as unpalatable, you mean that you find it unpleasant and difficult to accept.

words.ex: Blue jeans are in vogue this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年牛仔裤很时髦。
words.en: If something is in vogue, it is very popular and fashionable.

words.tr: v. 打滚；躺卧；（船）颠簸；沉湎
words.ex: The pig wallow in the mud.
words.ex_cn: 猪在泥里打滚。
words.en: If you say that someone is wallowing in an unpleasant situation, you are criticizing them for being deliberately unhappy.

chapters.name: 多彩生活 休闲娱乐 认知词

words.tr: phrase. 按菜单定价点菜（与套餐相对）
words.ex: He ordered coffee à la carte.
words.ex_cn: 他单点了一杯咖啡。
words.en: If you choose à la carte, you choose individual dishes from a menu rather than having a complete meal that has been selected for you.

words.ex: He bought a new accessory for his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的手机买了一个新配件。
words.en: An accessory is something such as a bag or piece of jewelry that you wear or carry because it is attractive.

words.ex: My son loves watching cartoon animation.
words.ex_cn: 我儿子喜欢看卡通动画。
words.en: Animation is the process of making films in which drawings or puppets appear to move.

words.ex: She bought new apparel for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了新衣服。
words.en: Clothing, especially outer garments; attire.

words.ex: He has an appetite for spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢辛辣食物。
words.en: A desire or liking for something, especially food.

words.ex: The store offers an assortment of snacks.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供各种各样的零食。
words.en: An assortment is a group of similar things that are of different types or sizes.

words.ex: The school concert was held in the auditorium.
words.ex_cn: 学校的音乐会是在礼堂举行的。
words.en: An auditorium is the part of a theatre, concert hall, or other public building in which the audience sits.

words.ex: The actors stood in front of the backdrop with a mountain scene.
words.ex_cn: 演员们站在有山景的背景幕布前。
words.en: A backdrop is a large piece of cloth, often with scenery or buildings painted on it, that is hung at the back of a stage in a theatre.

words.ex: We bought spices at the local bazaar.
words.ex_cn: 我们在当地的集市上买了香料。
words.en: A bazaar is a market consisting of rows of shops or stalls, especially in the Middle East, or a sale of miscellaneous contributed articles to benefit some charity.

words.tr:
n. 大吃大喝；狂欢作乐；无节制
v. 放纵；不加节制
words.ex: He had a binge on pizza and soda last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚大吃大喝了一顿披萨和苏打水。
words.en: If someone goes on a binge, they do too much of something, such as drinking alcohol, eating, or spending money, usually over a short period of time.

words.tr:
n. 宾果游戏
int. 太好了！
words.ex: He shouted bingo when he got five in a row.
words.ex_cn: 当他连成五子时，他大喊‘宾果’。
words.en: Bingo is a game in which each player has a card with numbers on it. The caller calls out numbers and if a player has that number on their card they mark it off. The first player to mark off all their numbers calls out 'Bingo!' and wins the game.

words.ex: She bought a dress from a small boutique downtown.
words.ex_cn: 她在市中心的一家小型时装精品屋买了一条裙子。
words.en: A boutique is a small shop that sells stylish clothes, shoes, or jewelry.

words.tr:
v. 酿造；沏；酝酿
n. 酿造的饮料；啤酒
words.ex: He brews coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上冲咖啡。
words.en: If you brew tea or coffee, you make it by pouring hot water over tea leaves or ground coffee. If you brew beer, you make it by soaking grain in water and then fermenting it.

words.ex: We had dinner at a buffet with many dishes to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 我们在自助餐吃了晚饭，有很多菜可以选。
words.en: A buffet is a meal consisting of several dishes from which guests serve themselves. As a verb, to buffet means to strike repeatedly and violently.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.ex: She wears a soft cashmere sweater in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她冬天穿一件柔软的羊绒毛衣。
words.en: Cashmere is a type of very fine, soft wool that comes from the undercoat of cashmere goats. It is used to make high-quality clothing such as sweaters and scarves.

words.tr:
n. 嘘声；不满之声
v. 发嘘声
words.ex: The audience started catcalling when the speaker made a controversial statement.
words.ex_cn: 当演讲者发表有争议的言论时，观众开始发出嘘声。
words.en: A catcall is a loud whistle or a comment shouted by someone in a crowd, usually expressing disapproval or mockery.

words.ex: He ate caviar at the fancy restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 他在高档餐厅吃了鱼子酱。
words.en: Caviar is the salted eggs of a large fish, especially a sturgeon, and is considered a delicacy.

words.ex: They drank champagne at the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他们在婚礼上喝了香槟。
words.en: Champagne is an expensive French white wine with bubbles in. It is often drunk to celebrate something.

words.ex: Please go to the checkout to pay for your groceries.
words.ex_cn: 请去付款处支付你的杂货。
words.en: The act of paying for goods or services in a store, or the place where this is done.

words.ex: She wore a chic dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条别致的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as chic, you mean that they are stylish and fashionable.

words.tr:
v. 剧烈搅动；（使）猛烈翻腾
n. 搅乳器
words.ex: The machine churns the butter in the cream.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器剧烈搅动奶油来制作黄油。
words.en: To churn means to stir or shake milk or cream in order to make butter, or to move something around violently in water or air.

words.ex: The children loved the circus with clowns and elephants.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢有小丑和大象的马戏团。
words.en: A circus is a group of performers that include clowns, acrobats, and trained animals, who travel to different places to entertain people.

words.ex: He used cocaine last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚用了可卡因。
words.en: A drug obtained from the leaves of the coca plant, used as a local anesthetic and also illegally as a stimulant.

words.tr:
n. 连环漫画；
adj. 滑稽的；
words.ex: He reads a comic every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读一本连环漫画。
words.en: A comic is someone who entertains people by making them laugh, especially a professional comedian.

words.tr: n. 甜食；糖果；调制；精美作品
words.ex: He bought a confection at the candy store.
words.ex_cn: 他在糖果店买了一颗糖果。
words.en: A confection is a sweet food or a delicacy made with sugar or other sweeteners.

words.ex: They threw confetti at the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他们在婚礼上撒了彩纸屑。
words.en: Small pieces of colored paper that are traditionally thrown over a bride and groom at a wedding.

words.ex: The wizard conjure a fireball with ancient words.
words.ex_cn: 巫师用古老的咒语召唤出一个火球。
words.en: If you conjure something out of nothing, you make it appear as if by magic.

words.ex: He plays the cornet in the school band.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校乐队里吹短号。
words.en: A cornet is a musical instrument of the brass family, similar to a trumpet but with a more compact shape and a mellower tone.

words.ex: She uses cosmetic cream to make her skin look better.
words.ex_cn: 她使用美容霜让皮肤看起来更好。
words.en: A cosmetic is a substance that you put on your face or body to improve its appearance.

words.ex: He wore a funny costume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对穿了一套滑稽的服装。
words.en: A costume is a set of clothes in a style typical of a particular country or historical period, or a set of clothes worn by an actor for a particular role.

words.tr: n. 优惠券；息票；配给券
words.ex: He used a coupon to buy milk at half price.
words.ex_cn: 他用一张优惠券以半价买了牛奶。
words.en: A coupon is a piece of printed paper that allows you to pay less money than usual for a product, or to get it free.

words.ex: She served a delicious homemade custard.
words.ex_cn: 她端上了一道美味的自制蛋奶糊。
words.en: A sweet dessert or sauce made with milk, eggs, and sugar, often flavored with vanilla or other flavorings.

words.ex: He put up new decor for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对布置了新的装饰。
words.en: The style of decoration and furnishing of a room or building.

words.tr: n. 粗斜纹棉布；劳动布；牛仔布
words.ex: He wears blue denim jeans every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿蓝色牛仔裤。
words.en: Denim is a kind of cotton fabric, typically blue, used for making jeans, jackets, and other clothing.

words.ex: The derby is held every spring at the local racetrack.
words.ex_cn: 德比马术比赛每年春天在本地赛马场举行。
words.en: A derby is a type of hat, a horse race, or a match between two rival teams from the same area.

words.tr: v. 吞食；吞噬；狼吞虎咽地吃；如饥似渴地看
words.ex: The dog devoured the meat quickly.
words.ex_cn: 狗很快地把肉吃光了。
words.en: To eat something quickly and eagerly, especially because you are very hungry; to destroy something quickly and completely.

words.ex: The boys are playing dice after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后玩掷骰游戏。
words.en: Small cubes marked on each side with spots numbering from one to six, used in games of chance; to cut food into small cubes.

words.ex: He follows a dietary plan to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他遵循一种饮食计划来保持健康。
words.en: Relating to the diet or the kinds of food that a person, animal, or community habitually eats.

words.tr: n. 饮食学家；营养学家
words.ex: The dietitian gave her healthy meal plans.
words.ex_cn: 营养师给了她健康的饮食计划。
words.en: A dietitian is a person who is qualified to advise people on what to eat in order to be healthy.

words.tr: n. 半吊子；浅薄涉猎者；
words.ex: He is a dilettante who likes painting but never practices.
words.ex_cn: 他是个半吊子，喜欢画画但从不练习。
words.en: A dilettante is someone who studies or does something, but is not serious about it and does not have much knowledge.

words.ex: The loud music was a diversion from his worries.
words.ex_cn: 那嘈杂的音乐分散了他对烦恼的注意力。
words.en: A diversion is an action or event that attracts your attention away from what you are doing or should be doing.

words.tr: n. （软食或黏食的）一团；一勺；一块
words.ex: He added a dollop of cream to his coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他往咖啡里加了一勺奶油。
words.en: A dollop of soft or semi-liquid food is a large spoonful of it.

words.tr:
n. 滴落；油滴
v. 滴落；“drip”的现在分词
adj. 湿淋淋的
words.ex: The dripping from the faucet woke me up.
words.ex_cn: 水龙头的滴落声把我吵醒了。
words.en: The act or sound of liquid falling in drops.

words.tr:
v. 流口水；垂涎；胡说
n. 口水；胡话
words.ex: The dog drools when it sees food.
words.ex_cn: 狗看到食物时会流口水。
words.en: If someone drools, saliva drops slowly from their mouth, often because they are thinking about food or are asleep.

words.tr: adj. 有趣的；使人愉快的； v. 款待；“entertain”的现在分词；
words.ex: The clown gave an entertaining show.
words.ex_cn: 小丑表演了一场有趣的节目。
words.en: Providing amusement or enjoyment.

words.tr: n. 时尚；一时流行的狂热
words.ex: Wearing those shoes is just a fad.
words.ex_cn: 穿那双鞋只是个短暂的潮流。
words.en: A fad is an activity or topic of interest that is very popular for a short time.

words.ex: The children laughed as they rode the carousel at the fairground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在游乐场上坐旋转木马时笑了。
words.en: A fairground is an open space where fairs, circuses, or exhibitions are held.

words.ex: The golfer aimed for the center of the fairway.
words.ex_cn: 高尔夫球手瞄准了球道的中心。
words.en: In golf, the fairway is the part of the course that leads directly from the tee to the green, kept mowed and free of rough.

words.ex: The trial was a farce.
words.ex_cn: 这场审判是一场闹剧。
words.en: A farce is a comedy that aims at entertaining the audience through situations that are highly exaggerated, extravagant, and thus improbable.

words.ex: The town was alive with festivity during the carnival.
words.ex_cn: 狂欢节期间，小镇充满了喜庆的气氛。
words.en: Festivity refers to the celebration of something in a joyful and exuberant manner.

words.tr:
n. 花彩
v. 以花彩装饰
words.ex: The streets were festooned with colorful banners for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 街道因节日而挂满了五彩缤纷的横幅。
words.en: To decorate something with flowers, leaves, or chains in a way that hangs down in curves.

words.tr:
n. 游园会；庆祝；盛大节日
v. 宴请；招待
words.ex: The town held a fete to raise money for the school.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇举办了一场集市来为学校筹款。
words.en: A fete is an outdoor event with stalls, games, and entertainments, often organized to raise money for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
n. 去骨鱼片；无骨肉片
v. 剔除（鱼或肉）的骨头
words.ex: He cooked a fish fillet for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他为晚餐烹制了一块鱼排。
words.en: A fillet is a piece of meat or fish that has no bones in it.

words.ex: She wore finery to the royal ball.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着华丽的服装去参加皇家舞会。
words.en: Finery refers to elaborate or showy attire and decorations.

words.ex: He uses a flashlight to find his keys in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他用手电筒在黑暗中找钥匙。
words.en: A flashlight is a small portable electric light that is powered by batteries and typically has a handle for holding.

words.tr: n. 调味品；调料； v. “flavor”的现在分词；
words.ex: She added vanilla flavoring to the cake.
words.ex_cn: 她给蛋糕加了香草调味品。
words.en: A substance used to give a particular taste to food or drink.

words.tr: n. 调味品；调料； v. “flavour”的现在分词；
words.ex: She added a little flavouring to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她给汤里加了一点调味品。
words.en: A substance used to give a particular taste to food or drink.

words.ex: The machine uses a flywheel to store energy.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器使用飞轮来储存能量。
words.en: A flywheel is a heavy wheel in a machine that helps the machine to work at a steady speed by storing kinetic energy.

words.ex: The movie provided a foretaste of what the sequel might bring.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影预示了续集可能会带来的内容。
words.en: A foretaste is a small experience of something before it happens, which makes you want to experience it more.

words.ex: He laughed at the silly joke, but she saw it as mere frivolity.
words.ex_cn: 他笑了那个愚蠢的笑话，但她认为那只是轻浮。
words.en: If you refer to an activity as frivolity, you think that it is useful and silly rather than serious and sensible.

words.ex: She wore a long frock to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条长连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A frock is a dress, especially one that is worn by women or girls.

words.tr:
n. 乳脂软糖；胡言
v. 敷衍；回避；捏造
words.ex: She made a fudge cake for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为聚会做了一个乳脂软糖蛋糕。
words.en: If you fudge something, you avoid making a clear and definite decision, distinction, or statement about it.

words.ex: The doctor put a gag in his mouth to keep it open.
words.ex_cn: 医生在他的嘴里放了一个塞口物以保持口腔张开。
words.en: A gag is something such as a piece of cloth that is tied around or put inside someone's mouth in order to stop them from speaking or shouting. It can also refer to a joke or a prank.

words.ex: The village held a gala to celebrate the harvest.
words.ex_cn: 村庄举办了一个节日来庆祝丰收。
words.en: A gala is a special public celebration, entertainment, performance, or festival.

words.ex: She bought a new garment for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件新衣服。
words.en: A garment is a piece of clothing; used especially in contexts where you are talking about the manufacture or sale of clothes.

words.ex: He is a glutton who eats too much candy.
words.ex_cn: 他是个贪吃糖的暴食者。
words.en: A glutton is a person who eats and drinks excessively or voraciously.

words.tr:
n. 甜食；好东西；佳品
int. （儿语）好哇
words.ex: The children love eating goody after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在晚饭后吃甜食。
words.en: A goody is something that is pleasant or attractive, especially something nice to eat.

words.ex: The hikers walked through a deep gorge.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者走过一个深峡谷。
words.en: A gorge is a deep, narrow valley with steep sides, often carved by a river. It can also refer to the act of eating greedily.

words.tr: adj. 煮过熟了的；不动感情的
words.ex: He ate a hard-boiled egg for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个煮熟的鸡蛋。
words.en: Hard-boiled refers to eggs that have been cooked until both the white and yolk are solid, or it can describe a person who is tough and unsentimental.

words.tr:
n. 骗局；恶作剧；戏弄
v. 愚弄
words.ex: The news was a hoax to scare people.
words.ex_cn: 这则新闻是个骗局，为了吓唬人。
words.en: A hoax is a plan to deceive someone, such as telling the police there is a bomb somewhere when there is not, or a trick in which someone tells people a lie.

words.tr: n. 玩具木马；爱反复讲的话题
words.ex: He keeps talking about his hobbyhorse, tax reform.
words.ex_cn: 他不停地谈论他的老话题——税收改革。
words.en: A hobbyhorse is a subject or idea that someone talks about a lot or is very interested in, often to the point of obsession.

words.ex: She bought new hosiery for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了新的袜子。
words.en: Hosiery refers to stockings, socks, and tights collectively, especially those made of knitted fabric.

words.tr: n. 火锅；热锅炖菜；罐焖菜肴
words.ex: We had hotpot for dinner last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚我们晚餐吃了罐焖土豆烧肉。
words.en: A hotpot is a dish that is cooked and served in a pot at the table, typically containing a variety of meats, vegetables, and sometimes noodles or tofu, cooked in a simmering pot of stock at the table.

words.tr: n. 居家女式便服；（女式）家居袍
words.ex: She wears a housecoat while cleaning the house.
words.ex_cn: 她打扫房子时穿一件家居袍。
words.en: A housecoat is a long, loose piece of clothing that you wear at home, especially over your nightclothes.

words.tr: n. 新屋落成宴；乔迁庆宴
words.ex: They had a housewarming party last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周末举办了乔迁派对。
words.en: A housewarming is a party that is held to celebrate moving into a new home.

words.ex: He buys groceries at the hypermarket every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都在超级市场买杂货。
words.en: A hypermarket is a very large supermarket that sells a wide range of products, often including groceries, clothing, and household goods, under one roof.

words.tr:
n. 糖衣；糖霜
v. （使）结冰；“ice”的现在分词
words.ex: The cake has a thin layer of icing on top.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕顶部有一层薄薄的糖衣。
words.en: Icing is a sweet mixture made from sugar and water or milk, which is used to cover or fill cakes.

words.tr: adj. 淡而无味的；枯燥乏味的
words.ex: The soup was insipid and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这汤淡而无味，很无聊。
words.en: If you describe food or drink as insipid, you mean that it is very weak, tasteless, or uninteresting.

words.tr: n. 间歇；插曲；幕间节目
words.ex: He took an interlude to drink water.
words.ex_cn: 他休息了一下喝水。
words.en: An interlude is a short period of time that comes in the middle of something, or a short piece of music, talk, or entertainment that comes between the main parts of a performance or event.

words.tr:
adj. 醉人的
n. 酒精饮料；致醉药物
words.ex: Alcohol is a common intoxicant.
words.ex_cn: 酒精是一种常见的致醉物。
words.en: An intoxicant is a substance that can cause intoxication, such as alcohol or drugs.

words.tr: v.  使中毒；使醉；使 ...陶醉
words.ex: The dirty water can intoxicate animals.
words.ex_cn: 脏水会使动物中毒。
words.en: To intoxicate someone means to make them lose control of their actions or behavior because they have drunk alcohol or taken drugs. It can also mean to make someone feel very excited and happy.

words.ex: The child laughed when the jack-in-the-box popped out.
words.ex_cn: 当玩偶从盒子里弹出来时，孩子笑了。
words.en: A toy consisting of a box from which a figure on a spring jumps up when the lid is opened.

words.ex: He used a jigsaw to cut the wooden board.
words.ex_cn: 他用竖锯切割木板。
words.en: A jigsaw is a machine with a fine blade used for cutting shapes in wood or metal. It is also a puzzle consisting of a picture printed on cardboard or wood and cut into various pieces of different shapes that have to be fitted together.

words.tr: n. 拉格啤酒；贮藏啤酒
words.ex: He drinks lager at the pub.
words.ex_cn: 他在酒吧喝拉格啤酒。
words.en: A type of beer that is stored at a low temperature for a period of time to allow it to mature and develop its flavor.

words.ex: He cut a piece of meat from the loin.
words.ex_cn: 他从腰肉部分切了一块肉。
words.en: The part of the body on both sides of the spine between the lowest ribs and the hip bones; the meat from this part of an animal.

words.ex: She puts lotion on her hands after washing them.
words.ex_cn: 她洗手后在手上涂乳液。
words.en: A lotion is a liquid that you use to clean, improve, or protect your skin or hair.

words.ex: She served macaroni with a rich tomato sauce.
words.ex_cn: 她端上了配有浓郁番茄酱的通心粉。
words.en: Macaroni is a type of pasta in the form of narrow tubes.

words.tr: adj. 奇妙的；魔术的；有魔力的；
words.ex: The magical night lit up the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 奇妙的夜晚照亮了整个村庄。
words.en: Something that is magical seems to use magic or to be full of magic.

words.ex: The mantle lies below the Earth's crust.
words.ex_cn: 地幔位于地球地壳之下。
words.en: The mantle is the part of the earth between the crust and the core. It can also refer to a cloak or covering.

words.ex: We went to the matinee on Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周六去看午场电影。
words.en: A matinee is a performance of a play or a showing of a movie which takes place in the afternoon.

words.ex: The children were excited to ride the merry-go-round.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们对乘坐旋转木马感到兴奋。
words.en: A merry-go-round is a large machine at a fair that turns round and has wooden or plastic animals or vehicles on which children ride.

words.tr: n. 不适合的东西；不适应环境的人
words.ex: That old chair is a misfit in the new room.
words.ex_cn: 那把旧椅子在这个新房间里格格不入。
words.en: A misfit is a person who is not suited to a situation or who does not fit in well with the other people in a group.

words.tr:
n. 鲜奶油慕思；定型摩丝
v. 给…涂上摩丝
words.ex: She applied mousse to her hair to keep it styled.
words.ex_cn: 她在头发上抹了摩丝以保持造型。
words.en: A light, fluffy dessert made from cream and egg whites, often flavored with chocolate or fruit.

words.ex: She baked a batch of blueberry muffins.
words.ex_cn: 她烤了一盘蓝莓玛芬。
words.en: A muffin is a small, round, sweet cake, usually with fruit or nuts in it.

words.ex: Bees collect nectar from flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂从花朵中采集花蜜。
words.en: A sweet liquid secreted by flowers and collected by bees for making honey.

words.ex: The sign glows with bright neon light.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志发出明亮的霓虹光。
words.en: A colourless, odourless inert gaseous element occurring in minute amounts in the earth's atmosphere, used in fluorescent lights and illuminated advertising signs.

words.tr:
v. 轻咬；啃；一点点地吃
n. 一小口；轻咬；少量
words.ex: The dog nibble the biscuit slowly.
words.ex_cn: 狗慢慢地轻咬着饼干。
words.en: To nibble means to take small bites of something, especially food.

words.ex: He made an omelette for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他为早餐做了一个煎蛋卷。
words.en: An omelette is a dish made by beating eggs and cooking them in a frying pan, often with other ingredients such as cheese, vegetables, or meat.

words.ex: The party turned into an orgy of drinking and dancing.
words.ex_cn: 派对变成了饮酒跳舞的狂欢。
words.en: An orgy is a wild party or gathering where people behave in an unrestrained way, often involving excessive drinking, eating, or sexual activity.

words.tr: n. 露天历史剧；盛装游行（或庆典）；选美比赛
words.ex: The town held a pageant to show the history of the old kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇举办了一场露天历史剧，以展示古老王国的历史。
words.en: A pageant is a public entertainment consisting of a procession of people in elaborate, colorful costumes, or an outdoor performance of a historical scene.

words.ex: He ate a pancake for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一块煎饼。
words.en: A pancake is a thin, flat, round cake prepared from a batter and cooked on a hot griddle or frying pan.

words.ex: He saw a beautiful panorama from the mountain top.
words.ex_cn: 他从山顶看到了美丽的全景。
words.en: A panorama is a view of a wide area, or a description or study that presents all the different parts or aspects of a particular subject.

words.ex: The view from the hill is panoramic.
words.ex_cn: 从山上望去，景色一览无余。
words.en: A panoramic view or picture is one that shows a wide area of land or sea.

words.tr:
n. 拙劣的模仿（作品）
v. 拙劣模仿
words.ex: The film is a parody of classic horror movies.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是对经典恐怖电影的滑稽模仿。
words.en: A parody is a humorous or satirical imitation of a serious piece of literature or writing.

words.ex: He eats pasta for dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上吃意大利面。
words.en: Pasta is a type of food made from a mixture of flour, eggs, and water that is formed into different shapes and then boiled.

words.ex: The company's payout this month was very high.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司这个月的支出非常高。
words.en: A payout is a sum of money that is paid to someone, for example by an insurance company or as a prize.

words.tr:
n. 果皮；
v. 去皮；剥落；
words.ex: The apple peel is rich in fiber.
words.ex_cn: 苹果皮富含纤维。
words.en: To remove the outer covering from something, especially a fruit or vegetable.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
