v. 打嗝
words.ex: He tried to stop his hiccough by holding his breath.
words.ex_cn: 他试图通过屏住呼吸来止住打嗝。
words.en: A hiccough is a sudden, involuntary contraction of the diaphragm that occurs repeatedly at intervals of a few seconds, often causing a characteristic sound.

words.tr: abbr. 人体免疫缺损病毒；艾滋病病毒；
words.ex: He tested positive for HIV last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年检测出人体免疫缺损病毒阳性。
words.en: HIV is the virus that causes AIDS by attacking the body's immune system.

words.ex: He uses homeopathy to treat his cold.
words.ex_cn: 他用顺势疗法治疗感冒。
words.en: Homeopathy is a system of alternative medicine created in 1796 by Samuel Hahnemann, based on his doctrine of like cures like, a claim that a substance that causes the symptoms of a disease in healthy people would cure similar symptoms in sick people.

words.ex: Hormones control growth and mood in the body.
words.ex_cn: 荷尔蒙控制身体的生长和情绪。
words.en: A hormone is a chemical substance produced in the body that controls and regulates the activity of certain cells or organs.

words.tr: n. （教会办的）旅客招待所；临终关怀医院；临终安养院
words.ex: He spent his last days in a hospice.
words.ex_cn: 他最后的日子是在临终关怀机构度过的。
words.en: A hospice is a special hospital or home for people who are dying, where they are cared for by specially trained nurses and doctors.

words.tr: adj. 不能外出的；不能离家的
words.ex: He is housebound because of his illness.
words.ex_cn: 他因病而足不出户。
words.en: If someone is housebound, they are unable to go out of their house, often because they are ill or have a disability.

words.ex: He has hypertension and takes medicine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他有高血压，每天吃药。
words.en: Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the artery walls is too high.

words.ex: He entered a deep hypnosis during the therapy.
words.ex_cn: 他在治疗过程中进入了深度催眠状态。
words.en: Hypnosis is a state in which a person seems to be asleep but can still see, hear, or respond to things said to them.

words.tr: adj. 催眠的；引起睡眠的；
words.ex: The soft music had a hypnotic effect.
words.ex_cn: 柔和的音乐有催眠效果。
words.en: Something that is hypnotic holds your attention or makes you feel very relaxed, often in a way that is similar to being hypnotized.

words.ex: He uses hypnotism to help people relax.
words.ex_cn: 他使用催眠术帮助人们放松。
words.en: Hypnotism is the practice of hypnotizing people.

words.tr:
adj. 皮下注射的；皮下的
n. 皮下注射；皮下注射器
words.ex: The nurse used a hypodermic needle to give him a shot.
words.ex_cn: 护士用皮下注射针给他打了一针。
words.en: A hypodermic needle or syringe is a medical instrument with a hollow needle used to inject substances into the body or extract fluids from it.

words.tr: n. 无效；虚弱；无能为力；阳萎
words.ex: The new policy showed impotence in solving the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策在解决问题上显得无效。
words.en: The condition of being unable to take effective action; helplessness.

words.ex: The hen incubate eggs until they hatch.
words.ex_cn: 母鸡孵化鸡蛋直到小鸡孵出。
words.en: to keep eggs warm so that they develop and hatch, or to keep cells, bacteria, etc. at a suitable temperature so that they develop

words.ex: The incubation of eggs takes about 21 days.
words.ex_cn: 鸡蛋的孵化需要大约21天。
words.en: The process of keeping eggs at the right temperature so that they develop and hatch, or the period of time that a disease takes to develop before symptoms appear.

words.tr: n. 孵卵器；育婴箱；培养的器具
words.ex: The eggs are kept in an incubator to hatch.
words.ex_cn: 鸡蛋放在孵卵器里孵化。
words.en: An incubator is a piece of hospital equipment which helps weak or small babies to survive. It consists of a transparent container in which the oxygen supply, temperature, and humidity can be controlled.

words.ex: The child showed signs of talent in infancy.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在婴儿期就表现出天赋。
words.en: The earliest period of childhood, especially before the ability to walk has been acquired.

words.ex: The student went to the infirmary after falling off the bike.
words.ex_cn: 学生骑自行车摔了之后去了医院。
words.en: A place where sick or injured people receive care and treatment, especially in a school, college, or other institution.

words.tr:
adj. 发炎的；红肿的
v. 激怒；加剧；发炎；“inflame”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: His skin is inflamed after the bug bite.
words.ex_cn: 他被虫子叮咬后皮肤发炎了。
words.en: If part of your body is inflamed, it is red or swollen, usually as a result of an infection, injury, or illness.

words.tr: n. 发炎；炎症；燃烧；激动
words.ex: The redness and swelling show inflammation.
words.ex_cn: 发红和肿胀表明有炎症。
words.en: Inflammation is a condition in which a part of your body becomes red, swollen, and painful as a reaction to infection or injury.

words.ex: He has insomnia and cannot sleep at night.
words.ex_cn: 他有失眠症，晚上睡不着。
words.en: If someone suffers from insomnia, they find it difficult to sleep.

words.tr:
n. 失眠患者
adj. 患失眠症的
words.ex: He is an insomniac and sleeps very little at night.
words.ex_cn: 他是个失眠者，晚上睡得很晚。
words.en: An insomniac is a person who is regularly unable to sleep.

words.ex: The doctor checked his intestinal health.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的肠道健康。
words.en: Relating to or affecting the intestines.

words.ex: He kneads dough every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上揉面团。
words.en: To knead is to press and stretch dough or another substance with your hands in order to make it smooth and ready to use.

words.ex: He has laryngitis and cannot speak loudly.
words.ex_cn: 他得了喉炎，不能大声说话。
words.en: Laryngitis is an inflammation of the larynx, typically resulting in huskiness or loss of the voice, harsh breathing, and a painful cough.

words.ex: The larynx helps us speak and breathe.
words.ex_cn: 喉部帮助我们说话和呼吸。
words.en: The part of the throat that contains the vocal cords and is used for breathing, swallowing, and speaking.

words.ex: The latent talent in the child became clear after years of practice.
words.ex_cn: 孩子潜在的才能在多年练习后显现出来。
words.en: Latent is used to describe something which is hidden and not obvious at the moment, but which may develop further in the future.

words.ex: The camera has a clear lens.
words.ex_cn: 这台相机有一个清晰的透镜。
words.en: A lens is a piece of curved glass or other transparent substance that is used in things such as cameras, telescopes, or pairs of glasses to make images larger or smaller.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with leprosy last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有麻风病。
words.en: Leprosy is a chronic infectious disease caused by the bacterium Mycobacterium leprae, which primarily affects the skin, the peripheral nerves, mucosal surfaces of the upper respiratory tract, and the eyes.

words.ex: He has leukemia and takes medicine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他患有白血病，每天吃药。
words.en: Leukemia is a type of cancer that affects the blood and bone marrow, characterized by an abnormal increase in white blood cells.

words.ex: He hurt his ligament while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时拉伤了韧带。
words.en: A ligament is a band of strong tissue in a person's body which connects bones.

words.ex: The doctor examined the left lobe of the lung.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了左肺叶。
words.en: A lobe is a rounded projection or division, especially a part of the brain, lung, or liver, that is separated from the rest by a fissure.

words.ex: He ate a lump of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块糖。
words.en: A lump is a solid piece of something, often with no particular shape. If you lump things together, you put them together in a group or treat them as the same.

words.tr: n. 精神失常；疯狂；极蠢
words.ex: His idea to jump from the roof was pure lunacy.
words.ex_cn: 他从屋顶跳下去的主意简直是疯了。
words.en: Lunacy is behavior that is stupid, dangerous, or insane.

words.ex: He got malaria from a mosquito bite.
words.ex_cn: 他被蚊子叮咬后得了疟疾。
words.en: Malaria is a disease caused by a parasite that is transmitted to humans through the bites of infected mosquitoes.

words.ex: The baby was born with a malformed hand.
words.ex_cn: 这个婴儿出生时手部畸形。
words.en: A malformed object or part of the body is not the correct shape or size because it has developed wrongly.

words.ex: The doctor said the tumor is a malignancy.
words.ex_cn: 医生说这个肿瘤是恶性肿瘤。
words.en: Malignancy refers to the presence of cancerous cells that can invade and destroy nearby tissue and spread to other parts of the body.

words.ex: The child has malnutrition from not eating enough food.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子因为吃不够饭而营养不良。
words.en: Malnutrition is a condition that results from eating a diet in which certain nutrients are lacking, in excess (too high in intake), or in the wrong proportions.

words.ex: He had measles when he was five.
words.ex_cn: 他五岁时得了麻疹。
words.en: An infectious disease that causes fever and small red spots on the skin.

words.ex: Meningitis can be a life-threatening condition if not treated promptly.
words.ex_cn: 如果不及时治疗，脑膜炎可能会危及生命。
words.en: Meningitis is a serious illness in which there is inflammation of the meninges, the membranes covering the brain and spinal cord, usually caused by infection.

words.ex: She is going through menopause at age 52.
words.ex_cn: 她在52岁时经历更年期。
words.en: The time in a woman's life when she stops menstruating, typically between the ages of 45 and 55.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed medication to alleviate her menstrual cramps.
words.ex_cn: 医生开了药来缓解她的月经疼痛。
words.en: Relating to the menstruation or the monthly discharge of blood and mucosal tissue from the inner lining of the uterus through the vagina.

words.tr: v. 施以催眠术；迷住；迷惑
words.ex: The dancer mesmerized the crowd with her slow movements.
words.ex_cn: 舞者用她缓慢的动作对观众施以催眠术。
words.en: If you are mesmerized by something, you are so interested in it or so attracted to it that you cannot think about anything else.

words.ex: He has a migraine every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一都偏头痛。
words.en: A migraine is a severe, often painful headache that can be accompanied by nausea, vomiting, and sensitivity to light and sound.

words.ex: The doctor gave him morphine for the pain.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他吗啡来止痛。
words.en: A powerful drug that is used to relieve severe pain, especially after surgery or in terminal illness.

words.ex: He had mumps last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周得了腮腺炎。
words.en: Mumps is a contagious disease that causes swelling of the salivary glands and can lead to more serious complications.

words.ex: He strengthened his muscle by lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他通过举重来增强肌肉。
words.en: Muscle is the tissue in the body that can contract to produce movement or maintain the position of parts of the body.

words.tr: adj. 肌肉的；肌肉发达的；
words.ex: He has a muscular arm from lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他因为举重而拥有强壮的手臂。
words.en: Relating to or affecting the muscles; having well-developed muscles.

words.ex: The smell of the food made her feel nausea.
words.ex_cn: 食物的气味让她感到恶心。
words.en: A feeling of sickness with an inclination to vomit.

words.ex: The baby has a small navel.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿有一个小肚脐。
words.en: The small hollow or depression in the center of a person's belly where the umbilical cord was attached at birth.

words.tr: adj. 神经（病）学的；神经系统的；
words.ex: The doctor checked for neurological damage after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，医生检查是否有神经学方面的损伤。
words.en: Relating to the anatomy, functions, and organic disorders of nerves and the nervous system.

words.ex: He quit smoking to avoid nicotine.
words.ex_cn: 他戒烟以避免尼古丁。
words.en: Nicotine is a toxic colorless or yellowish oily liquid that is the chief active constituent of tobacco. It acts as a stimulant in small doses, but in larger amounts blocks the action of autonomic nerve and skeletal muscle cells.

words.ex: The node is connected to two wires.
words.ex_cn: 这个节点连接着两根电线。
words.en: A node is a point at which lines or pathways intersect or branch; a central or connecting point.

words.ex: Milk provides good nourishment for children.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶为儿童提供良好的滋养品。
words.en: Nourishment refers to the food or other substances necessary for growth, health, and good condition.

words.ex: Eating fruits and vegetables is nutritious.
words.ex_cn: 吃水果和蔬菜是有营养的。
words.en: Nutritious food contains substances which help your body to be healthy.

words.ex: He put ointment on his cut.
words.ex_cn: 他把药膏涂在伤口上。
words.en: A smooth substance that is rubbed on the skin to heal wounds or soothe pain.

words.ex: The heart is an important organ in the body.
words.ex_cn: 心脏是身体中重要的器官。
words.en: An organ is a part of an organism that is typically self-contained and has a specific vital function, such as the heart or liver in humans.

words.ex: She felt a sudden wave of pleasure and reached orgasm.
words.ex_cn: 她感到一阵突如其来的快感，达到了高潮。
words.en: An orgasm is the moment of greatest pleasure and excitement during sexual activity.

words.tr:
n. 服药过量；嗑药过量；过量
v. （使）服药过量；过量…
words.ex: He took an overdose of pills and went to hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他服用了过量的药片，被送到了医院。
words.en: An overdose is the taking of too much of a drug, which can cause serious harm or death.

words.ex: He is overweight because he eats too much junk food.
words.ex_cn: 他超重是因为吃太多垃圾食品。
words.en: If someone is overweight, they weigh more than is considered healthy or attractive.

words.tr: n. 上腭；味觉；审美眼光；嗜好；爱好
words.ex: The roof of the mouth is called the palate.
words.ex_cn: 口腔的顶部被称为上腭。
words.en: The palate refers to the roof of the mouth in humans and other mammals, separating the oral cavity from the nasal cavity. It also refers to a person's ability to distinguish between and appreciate different flavors.

words.ex: The boy learned about the penis in science class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在科学课上学习了阴茎。
words.en: The male organ of copulation in higher vertebrates, carrying the duct for the transfer of sperm during copulation.

words.tr:
adj. 制药的；配药的；
n. 药物；
words.ex: He works at a pharmaceutical company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家制药公司工作。
words.en: relating to the production and sale of medicinal drugs

words.ex: He works at a small pharmacy near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一家小药房工作。
words.en: A pharmacy is a shop or a department in a shop where medicines are prepared and sold.

words.ex: He goes to physiotherapy after his surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他手术后去做物理治疗。
words.en: Physiotherapy is the treatment of disease, injury, or deformity by physical methods such as massage, heat treatment, and exercise rather than by drugs or surgery.

words.ex: He has a strong physique from lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他因为举重而拥有强健的体格。
words.en: The form, size, and development of a person's body.

words.ex: The doctor tested his plasma for antibodies.
words.ex_cn: 医生检测了他的血浆中的抗体。
words.en: Plasma is the clear, straw-colored liquid portion of blood that remains after red blood cells, white blood cells, platelets and other cellular components are removed. It is the single largest component of human blood, comprising about 55 percent, and contains water, salts, enzymes, antibodies and other proteins.

words.tr:
n. 痘疱；痘痕；麻点
v. 使有麻点
words.ex: The wall was covered with pockmarks from the bullets.
words.ex_cn: 墙上布满了子弹留下的麻点。
words.en: A pockmark is a small hollow on the skin, especially one left by a spot or pimple.

words.tr: n. 脊髓灰质炎；小儿麻痹症；
words.ex: Children must get vaccinated to prevent polio.
words.ex_cn: 儿童必须接种疫苗以预防脊髓灰质炎。
words.en: Polio, also known as poliomyelitis, is a highly infectious viral disease that mainly affects young children. The virus is transmitted by person-to-person spread mainly through the fecal-oral route or, less frequently, by a common vehicle (e.g., contaminated water or food) and multiplies in the intestine, from where it can invade the nervous system and can cause paralysis.

words.ex: She is pregnant and will have a baby next month.
words.ex_cn: 她怀孕了，下个月就要生宝宝了。
words.en: Having a baby developing in the uterus.

words.ex: Prenatal care is crucial for the health of both the mother and the baby.
words.ex_cn: 产前护理对母亲和婴儿的健康至关重要。
words.en: Prenatal means relating to the medical care given to pregnant women before their babies are born.

words.ex: The doctor wrote a prescription for medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生开了一张药方。
words.en: A prescription is a written order from a physician for the preparation and administration of a drug or device for a patient.

words.ex: He visited the doctor for a prostate check.
words.ex_cn: 他去看医生做前列腺检查。
words.en: The prostate is a gland in the male reproductive system that is located just below the bladder and in front of the rectum. It surrounds the urethra, the tube through which urine and semen exit the body.

words.tr: n. 精神病学家；精神科医生
words.ex: He visits a psychiatrist every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周去看一次精神科医生。
words.en: A psychiatrist is a medical doctor who specializes in the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of mental illnesses and emotional disorders.

words.ex: He wants to study psychiatry after medical school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在医学院毕业后学习精神病学。
words.en: Psychiatry is the branch of medicine concerned with the study, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of mental illness.

words.tr:
n. 精神病患者
adj. 发疯的；不正常的
words.ex: He was acting like a total psycho.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为完全像个疯子。
words.en: A psycho is a person who is mentally ill and who behaves in a very strange or violent way.

words.tr: n. 精神分析学家；心理分析学者（或医生）
words.ex: The psychoanalyst helped her understand the root causes of her anxiety.
words.ex_cn: 这位精神分析学家帮助她理解了焦虑的根源。
words.en: A psychoanalyst is a person who treats mental illness by investigating the unconscious mind and the conscious mind's relation to it.

words.tr: n. 精神治疗医师；心理治疗师
words.ex: The psychotherapist helps people feel better.
words.ex_cn: 心理治疗师帮助人们感觉更好。
words.en: A psychotherapist is a person who treats mental illness by using psychological methods rather than medical means.

words.tr: n. 心理疗法；精神疗法；
words.ex: He goes to psychotherapy every week to feel better.
words.ex_cn: 他每周去接受心理疗法以感觉更好。
words.en: Psychotherapy is the treatment of mental illness by discussing someone's problems with them, rather than giving them drugs.

words.ex: He entered puberty at age 12.
words.ex_cn: 他12岁时进入青春期。
words.en: Puberty is the stage in a person's life when they physically develop from a child into an adult.

words.ex: The doctor checked his pulse with his fingers.
words.ex_cn: 医生用手指检查了他的脉搏。
words.en: A pulse is the regular beating of the heart, especially when it is felt at the wrist or neck. It can also refer to a single vibration or short burst of sound, electric current, light, etc.

words.tr:
n. 嘎嘎叫声；庸医；冒充内行的人
v. 嘎嘎地叫；大声闲谈；冒充内行
words.ex: The duck made a loud quack.
words.ex_cn: 鸭子发出了响亮的嘎嘎叫声。
words.en: A quack is someone who pretends to have medical skills that they do not really possess. It can also refer to the sound a duck makes.

words.tr: adj. 患狂犬病的；狂暴的；疯狂的
words.ex: The rabid dog ran wildly through the street.
words.ex_cn: 那只狂犬在街上狂奔。
words.en: If you describe someone as rabid, you mean that they have very strong and unreasonable opinions or beliefs about a subject, especially in politics.

words.ex: The dog has rabies.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗得了狂犬病。
words.en: Rabies is a serious disease that affects the brain and nerves, usually caught from the bite of an infected animal.

words.ex: He took a remedial math course to improve his skills.
words.ex_cn: 他上了一门补救数学课程来提高自己的技能。
words.en: Remedial actions or activities are intended to correct something that is wrong or to improve a bad situation.

words.ex: Breathing deeply helps with respiration.
words.ex_cn: 深呼吸有助于呼吸。
words.en: The process of breathing, which involves inhaling oxygen and exhaling carbon dioxide.

words.ex: The city plan will revitalize the old town.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市计划将使老城区复兴。
words.en: To revitalize something means to give it new life or energy.

words.tr: n. 板球; 蟋蟀( cricket的名词复数 )
words.ex: He plays crickets every weekend with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都和朋友打板球。
words.en: Crickets are insects related to grasshoppers and katydids, known for their chirping sound. The term can also refer to the sport of cricket.

words.tr: n. 玫瑰花结；玫瑰花饰；玫瑰花形徽章；
words.ex: She wore a rosette on her dress.
words.ex_cn: 她衣服上戴着一个玫瑰花结。
words.en: A rosette is a decoration or design that looks like a rose, often made of ribbon or carved in stone.

words.tr: adj. 唾液的；产生唾液的
words.ex: The salivary glands produce saliva.
words.ex_cn: 唾腺分泌唾液。
words.en: Relating to or producing saliva.

words.tr: v. 分泌唾液；垂涎；过量分泌唾液；
words.ex: The smell of food makes dogs salivate.
words.ex_cn: 食物的气味让狗分泌唾液。
words.en: If you salivate, you produce a lot of saliva in your mouth, often because you see or smell food that you would like to eat.

words.tr:
adj. 灰黄的；蜡黄的
n. 黄华柳；阔叶柳
v. （使）成灰黄色
words.ex: His face looks sallow after the long illness.
words.ex_cn: 他久病之后脸色发黄。
words.en: If someone is sallow, their skin, especially on their face, is a pale-yellowish color and looks unhealthy.

words.tr: n. 心智健全；神志清楚；神智健全
words.ex: The doctors questioned his sanity after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，医生们质疑他的精神是否健全。
words.en: The condition of having a healthy mind and not being mentally ill.

words.tr:
n. 痂；疥癣；拒罢工的工人
v. 结疤；当工贼
words.ex: The wound healed and a scab formed.
words.ex_cn: 伤口愈合了，结了痂。
words.en: A scab is a hard, dry covering that forms over a wound or sore as it heals. It can also refer to a person who continues working while others are on strike, often viewed negatively by the strikers.

words.ex: The doctor uses a scalpel to cut the skin.
words.ex_cn: 医生用手术刀切开皮肤。
words.en: A scalpel is a small, extremely sharp knife used for surgery, anatomical dissection, and various arts and crafts.

words.ex: He has schizophrenia and takes medicine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他患有精神分裂症，每天吃药。
words.en: A long-term mental disorder of a type involving a breakdown in the relation between thought, emotion, and behavior, leading to faulty perception, inappropriate actions and feelings, withdrawal from reality and personal relationships into fantasy and delusion, and a sense of mental fragmentation.

words.tr:
adj. 镇静的；镇定的；止痛的
n. 镇静剂；止痛药
words.ex: The doctor gave her a sedative pill to calm her down.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了她一颗镇静药片来让她平静下来。
words.en: A sedative is a drug that calms you down or makes you sleep.

words.tr: n. 血清；（植物分泌的）浆液
words.ex: The doctor tested his serum for bacteria.
words.ex_cn: 医生检测了他的血清是否含有细菌。
words.en: Serum is the liquid part of the blood that remains after the blood has clotted, containing antibodies and other proteins.

words.ex: The injured sailor was taken to the sickbay for treatment.
words.ex_cn: 受伤的水手被带到医务室接受治疗。
words.en: A sickbay is a place on a ship or in the military where medical treatment is given to people who are sick or injured.

words.ex: The skeleton of the dinosaur is displayed in the museum.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙的骨架在博物馆里展出。
words.en: The internal structure that supports and gives shape to a person, animal, or plant, composed of bones and cartilage in vertebrates.

words.ex: The workers cleaned the slurry from the construction site.
words.ex_cn: 工人们清理了建筑工地上的泥浆。
words.en: A slurry is a thin mixture of a liquid, especially water, and any of several finely divided substances, such as cement, plaster of Paris, or clay particles.

words.tr:
n. 喷嚏；喷嚏声
v. 打喷嚏
words.ex: He had a cold and let out a loud sneeze.
words.ex_cn: 他感冒了，打了一个响亮的喷嚏。
words.en: To sneeze is to suddenly expel air from the nose and mouth due to irritation in the nasal passages.

words.tr:
v. 打鼾；打呼噜
n. 打呼噜（声）；打鼾（声）
words.ex: He snores loudly when he sleeps.
words.ex_cn: 他睡觉时打呼噜很响。
words.en: To breathe noisily through your mouth and nose while you are asleep.

words.tr: adj. 痉挛的；间歇的；一阵阵的
words.ex: He had spasmodic coughing at night.
words.ex_cn: 他晚上有阵发性的咳嗽。
words.en: Something that is spasmodic happens suddenly and irregularly, often in short periods of time.

words.tr:
v. 喷出；涌出；呕吐
n. 呕吐物；喷出物
words.ex: The factory spews smoke into the air.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向空气中排放烟雾。
words.en: To spew means to expel something, especially liquid, gas, or small particles, in large quantities and with force. It can also refer to the act of vomiting.

words.ex: He lost his spleen in a car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在一场车祸中失去了脾脏。
words.en: The spleen is an organ involved in the production and removal of blood cells in most vertebrates and forming part of the immune system. It can also refer to feelings of anger or spite.

words.tr: adj. 易恶心的；易受惊的；神经质的；过于拘谨的
words.ex: She was too squeamish to watch the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 她太容易呕吐了，不敢看手术过程。
words.en: If you are squeamish, you are easily upset by unpleasant sights or situations.

words.ex: The lab tested the sterility of the equipment.
words.ex_cn: 实验室检测了设备的无菌性。
words.en: The state of being free from living microorganisms or the inability to produce offspring.

words.ex: He takes steroid to help his muscles grow.
words.ex_cn: 他服用类固醇来帮助肌肉增长。
words.en: A steroid is a type of organic compound that is biologically active and has a characteristic molecular structure containing four rings of carbon atoms.

words.ex: The doctor uses a stethoscope to listen to his heart.
words.ex_cn: 医生用听诊器听他的心跳。
words.en: A stethoscope is an instrument that a doctor uses to listen to someone's heart and breathing. It consists of a small disc that is placed against the chest, and two tubes connected to earpieces.

words.tr:
n. 针脚；缝线；一针
v. 缝；缝合
words.ex: She sews a stitch to fix the tear.
words.ex_cn: 她缝一针来补破洞。
words.en: A stitch is a piece of thread that has been used to sew the edges of a wound together. It can also refer to a loop of thread or yarn resulting from a single pass or movement of the needle in sewing, knitting, or crocheting.

words.ex: He stared in stupefaction at the sudden crash.
words.ex_cn: 他震惊地盯着突如其来的撞击声。
words.en: The state of being stupefied; astonishment.

words.tr: n. 昏迷；不省人事；恍惚
words.ex: He fell into a stupor after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后，他陷入了昏迷状态。
words.en: A state of near-unconsciousness or insensibility.

words.tr:
v. 口吃；结结巴巴地说；缓慢地颠簸前进
n. 口吃；结巴
words.ex: He stutters when he is nervous.
words.ex_cn: 当他紧张时，他会结巴。
words.en: If someone stutters, they have difficulty speaking because they find it hard to say the first sound of a word, and so they often hesitate or repeat that sound several times.

words.ex: He needs surgery for his broken arm.
words.ex_cn: 他需要做手术来治疗断掉的胳膊。
words.en: Surgery is the medical specialty that uses operative manual and instrumental techniques on a patient to investigate or treat a pathological condition such as a disease or injury, to help improve bodily function or appearance, or to repair unwanted ruptured areas.

words.tr: adj. 外科的；外科手术的；
words.ex: The surgical team worked quickly to save the patient.
words.ex_cn: 外科团队迅速工作以挽救病人。
words.en: Relating to or used in surgery.

words.tr: n. 综合征；综合症状；典型表现；
words.ex: He was diagnosed with sleep apnea syndrome.
words.ex_cn: 他被诊断出患有睡眠呼吸暂停综合征。
words.en: A syndrome is a set of medical signs and symptoms which are correlated with each other and often associated with a particular disease or disorder.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with syphilis last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有梅毒。
words.en: Syphilis is a serious sexually transmitted disease caused by the bacterium Treponema pallidum, which can lead to serious complications if not treated.

words.ex: The surgeon repaired the torn tendon in the athlete's leg.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生修复了运动员腿上的撕裂肌腱。
words.en: A tendon is a tough band of fibrous connective tissue that usually connects muscle to bone and is capable of withstanding tension.

words.ex: The therapeutic massage helped her relax.
words.ex_cn: 这种治疗性的按摩帮助她放松了。
words.en: If something is therapeutic, it helps you to relax or to feel better about things, especially if you have been feeling worried or upset.

words.ex: The therapist helped him feel better after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 治疗专家在事故后帮助他感觉好些了。
words.en: A therapist is a person who is skilled in a particular type of therapy and treats people using it.

words.ex: He is receiving therapy for his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受治疗以缓解背痛。
words.en: Therapy is the treatment of someone with mental or physical illness without the use of drugs or operations.

words.ex: He takes medicine for his thyroid.
words.ex_cn: 他为甲状腺服用药物。
words.en: The thyroid is a large ductless gland in the neck that secretes hormones regulating growth and development through the rate of metabolism.

words.tr:
v. 感到刺痛；强烈地感到
n. 刺痛感；激动感
words.ex: Her fingers tingle when she holds ice.
words.ex_cn: 当她握着冰时，手指会发麻。
words.en: If you tingle, you feel a slight prickling or stinging sensation, often because you are excited or frightened.

words.tr: n. 补药；滋补品；奎宁水
words.ex: He drank a tonic to feel better.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了一杯滋补剂来感觉好些。
words.en: A tonic is a medicine that makes you feel stronger, healthier, and less tired.

words.ex: The entrance to the building is on the left.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的入口在左边。
words.en: An entrance is a way into a place, such as a door or gate. It can also refer to the act of entering a place or the right to enter.

words.ex: The accident left him with a serious trauma on his leg.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故使他的腿受了严重的伤。
words.en: A trauma is a very distressing or disturbing experience.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with tuberculosis last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有结核病。
words.en: Tuberculosis is an infectious disease caused by the bacterium Mycobacterium tuberculosis, which primarily affects the lungs but can also affect other parts of the body.

words.ex: He has an ulcer from eating too much spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吃太多辣食而得了溃疡。
words.en: An ulcer is a sore area on the skin or inside the body that is very painful and may bleed or produce a poisonous substance.

words.tr: v. 接种疫苗；预防接种
words.ex: The doctor will vaccinate the child tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 医生明天会给这个孩子接种疫苗。
words.en: To vaccinate someone is to give them a vaccine, usually by injection, to prevent them from getting a disease.

words.ex: He got a vaccine last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周打了疫苗。
words.en: A vaccine is a substance containing a virus or bacterium in a form that is not harmful, given to a person or animal to prevent them from getting the disease that the virus or bacterium causes.

words.ex: The water valve is broken and needs repair.
words.ex_cn: 这个水阀坏了，需要修理。
words.en: A valve is a device attached to a pipe or a tube which controls the flow of air or liquid through it.

words.ex: He has varicose veins on his legs.
words.ex_cn: 他的腿上有静脉曲张。
words.en: Varicose veins are veins that have become enlarged and twisted, typically appearing as bulging, blue cords running just beneath the surface of your skin. They most commonly affect the legs and feet.

words.tr: adj. 性病的；性交传染的
words.ex: He was diagnosed with a venereal disease last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有性病。
words.en: Venereal is used to describe something related to or resulting from sexual intercourse, especially in the context of diseases.

words.ex: The ventral side of the fish is lighter in color.
words.ex_cn: 鱼的腹侧颜色较浅。
words.en: Relating to or situated on or close to the abdomen; abdominal.

words.ex: The heart has four ventricles.
words.ex_cn: 心脏有四个心室。
words.en: A ventricle is one of the two lower chambers of the heart that receive blood from the atria and pump it to the lungs and the rest of the body.

words.ex: The doctor checked the ventricular rhythm of the patient.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的心室节律。
words.en: Relating to a ventricle, especially one of the heart.

words.tr:
n. 兽医；
v. 审查；
words.ex: The vet checked the dog's health.
words.ex_cn: 兽医检查了狗的健康状况。
words.en: A vet is a person who is qualified to treat sick or injured animals. As a verb, to vet means to examine something or someone carefully to make sure they are suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The viral infection made him feverish for three days.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒引起的感染让他发烧了三天。
words.en: Relating to or caused by a virus; becoming very popular by circulating quickly from person to person, especially on the internet.

words.ex: The doctor examined the viscera during the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 医生在手术中检查了内脏。
words.en: Your viscera are the large organs inside your body, such as your heart, liver, and stomach.

chapters.name: 拥抱自然 动植物 重点词

words.tr: v. “be”的现在分词；是；在； n. 存在；生物；人；生命；
words.ex: He is being quiet in the library.
words.ex_cn: 他正在图书馆里保持安静。
words.en: The state or quality of having existence.

words.ex: The roses are in bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 玫瑰在春天开花。
words.en: When a plant or tree blooms, it produces flowers. The period during which a plant or tree produces flowers is also known as its bloom.

words.tr:
n. 笼子；栏舍
v. 把…关起来
words.ex: The chickens live in a small coop.
words.ex_cn: 鸡住在小笼子里。
words.en: A coop is a cage or small building in which chickens are kept.

words.tr:
v. 嘎吱嘎吱地动；发嘎吱嘎吱声
n. 嘎吱声；艰难局面；危急情况
words.ex: The dog crunches the bone loudly.
words.ex_cn: 狗嘎吱嘎吱地咬着骨头。
words.en: To crunch means to chew noisily with your mouth open, or to make a loud noise like the sound of something being crushed. It can also refer to a critical point or situation, especially in financial contexts.

words.ex: The apple will decompose in the soil.
words.ex_cn: 苹果会在土壤中分解。
words.en: If something decomposes, or if it is decomposed, it decays or breaks down into smaller parts or substances.

words.tr:
n. 诱饵；（诱捕鸟兽的）动物
v. 引诱
words.ex: The hunter used a decoy to attract ducks.
words.ex_cn: 猎人用假鸭子来吸引鸭子。
words.en: A decoy is a person, thing, or action that is used to trick someone into doing something or going somewhere, especially by making them think they are going to get something they want.

words.tr: adj. 精致的；微妙的；易碎的；脆弱的；
words.ex: She wore a delicate lace dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条精致的蕾丝连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is delicate is small and beautifully shaped. It can also be easily broken or damaged.

words.ex: The flowers exude a sweet smell.
words.ex_cn: 花朵散发出甜美的香味。
words.en: If someone exudes a quality or feeling, or if it exudes, they show that they have it to a great extent.

words.tr:
v. 拍动；摆动；
n. 薄片；
words.ex: The bird flaps its wings to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟拍动翅膀飞翔。
words.en: A flap is a piece of cloth, paper, skin etc that is fixed at one edge to a surface, which you can lift up easily. If something such as a piece of cloth or paper flaps or if you flap it, it moves quickly up and down or from side to side.

words.tr:
v. 梳理；乱砍
n. 颈羽
words.ex: The dog raised its hackles when it saw the stranger.
words.ex_cn: 狗看到陌生人时竖起了鬃毛。
words.en: Hackle refers to the erectile hairs or feathers on the neck of an animal, especially a dog or a rooster, which rise when the animal is angry or frightened. It can also mean to comb or tease fibers, as in preparing flax or hemp.

words.ex: Bears hibernate in winter to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 熊在冬天冬眠以保存能量。
words.en: To spend the winter in a dormant state.

words.ex: The lush grass looked green after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后，葱翠的草地显得格外绿。
words.en: A lush area has a lot of green, healthy plants, grass, and trees.

words.ex: The luxuriant forest had thick trees and deep green leaves.
words.ex_cn: 这片茂密的森林有茂盛的树木和深绿色的叶子。
words.en: Luxuriant is used to describe something that is rich in growth, abundance, or opulence.

words.ex: The migrant found a new job in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这位移居者在城市里找到了一份新工作。
words.en: A migrant is a person who moves from one place to another, especially in order to find work.

words.ex: The nomadic family moves with their sheep every season.
words.ex_cn: 这个游牧家庭每季都随着羊群迁移。
words.en: A nomadic way of life is one in which people move from place to place instead of living in one place all the time.

words.ex: The flowers will perish if you don't water them.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不给花浇水，它们会死。
words.en: If people or animals perish, they die as a result of very harsh conditions or as the result of an accident.

words.ex: The chickens roost on the branch at night.
words.ex_cn: 鸡晚上栖息在树枝上。
words.en: A roost is a place where birds rest or sleep. As a verb, to roost means for birds to settle or rest, typically for the night.

words.tr: adj. 真实的；真的；正确的；
words.ex: The story is true.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事是真实的。
words.en: in accordance with fact or reality

words.tr: v. （在废物中）寻觅；食腐肉；拾荒
words.ex: Dogs scavenge for food in the streets.
words.ex_cn: 狗在街上翻找食物。
words.en: To scavenge means to search for and collect anything usable from discarded waste.

words.ex: He sealed the envelope with glue.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶水把信封封上了。
words.en: A seal is a device or substance that is used to close off or fasten an opening or container, making it airtight or watertight. It can also refer to a marine mammal with flippers for swimming.

words.ex: The gland secrete sweat to cool the body.
words.ex_cn: 腺体分泌汗液来降温。
words.en: If part of a plant, animal, or human secretes a liquid or substance, it produces it.

words.ex: The apple shrivels in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 苹果在阳光下皱缩。
words.en: If something shrivels or if you shrivel it, it becomes dryer and smaller, often with lines in its surface, as a result of losing the water it contains.

words.tr:
v. 咆哮；吼叫；（使）缠结
n. 咆哮（声）；缠结
words.ex: The dog snarls at strangers.
words.ex_cn: 狗对陌生人咆哮。
words.en: If an animal snarls, it makes a fierce, rough noise in its throat, usually to show anger.

words.tr:
n. 茎；词干；
v. 起源于(~ from)；
words.ex: The flower grows on a long green stem.
words.ex_cn: 花长在一根长长的绿色茎上。
words.en: The main body or stalk of a plant or shrub, typically rising above ground but occasionally subterranean; to stop or restrict (the flow of something).

words.tr: v. 蒸发；排出；为人所知；发生
words.ex: Water transpires from the leaves in hot weather.
words.ex_cn: 水在炎热的天气中从叶子中蒸发。
words.en: If it transpires that something has happened, this previously secret or unknown fact becomes known.

words.ex: The little girl drew a unicorn in her notebook.
words.ex_cn: 小女孩在笔记本上画了一只独角兽。
words.en: A unicorn is a mythical creature typically represented as a horse with a single straight horn projecting from its forehead.

words.tr:
n. 枯萎；凋谢；憔悴；
v. 枯萎；凋谢；憔悴；
words.ex: The flowers showed signs of wilt after the long heat.
words.ex_cn: 这些花在长时间高温后出现了枯萎的迹象。
words.en: If a plant wilts, it bends over because it is too dry, too hot, or too weak to stay upright.

chapters.name: 拥抱自然 动植物 认知词

words.ex: He used an adhesive to stick the paper on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他用黏合剂把纸贴在墙上。
words.en: An adhesive is a substance used for sticking objects or materials together.

words.ex: The cat is agile and jumps high.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫很敏捷，跳得很高。
words.en: Someone who is agile can move quickly and easily.

words.ex: The frog is an amphibian.
words.ex_cn: 青蛙是一种两栖动物。
words.en: An amphibian is a type of animal that can live both on land and in water. Frogs, toads, and salamanders are examples of amphibians.

words.ex: The frog is an amphibious animal.
words.ex_cn: 青蛙是一种两栖动物。
words.en: An amphibious vehicle or craft is one that can operate on both land and water.

words.ex: The antelope runs fast across the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 羚羊在草原上快速奔跑。
words.en: An antelope is a swift-running deer-like mammal with smooth hair and upward-pointing horns, found chiefly in Africa and Asia.

words.ex: The deer has big antlers.
words.ex_cn: 这只鹿有大角。
words.en: One of the branched horns on the head of an adult deer (typically a male), which are made of bone and are shed and regrown annually.

words.ex: He wore a coat made of badger.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件用獾皮毛制成的外套。
words.en: To badger someone means to repeatedly ask them to do something or to repeatedly question them about something, often in an annoying way.

words.ex: The boat is parked in the bay.
words.ex_cn: 船停在海湾里。
words.en: A bay is a body of water partially enclosed by land, typically smaller than a gulf. It can also refer to a compartment for a ship, the color of a horse, or the sound a dog makes.

words.ex: I eat broccoli with dinner every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚餐都吃西兰花。
words.en: Broccoli is a vegetable with a green flower head and a thick stalk, eaten as a vegetable.

words.ex: A bug crawled on the leaf.
words.ex_cn: 一只小虫子爬在叶子上。
words.en: A bug is a small insect, or it can refer to a fault in a computer program or system.

words.tr:
v. 咯咯叫；咯咯地笑
n. 咯咯叫声；咯咯的笑声
words.ex: The witches cackle in the dark forest.
words.ex_cn: 女巫们在黑暗的森林里咯咯大笑。
words.en: If someone cackles, they laugh in a loud, unpleasant way, especially at something wicked or cruel.

words.ex: She gave her mom a red carnation on Mother's Day.
words.ex_cn: 她在母亲节送了妈妈一朵红色的康乃馨。
words.en: A carnation is a type of flower with a sweet smell, which is often worn on special occasions such as weddings or funerals.

words.ex: Lions are carnivores that eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是吃肉的食肉动物。
words.en: A carnivore is an animal that eats the flesh of other animals.

words.ex: He caught a big carp in the river.
words.ex_cn: 他在河里钓到了一条大鲤鱼。
words.en: To complain or find fault continually, typically about trivial matters.

words.ex: The cabin is built from cedar wood.
words.ex_cn: 小屋是用雪松木建造的。
words.en: Cedar is a type of large evergreen tree with wide branches and needle-like leaves.

words.ex: The cellular structure of plants is very small.
words.ex_cn: 植物的细胞结构非常微小。
words.en: Relating to or consisting of cells; having a porous structure.

words.ex: The chimpanzee is eating a banana.
words.ex_cn: 这只黑猩猩正在吃一根香蕉。
words.en: A chimpanzee is a great ape native to the forest and savannah of tropical Africa. It is known for its intelligence, use of tools, and complex social structures.

words.ex: The bird made a soft chirp in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在早晨发出轻柔的唧唧声。
words.en: If a bird or an insect chirps, it makes short high-pitched sounds.

words.ex: Chloroplasts are the site of photosynthesis in plant cells.
words.ex_cn: 叶绿体是植物细胞中进行光合作用的场所。
words.en: A chloroplast is a part of a plant cell that contains chlorophyll and in which photosynthesis takes place.

words.ex: Each cell has 46 chromosomes.
words.ex_cn: 每个细胞有46条染色体。
words.en: A chromosome is a thread-like structure of nucleic acids and protein found in the nucleus of most living cells, carrying genetic information in the form of genes.

words.ex: The scientist created a clone of the sheep.
words.ex_cn: 科学家克隆了一只羊。
words.en: A clone is an organism or cell produced asexually from one ancestor or stock, to which they are genetically identical.

words.tr:
n. 丛；笨重的脚步声；土块
v. 使成一丛；凝结成块；拖着沉重的步子走
words.ex: The grass formed a clump near the fence.
words.ex_cn: 草在篱笆附近长成了一簇。
words.en: A clump of things such as trees or plants is a small group of them growing together. A clump of earth or mud is a small, solid mass of it.

words.ex: The coastal village has beautiful beaches.
words.ex_cn: 这个沿海村庄有美丽的海滩。
words.en: relating to the coast, the area where the land meets the sea

words.ex: The cobra hissed at the man.
words.ex_cn: 眼镜蛇向那个人嘶嘶作响。
words.en: A cobra is a highly venomous snake known for its hood and its ability to spit venom.

words.ex: The colt runs fast across the field.
words.ex_cn: 小马在田野上快速奔跑。
words.en: A colt is a young male horse, especially one that is less than four years old.

words.ex: The forest has many coniferous trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有很多针叶树。
words.en: Coniferous refers to trees that produce cones and have needle-shaped leaves, typically evergreen.

words.tr:
v. 呱呱地叫；发出低沉沙哑声
n. 呱呱的叫声
words.ex: The frog croaks loudly at night.
words.ex_cn: 青蛙晚上呱呱叫得很响。
words.en: To croak means to make a deep, harsh sound like that of a frog. It can also mean to die or to speak in a rough, low voice.

words.ex: The crocodile is swimming in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鳄鱼正在河里游泳。
words.en: A crocodile is a large reptile that lives in rivers in the tropical regions of Africa, Asia, America, and Australia. It has a long body, a long tail, and very strong jaws.

words.ex: The child played with a wooden cube.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩了一个木制立方体。
words.en: A cube is a solid object with six square faces which are all the same size.

words.ex: The cuckoo sings loudly in the spring.
words.ex_cn: 杜鹃在春天大声鸣叫。
words.en: A cuckoo is a bird with a call that sounds like its name. It is known for laying its eggs in the nests of other birds.

words.ex: The daffodil blooms in spring.
words.ex_cn: 水仙花在春天开放。
words.en: A daffodil is a yellow flower that blooms in the spring.

words.ex: She picked a white daisy in the field.
words.ex_cn: 她在田野里摘了一朵白色的雏菊。
words.en: A daisy is a small wild flower with white petals and a yellow center.

words.ex: The child blew a dandelion in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在公园里吹了一朵蒲公英。
words.en: A dandelion is a wild plant which has yellow flowers with lots of thin petals. When the petals fall, they are replaced by a fluffy white ball of seeds.

words.ex: The docile dog followed its owner quietly.
words.ex_cn: 这只温顺的狗安静地跟着主人。
words.en: A docile person or animal is quiet, not aggressive, and easily controlled.

words.ex: The farmer feeds the ewe every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂那只母羊。
words.en: A ewe is a female sheep.

words.ex: The falcon flew high above the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 猎鹰在群山上空飞翔。
words.en: A falcon is a bird of prey, known for its speed and keen eyesight, used in falconry.

words.ex: The forest is home to a rich fauna.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是丰富动物群的家园。
words.en: The animals of a particular region, habitat, or geological period.

words.ex: He ate a fresh fig for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个新鲜的无花果。
words.en: A fig is a soft sweet fruit that grows in hot countries. It is full of tiny seeds and often eaten dried.

words.ex: He handed out a flyer about the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他分发了一张关于音乐会的传单。
words.en: A flyer is a small handbill advertising an event or product.

words.tr: n. 飞行物；飞行员；传单
words.ex: The flier soared high above the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个飞行物在群山之上高高飞翔。
words.en: A flier is someone who travels in an aircraft, especially as a passenger, or a small piece of paper that is used to advertise something.

words.ex: Gorillas are primarily folivores, feeding on leaves and stems.
words.ex_cn: 大猩猩主要是食叶动物，以树叶和茎为食。
words.en: An animal that feeds on leaves.

words.ex: He fries fish in a pan every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日用平底锅油炸鱼。
words.en: To cook something in hot fat or oil, or to be cooked in this way.

words.ex: The seeds germinate in warm soil.
words.ex_cn: 种子在温暖的土壤中发芽。
words.en: To germinate means to begin to grow or develop, especially for a seed or spore.

words.ex: The gibbon swings through the trees in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 长臂猿在丛林中荡来荡去。
words.en: A gibbon is a small, slender, long-armed ape found in the forests of Southeast Asia.

words.ex: The fish opened its gill to breathe water.
words.ex_cn: 鱼张开鳃来呼吸水中的氧气。
words.en: A gill is the respiratory organ of fish and some amphibians, which allows them to breathe underwater by extracting oxygen from water.

words.ex: He adds ginger to his tea for flavor.
words.ex_cn: 他往茶里加姜来调味。
words.en: Ginger is a plant with a thick, knobby root that is used as a spice in cooking. It has a strong, spicy flavor and is also used in traditional medicine.

words.ex: The children played in a small grove behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的小树林里玩耍。
words.en: A grove is a small group of trees.

words.ex: He made a table from hardwood.
words.ex_cn: 他用硬木做了一张桌子。
words.en: Hardwood is wood from broad-leaved trees such as oak, ash, or beech, as opposed to conifers.

words.ex: The farmer feeds the heifer every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂小母牛。
words.en: A heifer is a young cow that has not borne a calf.

words.ex: The deer avoided the hemlock because it is poisonous.
words.ex_cn: 鹿避开了毒芹，因为它是有毒的。
words.en: Hemlock is a highly poisonous plant, especially the poison hemlock, Conium maculatum, of the parsley family. It is also the name of the poison derived from this plant.

words.ex: They made rope from hemp.
words.ex_cn: 他们用大麻纤维制作绳子。
words.en: Hemp is a plant from the cannabis family, cultivated for its fiber, seeds, and oil. It is used in a variety of products, including textiles, paper, and biodegradable plastics.

words.ex: She dried the herb to make tea.
words.ex_cn: 她晒干了这种药草来泡茶。
words.en: A plant or a part of a plant that is used for its medicinal, savory, or aromatic qualities.

words.ex: The deer is a herbivore.
words.ex_cn: 鹿是食草动物。
words.en: An herbivore is an animal that gets its energy from eating plants, and only plants.

words.ex: The deer is herbivorous.
words.ex_cn: 这只鹿是食草的。
words.en: Herbivorous animals are those that feed on plants.

words.ex: The horse moved its hindquarters to the left.
words.ex_cn: 马把后躯往左移动。
words.en: The back part of an animal, including the legs.

words.ex: She hung holly above the door for Christmas.
words.ex_cn: 她把冬青挂在门上方过圣诞节。
words.en: Holly is a type of evergreen tree or shrub with prickly leaves and red berries, often used as a decoration during Christmas.

words.ex: A hornet flew near my head.
words.ex_cn: 一只大黄蜂飞到了我的头附近。
words.en: A hornet is a large, stinging wasp that is typically more aggressive than a bee.

words.ex: The wolf howl at the moon.
words.ex_cn: 狼对着月亮嚎叫。
words.en: If a dog or wolf howls, it makes a long, loud, crying sound. If a person howls, they make a long, loud cry expressing pain, anger, or unhappiness.

words.ex: The hull of the boat was damaged by the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 船的船体被岩石损坏了。
words.en: The main body of a ship or other vessel, including the bottom, sides, and deck but not the masts, superstructure, rigging, engines, and other fittings.

words.ex: The corn has a dry husk around it.
words.ex_cn: 玉米外面有一层干外壳。
words.en: The outer covering of some fruits and seeds, especially when it is dry and hard.

words.tr:
n. 杂交种；混合物；
adj. 混合的；
words.ex: The corn hybrid grows faster than the old type.
words.ex_cn: 这种玉米杂交种比旧品种长得更快。
words.en: A hybrid is a plant or animal that has been produced from two different types of plant or animal, especially to get better characteristics. It can also refer to something that is a mixture of two different things.

words.ex: Ivy climbs the old wall.
words.ex_cn: 常春藤爬上了旧墙。
words.en: Ivy is a climbing plant with dark green shiny leaves.

words.ex: She planted jasmine in her garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里种了茉莉。
words.en: A shrub or climbing plant which bears fragrant flowers used in perfumery or tea.

words.ex: She smells the jasmine in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里闻着茉莉花的香味。
words.en: A shrub or climbing plant which bears fragrant flowers used in perfumery or tea.

words.ex: The jellyfish floated gently in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 水母在海里轻轻漂浮。
words.en: A jellyfish is a sea creature with a soft, clear body and long tentacles that can sting.

words.ex: The kernel of the computer is the operating system.
words.ex_cn: 计算机的核心是操作系统。
words.en: The kernel of something such as a nut or a seed is the part inside the shell. The kernel of an idea or a theory is the central and most important part of it.

words.ex: The kiwi is a flightless bird from New Zealand.
words.ex_cn: 几维鸟是一种来自新西兰的不会飞的鸟。
words.en: A kiwi is a flightless bird native to New Zealand, or the fruit of a Chinese gooseberry vine, which is also known as kiwifruit.

words.ex: The butterfly starts as a larva.
words.ex_cn: 蝴蝶从幼虫开始。
words.en: An insect in the stage of development when it has just come out of an egg and before it changes into its adult form.

words.ex: He wore a laurel crown on his head.
words.ex_cn: 他头上戴着月桂花环。
words.en: A laurel is a type of shrub or tree, specifically the bay tree, whose leaves are used in cooking and as a symbol of victory or honor.

words.ex: He cooked soup with a leek.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根韭葱煮了汤。
words.en: A leek is a vegetable that is related to the onion, with flat leaves and a white base. It is used in cooking for its mild flavor.

words.ex: He eats lentil soup for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃扁豆汤。
words.en: A lentil is a small, flat, round seed that is cooked and eaten as a food. It is a type of legume.

words.tr:
n. 紫丁香；淡紫色
adj. 淡紫色的
words.ex: The lilac blooms in spring.
words.ex_cn: 丁香花在春天盛开。
words.en: A lilac is a type of shrub or small tree which has bunches of sweet-smelling pink, white, or purple flowers.

words.ex: The lotus grows in the muddy pond.
words.ex_cn: 莲花生长在泥泞的池塘里。
words.en: A lotus is a type of water lily with large, flat leaves and white, pink, or yellow flowers. It is often regarded as a symbol of purity and enlightenment in various cultures.

words.tr:
n. 虱子；寄生虫；卑鄙的家伙
v. 办砸；除虱子
words.ex: The boy has a louse in his hair.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩头发里有一只虱子。
words.en: A louse is a small, wingless, parasitic insect that lives on the skin of mammals and birds. It can also refer to a contemptible person.

words.tr:
n. 强烈的性欲；强烈的欲望
v. 对…有极强的性欲（或欲望）
words.ex: His lust for power ruined his relationships.
words.ex_cn: 他对权力的强烈欲望毁掉了他的关系。
words.en: Lust is a strong feeling of wanting to have or to do something, especially sexual desire.

words.ex: The lychee is a tropical fruit with a sweet, fragrant flesh.
words.ex_cn: 荔枝是一种热带水果，果肉香甜。
words.en: A lychee is a small fruit with sweet white flesh and a large seed inside, and it has a rough, red shell.

words.ex: The fishermen caught a large mackerel.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫捕获了一条大鲭鱼。
words.en: A mackerel is a sea fish with a greenish-blue back and silvery sides, often used as food.

words.ex: The rotten apple had a maggot inside.
words.ex_cn: 那个腐烂的苹果里有一条蛆。
words.en: A maggot is the larva of a fly, which is typically found in decaying organic matter.

words.tr: n. 木兰；玉兰类的植物
words.ex: The magnolia tree blooms in spring.
words.ex_cn: 玉兰树在春天开花。
words.en: A magnolia is a type of tree or shrub that has large, usually white or pink flowers. It is widely grown for its beauty and fragrance.

words.tr: n. 喜鹊；喜欢收集（无价值物品）的人
words.ex: The magpie stole my shiny spoon.
words.ex_cn: 喜鹊偷走了我闪亮的勺子。
words.en: A magpie is a bird with black and white feathers and a long tail. It is known for its noisy chattering and for collecting shiny objects.

words.tr:
n. 猛玛（象）；庞然大物；
adj. 巨大的；庞大的；
words.ex: The mammoth lived in cold areas long ago.
words.ex_cn: 猛犸象很久以前生活在寒冷地区。
words.en: If you describe something as mammoth, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large.

words.ex: The lion's mane is long and brown.
words.ex_cn: 狮子的鬃毛又长又棕。
words.en: The long hair growing from the neck of a horse, lion, or other animal; a person's long, thick hair.

words.ex: The mare grazed quietly in the field.
words.ex_cn: 那匹母马在田野里安静地吃草。
words.en: A mare is an adult female horse.

words.ex: He smokes marijuana on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末吸大麻。
words.en: A drug made from the dried leaves and flowers of the hemp plant, which is smoked or eaten to induce euphoria.

words.tr: n. 交配； v. “mate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The birds engage in mating during spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟在春天交配。
words.en: The process by which animals come together for the purpose of reproduction.

words.ex: The little girl drew a mermaid in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 小女孩画了一条海里的美人鱼。
words.en: A mermaid is a mythical sea creature with the head and upper body of a woman and the tail of a fish.

words.ex: The millipede crawled slowly under the leaf.
words.ex_cn: 千足虫在树叶下缓慢爬行。
words.en: A millipede is a small creature with a long, narrow body and a lot of legs.

words.ex: She wore a coat made of genuine mink.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着一件真正的貂皮大衣。
words.en: A mink is a small, dark brown, semiaquatic mammal that is valued for its fur.

words.ex: The dog was a mongrel, a mix of several breeds.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗是杂种狗，是几种品种的混血。
words.en: A mongrel is a dog that is a mixture of different breeds, or a person who is of mixed origin.

words.ex: A mosquito bit my arm last night.
words.ex_cn: 一只蚊子昨晚咬了我的胳膊。
words.en: A mosquito is a small flying insect that bites people and animals in order to feed on their blood. Some mosquitoes can transmit diseases.

words.ex: He ate a plate of steamed mussels for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了一盘蒸贻贝。
words.en: A mussel is a small sea creature that has a dark shell with two parts that close tightly together. Mussels are often eaten as food.

words.ex: The dog wore a leather muzzle.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗戴着一个皮制的鼻口罩。
words.en: The front part of the face of an animal, including the nose and mouth; a device placed over this part to prevent the animal from biting or eating; to prevent someone from expressing their opinions or ideas freely.

words.ex: She felt a cool breeze on the nape of her neck.
words.ex_cn: 她感觉到脖子后颈处有一阵凉风。
words.en: The back of the neck.

words.ex: The garden was filled with the sweet scent of narcissus.
words.ex_cn: 花园里弥漫着水仙花的甜美香气。
words.en: A narcissus is a plant with yellow or white flowers that appear in the spring. It is also used to refer to someone who is excessively self-absorbed.

words.tr: v. 用鼻擦、触、推；紧挨；偎依
words.ex: The cat nuzzled its owner's hand.
words.ex_cn: 那只猫在主人的手上蹭来蹭去。
words.en: If an animal nuzzles you, it pushes or rubs its nose or head against you in a gentle and affectionate way.

words.ex: The octopus swims quickly in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 章鱼在海里游得很快。
words.en: An octopus is a sea creature with a soft, oval body and eight long arms.

words.ex: She bought a pink orchid for her mother.
words.ex_cn: 她为母亲买了一朵粉色的兰花。
words.en: A plant with complex flowers that are often brightly coloured, grown especially for its beautiful flowers.

words.ex: The panther walks quietly through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 美洲豹静静地穿过森林。
words.en: A panther is a large wild animal of the cat family, which is either black or tawny-colored with black spots and is found in Africa, Asia, and the Americas.

words.tr: n. 寄生虫；寄生生物；依赖他人过活者；
words.ex: The parasite lives inside the host's body.
words.ex_cn: 这种寄生虫生活在宿主的体内。
words.en: A parasite is an organism that lives on or in a host organism and gets its food from or at the expense of its host.

words.tr: n. 欧芹；荷兰芹；洋芫荽
words.ex: She put parsley on the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她在汤里放了些欧芹。
words.en: Parsley is a plant with curly or flat green leaves that are used for flavoring or decorating food.

words.ex: The pelican scooped up a fish in its large beak.
words.ex_cn: 鹈鹕用它的大嘴捞起了一条鱼。
words.en: A pelican is a large water bird with a distinctive pouch under its beak, used for catching fish.

words.ex: The hunter bagged a pheasant for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 猎人捕获了一只雉鸡作为晚餐。
words.en: A pheasant is a large bird with a long tail, often hunted for sport or food.

words.tr:
n. 长矛；狗鱼
v. 用长矛刺
words.ex: The soldier held a sharp pike in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 士兵手里拿着一把锋利的长矛。
words.en: A pike is a long thrusting spear formerly used in European warfare from the Late Middle Ages and most of the Early Modern Period, and were wielded by foot soldiers deployed in pike square formation, and it is also a large predatory freshwater fish with a long body and large mouth.

words.ex: Bees collect pollen from flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂从花朵中采集花粉。
words.en: Pollen is a fine powder produced by flowers, which is carried by the wind or insects to other flowers of the same species, causing them to produce seeds.

words.ex: The poplar trees grow tall by the river.
words.ex_cn: 白杨树在河边长得很高。
words.en: A poplar is a type of tree that grows quickly and is often planted for its wood or to provide shade.

words.ex: The red poppy grows in the field.
words.ex_cn: 红罂粟生长在田地里。
words.en: A poppy is a plant with large, delicate, red flowers. The seeds of the poppy are used in cooking and for producing oil.

words.ex: The lion is a predatory animal.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种食肉动物。
words.en: Predatory animals live by killing and eating other animals. Predatory people or organizations are eager to gain something out of someone else's weakness or suffering.

words.ex: The python slithered quietly through the grass.
words.ex_cn: 那条大蟒蛇静静地从草丛中滑过。
words.en: Python is a high-level, interpreted programming language known for its readability and efficiency. It supports multiple programming paradigms, including procedural, object-oriented, and functional programming.

words.tr:
n. 鹌鹑；鹌鹑肉 
v. 畏缩；胆怯
words.ex: The farmer raised quail for their eggs.
words.ex_cn: 农夫饲养鹌鹑来获取它们的蛋。
words.en: If someone quails, they feel or show fear or hesitation.

words.ex: He was known as a rambler who loved to explore new places.
words.ex_cn: 他以喜欢探索新地方的漫步者而闻名。
words.en: A rambler is someone who walks for pleasure, especially in the countryside.

words.ex: Fish reproduce in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在河里繁殖。
words.en: To produce something again; to make a copy of something.

words.ex: The rhinoceros walks slowly in the grass.
words.ex_cn: 犀牛在草地上慢慢行走。
words.en: A rhinoceros is a large, thick-skinned animal with one or two horns on its nose, native to Africa and southern Asia.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.ex: The rodent ran quickly across the floor.
words.ex_cn: 这只啮齿动物迅速跑过地板。
words.en: A rodent is a small mammal which has sharp front teeth that it uses for gnawing. Rodents include rats, mice, and squirrels.

words.tr: n. 番红花粉；藏红花粉；
words.ex: She added a pinch of saffron to the rice.
words.ex_cn: 她往米饭里加了一小撮番红花粉。
words.en: Saffron is a very expensive spice that is used to color and flavor food. It is made from the dried stigmas of the saffron crocus.

words.tr:
n. 扇贝；扇形饰边
v. 拾扇贝；使成扇形
words.ex: She collected scallop shells on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 她在海滩上收集扇贝壳。
words.en: A scallop is a type of shellfish with two fan-shaped shells. Scallops can be eaten as food, and their shells are often used for decoration.

words.ex: The dog is a scavenger and eats leftover food.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗是拾荒者，吃剩下的食物。
words.en: A scavenger is an animal that feeds on dead organisms, especially a carnivorous animal that eats dead animals rather than or in addition to hunting live prey.

words.ex: The deer walked through the scrub near the hill.
words.ex_cn: 鹿穿过了山边的灌木丛。
words.en: To scrub something means to rub it hard in order to clean it, especially using a stiff brush and water.

words.ex: That paper was a seminal work in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 那篇论文是计算机科学领域一部影响深远的著作。
words.en: Seminal is used to describe things such as books, works, events, and people that have a great influence in a particular field.

words.ex: Her senility made it difficult for her to remember recent events.
words.ex_cn: 她的衰老使她难以记住最近发生的事情。
words.en: Senility refers to the mental and physical decline associated with old age, often characterized by memory loss, confusion, and a decrease in cognitive abilities.

words.tr:
n. 粗毛；蓬乱一团
v. 使蓬松；使杂乱
words.ex: The carpet has a thick, shag texture.
words.ex_cn: 这块地毯有着厚厚的粗毛质感。
words.en: Shag refers to a type of rough, coarse hair or a dance style characterized by energetic movements.

words.ex: The shrew ran quickly under the leaves.
words.ex_cn: 鼩鼱在树叶下快速奔跑。
words.en: A shrew is a small, mouse-like mammal with a pointed snout, or it can refer to a bad-tempered or aggressively assertive woman.

words.ex: The garden was filled with colorful shrubbery.
words.ex_cn: 花园里种满了五彩缤纷的灌木。
words.en: A shrubbery is a part of a garden where shrubs are planted.

words.tr: adj. 灌木的；灌木状的；灌木丛生的
words.ex: The hillside was covered in shrubby vegetation.
words.ex_cn: 山坡上覆盖着灌木丛生的植被。
words.en: Consisting of or resembling shrubs.

words.tr: n. 鼻口部；猪嘴；鼻状物；
words.ex: The pig stuck its snout in the mud.
words.ex_cn: 猪把它的鼻口部伸进了泥里。
words.en: The projecting nose and mouth of an animal, especially a mammal.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.ex: The fungus releases a spore into the air.
words.ex_cn: 真菌向空气中释放一个孢子。
words.en: A spore is a reproductive cell that is capable of developing into a new individual without fusion with another reproductive cell. Spores are thus agents of asexual reproduction, whereas gametes are agents of sexual reproduction.

words.ex: The stag ran through the forest quickly.
words.ex_cn: 那头成年雄鹿在森林中快速奔跑。
words.en: A stag is an adult male deer.

words.tr:
n. 茎；柄；梗
v. 跟踪；偷偷接近；昂首阔步地走
words.ex: The stalk of the sunflower is very tall.
words.ex_cn: 向日葵的茎很高。
words.en: The main stem of a plant, typically rising above ground but occasionally subterranean. Also, to pursue or approach stealthily.

words.ex: The stallion runs fast in the field.
words.ex_cn: 这匹公马在田野里跑得很快。
words.en: A stallion is an adult male horse that has not been castrated, especially one kept for breeding.

words.ex: The farmer feeds the swine every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂猪。
words.en: A swine is a pig, especially when considered as a farm animal, or a person who behaves in a very unpleasant way.

words.ex: The dog has a tapeworm in its stomach.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗的胃里有绦虫。
words.en: A tapeworm is a long, flat worm that lives in the intestines of humans and animals.

words.ex: He made a table from teak wood.
words.ex_cn: 他用柚木做了一张桌子。
words.en: Teak is a type of hardwood tree native to south and southeast Asia, known for its durability and water resistance. It is widely used in furniture making and shipbuilding.

words.tr:
n. 茅草；茅草屋顶；盖住头顶的蓬乱头发
v. 用茅草覆盖屋顶
words.ex: The cottage has a thatch roof.
words.ex_cn: 小屋有一个茅草屋顶。
words.en: Thatch is a roof covering made of dry vegetation such as straw, water reed, sedge, rushes, or heather, layered so as to shed water away from the inner roof.

words.ex: They made their way through the dense thicket.
words.ex_cn: 他们穿过浓密的灌木丛。
words.en: A thicket is a dense group of bushes or trees.

words.ex: The rabbit ate a thistle in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 兔子在花园里吃了一株蓟。
words.en: A thistle is a wild plant which has leaves with sharp points and purple flowers.

words.ex: Tom is a big tom cat that lives next door.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆是一只住在隔壁的大公猫。
words.en: A male animal, especially a male cat; also a given name for males.

words.ex: He bought a red tulip for his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他为母亲买了一朵红色的郁金香。
words.en: A tulip is a brightly colored flower that is shaped like a cup and grows from a bulb in spring.

words.ex: The chef cooked a fresh turbot for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 厨师为晚餐烹制了一条新鲜的比目鱼。
words.en: A turbot is a large flatfish that is highly valued as food.

words.ex: The deer hid in the underbrush.
words.ex_cn: 鹿藏在矮树丛里。
words.en: Underbrush refers to the dense growth of shrubs and other plants beneath the trees in a forest.

words.ex: The deer walked through the thick undergrowth.
words.ex_cn: 鹿穿过了茂密的矮树丛。
words.en: Undergrowth refers to the dense growth of shrubs and other plants beneath the trees in a forest.

words.ex: The doctor advised him to drink more water to help him urinate more frequently.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议他多喝水，以帮助他更频繁地排尿。
words.en: To urinate means to pass urine from the body.

words.tr:
n. 香草；香草精
adj. 香草味的；寻常的；无特色的
words.ex: He likes vanilla ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢香草冰淇淋。
words.en: Vanilla is a flavoring derived from orchids of the genus Vanilla, primarily from the Mexican species, flat-leaved vanilla (V. planifolia). The word vanilla, derived from the diminutive of the Spanish word vaina (vaina itself meaning sheath or pod), is translated simply as 'little pod'.

words.ex: The snake released venom into its prey.
words.ex_cn: 蛇向猎物释放了毒液。
words.en: Venom is a poisonous substance secreted by animals such as snakes and spiders, used for defense or to kill prey.

words.tr: adj. 分泌毒液的；有毒的；恶毒的
words.ex: The snake is venomous.
words.ex_cn: 这条蛇是有毒的。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behavior as venomous, you mean that they show great bitterness and anger toward someone.

words.ex: The hills are full of verdure in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，山丘上满是青翠的植被。
words.en: The lush greenness of growing vegetation, or such vegetation itself.

words.ex: The farmer trapped vermin that ate his crops.
words.ex_cn: 农夫 traps 了吃他庄稼的害兽。
words.en: Vermin are small animals and insects that are harmful to crops, farm animals, or people, and are difficult to control.

words.ex: Fish and birds are vertebrates.
words.ex_cn: 鱼和鸟是脊椎动物。
words.en: A vertebrate is an animal that has a spine or backbone.

words.tr: n. 兀鹫；秃鹫；贪得无厌的人
words.ex: The vulture is flying high above the desert.
words.ex_cn: 秃鹫在沙漠上空高飞。
words.en: A vulture is a large bird that lives in hot countries and eats dead animals.

chapters.name: 拥抱自然 地理与环境 重点词

words.tr: adj. 着火的；闪耀的；激动的
words.ex: The house was ablaze at night.
words.ex_cn: 那所房子在夜里着火了。
words.en: If something is ablaze, it is burning very fiercely.

words.ex: The Philippines is an archipelago of thousands of islands.
words.ex_cn: 菲律宾是一个由数千个岛屿组成的群岛。
words.en: An archipelago is a group of islands, especially small islands, scattered in a body of water.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.ex: The tree has bare branches in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在冬天有光秃秃的树枝。
words.en: If part of your body is bare, it is not covered by any clothing.

words.tr: v. 使变白；（脸色）变苍白；焯
words.ex: She blanches the vegetables before freezing them.
words.ex_cn: 她在冷冻蔬菜之前先焯水。
words.en: To blanch means to make something white or pale, often by removing color or by causing it to lose color. It can also refer to the process of briefly boiling vegetables and then plunging them into cold water to halt the cooking process.

words.tr:
adj. 空白的；
n. 空白处；
words.ex: The paper had a blank space at the top.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸的顶部有一个空白区域。
words.en: If something is blank, it has nothing on it.

words.tr:
n. 烈火；火焰；闪耀
v. 闪耀；熊熊燃烧；发亮光
words.ex: The fire began to blaze in the woods.
words.ex_cn: 火在森林里开始猛烈燃烧。
words.en: A blaze is a very large or fiercely burning fire that is difficult to control.

words.tr: adj. 无望的；凄凉的；荒凉的；
words.ex: The future looks bleak without a job.
words.ex_cn: 没有工作，未来看起来毫无希望。
words.en: If you describe a situation as bleak, you mean that it seems unlikely to improve or get better.

words.tr:
v. 使模糊；使看不清；弄污
n. 模糊
words.ex: The rain made the lights blur.
words.ex_cn: 雨使灯光变得模糊。
words.en: If something blurs your vision, it makes you unable to see things clearly.

words.ex: The country is on the brink of war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正处于战争的边缘。
words.en: If you are on the brink of something, you are about to do it or experience it.

words.ex: Under these circumstances, we had to cancel the trip.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们不得不取消旅行。
words.en: A circumstance is a fact or event that makes a situation the way it is.

words.tr:
n. 咔嗒声；哗啦声；嘈杂的谈笑声
v. （使）发出哗啦声；咔嗒咔嗒响；喧闹地谈笑
words.ex: The dishes made a loud clatter when they fell.
words.ex_cn: 盘子掉下来时发出了很大的咔嗒声。
words.en: If things clatter, they make a loud, unpleasant noise as they hit each other or something else.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.tr:
n. 群；团；簇；
v. 聚集；
words.ex: The stars form a bright cluster in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜空中形成了一群明亮的星群。
words.en: A cluster of things or people is a small group of them close together.

words.tr:
adj. 易燃的；燃烧性的；易激动的
n. 燃质物；可燃物
words.ex: The wood is combustible and burns easily.
words.ex_cn: 这种木头是可燃的，容易燃烧。
words.en: A combustible material or gas catches fire and burns easily.

words.ex: The river is contaminated by factory waste.
words.ex_cn: 这条河被工厂废料污染了。
words.en: To contaminate something means to make it impure or polluted by contact or mixture with something unclean or harmful.

words.tr: adj. 不足的；缺乏的；有缺陷的
words.ex: The plant is deficient in sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物缺乏阳光。
words.en: If someone or something is deficient in a particular thing, they do not have the full amount of it that they need.

words.ex: The heat made the metal deform.
words.ex_cn: 热量使金属变形。
words.en: To deform something means to change its shape, usually in a way that makes it less attractive or useful.

words.tr:
n. 大洪水；暴雨；泛滥
v. 泛滥；大量涌入
words.ex: The rain caused a deluge in the town.
words.ex_cn: 这场雨在镇上引发了洪水。
words.en: A deluge is a severe flood or a very heavy fall of rain that causes a lot of damage.

words.ex: The drought depletes the water supply.
words.ex_cn: 干旱耗尽了水源。
words.en: If you deplete something, you reduce the amount of it that is available or that exists.

words.ex: The camel walks across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼穿越沙漠。
words.en: A desert is a large area of land that has very little water and very few plants growing on it. Many deserts are covered by sand. If you desert someone or something, you leave them and no longer help or support them.

words.ex: The sun will desiccate the leaves in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天阳光会把叶子晒干。
words.en: To remove the moisture from something, typically in order to preserve it.

words.ex: The desert looks desolate and empty.
words.ex_cn: 这片沙漠看起来荒凉而空旷。
words.en: If you describe a place as desolate, you mean that it is empty and looks sad because there are no people there or because it has been damaged.

words.ex: The weather will deteriorate tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天天气会恶化。
words.en: If something deteriorates, it becomes worse in some way.

words.ex: He felt disgust when he saw the dirty food.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到脏兮兮的食物时，他感到厌恶。
words.en: A feeling of revulsion or profound disapproval aroused by something unpleasant or offensive.

words.ex: The disposal of waste is important for the environment.
words.ex_cn: 废物的处理对环境很重要。
words.en: The act or process of getting rid of something, especially by throwing it away or selling it.

words.ex: The company plans to diversify its products.
words.ex_cn: 公司计划使产品多样化。
words.en: To diversify means to make or become more varied or different. It often refers to the process of a company or individual expanding their range of products or activities to reduce risk or to explore new opportunities.

words.tr: adj. 休眠的；蛰伏的；暂停活动的
words.ex: The volcano is dormant now.
words.ex_cn: 这座火山现在处于休眠状态。
words.en: Something that is dormant is not active or growing but has the ability to be active at a later time.

words.ex: The bike ride is easy because it is downhill.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车很容易，因为是下山的。
words.en: If something or someone is moving downhill or is downhill, they are moving down a slope or are towards the bottom of a hill.

words.tr:
adv. 朝下游方向；
adj. 下游的；
words.ex: The boat moved downstream with the current.
words.ex_cn: 船顺流而下。
words.en: In the direction in which a stream or river flows; situated or moving in the direction of the flow of a stream or river.

words.ex: The rainwater drains into the street.
words.ex_cn: 雨水排入街道。
words.en: If you drain something, you remove the liquid from it, usually by pouring it away or by allowing it to flow away. If something drains, the liquid flows away from it.

words.ex: He dumped the trash into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾倒进了垃圾桶。
words.en: To dump something means to get rid of it quickly and without care, often because it is no longer wanted or needed. It can also refer to the place where waste is left.

words.tr:
n. 日食；月食；黯然失色
v. 使失色
words.ex: We watched the solar eclipse last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚观看了日食。
words.en: An eclipse occurs when one celestial body moves into the shadow of another, temporarily obscuring it or cutting off its light.

words.ex: The emergence of new technology changed our lives.
words.ex_cn: 新技术的出现改变了我们的生活。
words.en: The process of coming into view or becoming exposed after being concealed.

words.tr: v. 使遭危险或伤害；危害；危及
words.ex: Pollution can endanger animals.
words.ex_cn: 污染会危及动物。
words.en: To put someone or something at risk or in danger.

words.ex: The bird evolved from a small dinosaur.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟由一种小型恐龙演变而来。
words.en: If something evolves or you evolve it, it gradually develops over a period of time into something different and usually more advanced.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.tr: adj. 多产的；肥沃的；丰饶的
words.ex: The fertile land is fecund and grows many crops.
words.ex_cn: 这片肥沃的土地很丰产，能长出许多庄稼。
words.en: Capable of producing an abundance of offspring or new growth; fertile.

words.tr:
v. （突然）烧旺；闪耀；突然爆发；张开；加剧
n. 旺火；亮光
words.ex: The fire began to flare up suddenly.
words.ex_cn: 火突然燃了起来。
words.en: A flare is a sudden bright light or flame, or a sudden increase in something such as activity or trouble.

words.tr:
n. 闪光；一刹那；
v. 闪光；闪现；
words.ex: The camera captured a sudden flash of light.
words.ex_cn: 相机捕捉到了一道突然的闪光。
words.en: A flash is a sudden bright light that quickly disappears. As a verb, it means to shine brightly for a short time or to appear or pass suddenly.

words.ex: A flurry of snow covered the streets last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚一阵风雪覆盖了街道。
words.en: A flurry is a sudden, short period of activity, emotion, or excitement, often accompanied by confusion or haste.

words.ex: The milk froths when you steam it.
words.ex_cn: 当你用蒸汽加热牛奶时，它会起泡沫。
words.en: A mass of small bubbles formed in or on a liquid; foam.

words.tr:
v. 闪烁；隐约闪现
n. 亮光；闪光
words.ex: The sun gleams on the water.
words.ex_cn: 阳光照在水面上，闪闪发亮。
words.en: A gleam is a small, bright light, especially one that shines for a short time.

words.tr:
n. 闪耀；闪烁；小发光物
v. 闪耀；闪亮；流露（感情）
words.ex: The glitter of the stars lit up the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星的闪耀照亮了夜空。
words.en: If something glitters, light comes from or is reflected off different parts of it.

words.tr: v. 受引力（重力）作用；移向；被吸引
words.ex: The moon gravitates around the earth.
words.ex_cn: 月球受地球引力作用而围绕它运转。
words.en: If you gravitate towards a particular place, thing, or activity, you are attracted by it and go to it or get involved in it.

words.tr:
v. 汩汩地流；作咯咯声
n. 汩汩声；咯咯声
words.ex: The stream gurgles over the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 小溪在石头上汩汩流淌。
words.en: To make a bubbling sound, typically as a result of liquid flowing irregularly or of a person making a similar sound.

words.tr:
v. 喷涌；滔滔不绝地说
n. 涌出；喷出
words.ex: Water gushed from the broken pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水从破裂的管道中喷涌而出。
words.en: If someone gushes, they express their admiration or pleasure in an exaggerated way.

words.ex: The air feels humid after it rains.
words.ex_cn: 雨后空气感觉湿润。
words.en: You use humid to describe an atmosphere or climate that is very damp, and usually very hot.

words.tr:
n. （驼）峰；驼背；小土丘
v. 背负（重物）；弓起
words.ex: The camel has a big hump on its back.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼的背上有一个大驼峰。
words.en: A hump is a rounded protuberance or bulge, especially on the back of a camel or other animal, or on a person's back. As a verb, it means to form into a hump or to carry something with difficulty.

words.ex: He made a hypothesis that plants grow faster in light.
words.ex_cn: 他提出一个假设，认为植物在光照下长得更快。
words.en: A hypothesis is an idea which is suggested as a possible explanation for a particular situation or condition, but which has not yet been proved to be correct.

words.tr: adj. 用不完的；无穷无尽的；
words.ex: The sun provides an inexhaustible source of energy.
words.ex_cn: 太阳提供一种用不完的能量来源。
words.en: If you describe something as inexhaustible, you are emphasizing that there is a very large quantity of it and that it is not likely to be used up or to run out.

words.ex: The inflow of water filled the tank quickly.
words.ex_cn: 水的流入很快填满了水箱。
words.en: The movement of a substance into a place or system.

words.tr: adj. 海岛的；孤立的；思想褊狭的
words.ex: The insular village has no bridge to the mainland.
words.ex_cn: 这个海岛村庄没有桥通向大陆。
words.en: If you describe someone as insular, you are being critical of them because they are unwilling to meet new people or to consider new ideas.

words.ex: The storm will intensify tonight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴今晚会加强。
words.en: To make or become more intense or intensive.

words.ex: There is a five-minute interval between the two classes.
words.ex_cn: 两节课之间有五分钟的间隔。
words.en: An interval is a period of time between two events or dates.

words.tr: v. 淹没；泛滥；使不胜负荷；使应接不暇
words.ex: The rain inundated the small town.
words.ex_cn: 大雨淹没了这个小镇。
words.en: To inundate means to flood or overwhelm something with a large amount of water or things.

words.tr:
n. 跳跃；
v. 跳跃；
words.ex: The cat made a big leap over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳过了篱笆。
words.en: To leap means to jump high or a long way, or to move quickly and with a lot of energy.

words.ex: The sailors found shelter on the lee side of the island.
words.ex_cn: 水手们在岛屿的背风处找到了庇护。
words.en: The side or part that is sheltered or protected from the wind.

words.tr:
n. 织布机；
v. 迫近；
words.ex: The old loom made a loud clicking sound.
words.ex_cn: 那台旧织布机发出很大的咔嗒声。
words.en: If something looms over you, it appears as a large or unclear shape, often in a way that is frightening or causes worry.

words.ex: The microscope can magnify small objects.
words.ex_cn: 显微镜可以放大微小的物体。
words.en: To magnify something means to make it appear larger than it is, especially by using a lens or microscope. It can also mean to exaggerate or make something seem more important or serious than it really is.

words.tr:
