n. 辩论；讨论；
v. 辩论；讨论；
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: If you maintain something, you continue to have it, and do not let it stop or grow weaker.

words.tr: adj. 失调的；不能适应环境的
words.ex: He is maladjusted to the new school.
words.ex_cn: 他无法适应这所新学校。
words.en: If you describe someone as maladjusted, you mean that they are not psychologically well adjusted to their situation and may have difficulty in forming relationships or coping with life.

words.ex: He saw a mirage in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 他在沙漠中看到了海市蜃楼。
words.en: An optical illusion caused by atmospheric conditions, especially the appearance of a sheet of water in a desert or on a hot road caused by the refraction of light from the sky by heated air.

words.ex: The pastoral man tends his sheep on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这位牧人在山上照看他的羊。
words.en: Relating to the countryside or to the work of a shepherd; idyllically rural.

words.ex: Water can penetrate the soil slowly.
words.ex_cn: 水可以慢慢渗透进土壤。
words.en: To penetrate means to enter or pass through something, especially when this is difficult or when it is not obvious how to do it.

words.ex: The keyboard is a peripheral device.
words.ex_cn: 键盘是一个外围设备。
words.en: A peripheral activity or issue is one that is not very important compared with other activities or issues.

words.ex: The small village lies on the periphery of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄位于城市的外围。
words.en: The outer limits or edge of an area or object.

words.ex: The smell of bread permeate the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 面包的香味弥漫了整个厨房。
words.en: If something permeates a place, it spreads throughout it.

words.ex: The smell of bread pervades the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 面包的香味弥漫在整个厨房里。
words.en: If something pervades a place or thing, it is present throughout it.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.tr:
n. 猎物；受害者；受骗者；
v. 捕食；坑害；折磨；
words.ex: The lion chased its prey across the plain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在平原上追逐它的猎物。
words.en: An animal that is hunted and killed by another for food.

words.tr:
n. 一系列；（变化）范围；山脉；
v. （在某范围内）变化；包括（各种不同的人或物）；
words.ex: The store offers a range of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供一系列颜色。
words.en: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

words.ex: He retains his old photos in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧照片保存在一个盒子里。
words.en: If you retain something, you keep it or continue to have it.

words.tr: adj. 欠缺的；过小的；少量的
words.ex: He had scanty food for the whole day.
words.ex_cn: 他一整天的食物很少。
words.en: If something is scanty, there is not enough of it or it is too small in amount.

words.tr: adj. 缺乏的；不足的；稀有的；
words.ex: Water is scarce in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠里水很缺乏。
words.en: If something is scarce, there is not enough of it.

words.tr:
n. 小块；碎片；废金属；吵架
v. 废弃；取消
adj. 废弃的
words.ex: He picked up a scrap of paper from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起一张纸片。
words.en: A scrap is a small piece or amount of something, especially one that is left over after the greater part has been used. It can also mean to discard or get rid of something as being no longer useful or necessary.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；严厉的；非常困难的；
words.ex: The storm caused severe damage to the houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对房屋造成了严重的破坏。
words.en: If something is severe, it is very bad or very serious.

words.ex: The severity of the storm caused many power outages.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴的严重性导致了许多停电。
words.en: The severity of something is the degree to which it is serious or severe.

words.tr:
n. 闪光；闪烁；活力
v. 闪光；焕发活力
words.ex: The diamond showed a tiny sparkle in the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 钻石在阳光下显示出一丝闪光。
words.en: If something sparkles, it shines brightly with a lot of small points of light.

words.ex: The sunset was spectacular.
words.ex_cn: 日落非常壮观。
words.en: Something that is spectacular is very impressive or dramatic.

words.tr: n. 引人注目的人或物；溅污的斑点；
words.ex: The new singer became a splash on the music scene.
words.ex_cn: 这位新歌手成为了音乐界引人注目的人物。
words.en: To cause (a liquid) to scatter in drops or small quantities, especially by striking or moving suddenly; to move or strike so as to cause a liquid to scatter in this way.

words.tr:
n. 狂风；暴风雪；大喊大叫
v. 狂风吹袭；哇哇地叫嚷
words.ex: A sudden squall knocked over the small boat.
words.ex_cn: 一阵突如其来的狂风掀翻了小船。
words.en: A squall is a sudden, violent gust of wind or a localized storm, especially one bringing rain, snow, or sleet. It can also refer to a loud, harsh cry or scream.

words.tr:
n. 蜂拥；狂奔；大西部赛马会（美国西部或加拿大）
v. 惊跑；蜂拥
words.ex: The cows ran in a stampede when they heard the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 当牛群听到巨大的噪音时，它们惊慌狂奔。
words.en: A stampede is a situation in which a group of people or animals suddenly start running in a wild and uncontrolled way, often because they are frightened.

words.tr: adj. 完全的；荒凉的；光秃秃的；僵硬的；严厉的
words.ex: There was a stark difference between the two results.
words.ex_cn: 这两个结果之间有完全的差异。
words.en: Stark means complete, severe, or obvious in a way that is impossible to avoid noticing.

words.tr: adj. 陡峭的；急剧升降的；
words.ex: The mountain has a steep path.
words.ex_cn: 这座山有一条陡峭的小路。
words.en: A steep slope or hill is one that is at a sharp angle, rather than being flat or gradual.

words.ex: He sullied his reputation by lying.
words.ex_cn: 他通过撒谎玷污了自己的声誉。
words.en: To sully something means to spoil or reduce the value of something, especially someone's reputation or the purity of something.

words.tr:
v. 旋动；（使）成漩涡；盘旋
n. 漩涡；涡状形
words.ex: The milk swirls in the coffee.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶在咖啡里旋转。
words.en: If something swirls or if you swirl it, it moves around and around quickly.

words.tr:
n. 污染；腐坏；玷污
v. 污染；使腐坏；玷污
words.ex: The water has a taint from the factory waste.
words.ex_cn: 这种水因工厂废料而受到污染。
words.en: If something is tainted, it is affected by something bad or undesirable.

words.ex: He is a temperate person who never shouts.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个温和的人，从不大喊大叫。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as temperate, you mean that it is calm and reasonable, not extreme or emotional.

words.ex: The rain caused a torrent down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 大雨在山间形成了一股急流。
words.en: A torrent is a fast-moving stream of water or other liquid.

words.tr: adj. 骚乱的；喧闹的；热烈的
words.ex: The crowd was tumultuous during the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会上人群喧闹不安。
words.en: A tumultuous event or period of time involves many exciting and confusing events or feelings.

words.ex: The park is in the vicinity of my house.
words.ex_cn: 公园在我家附近。
words.en: The area or region near or about a place; the surrounding district.

words.ex: The void on the page made the text look empty.
words.ex_cn: 页面上的空白让文字看起来空荡荡的。
words.en: If you describe a situation or a feeling as a void, you mean that it seems empty because there is nothing interesting or worthwhile about it.

words.tr:
v. 衰落；减弱；缺；亏
n. 衰退；减弱；缺；亏
words.ex: The moon begins to wane after the full moon.
words.ex_cn: 满月之后，月亮开始变暗。
words.en: If something wanes, it becomes gradually weaker or less, often so that it eventually disappears.

chapters.name: 拥抱自然 地理与环境 认知词

words.ex: The hiker stared into the dark abyss.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者凝视着黑暗的深渊。
words.en: An abyss is a very deep hole in the ground, or a very difficult or unpleasant situation that seems to have no end.

words.ex: The spray can releases an aerosol into the air.
words.ex_cn: 喷雾罐将气溶胶释放到空气中。
words.en: An aerosol is a suspension of fine solid particles or liquid droplets in air or another gas.

words.ex: He works in the aerospace industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在航空航天行业工作。
words.en: The branch of technology and industry concerned with both aviation and space flight.

words.ex: The village is at an altitude of 2,000 meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的海拔是2000米。
words.en: The height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.

words.ex: The restaurant has a calm ambience.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅有一种宁静的氛围。
words.en: The character and atmosphere of a place.

words.tr: n. 异常事物；反常现象；
words.ex: The strange weather this month is an anomaly.
words.ex_cn: 这个月奇怪的天气是一个异常现象。
words.en: Something that deviates from what is standard, normal, or expected.

words.tr:
adj. 南极的；
n. 南极地区；
words.ex: The antarctic ice is melting fast.
words.ex_cn: 南极的冰正在迅速融化。
words.en: The Antarctic is the area around the South Pole, characterized by its cold climate and ice-covered landscapes.

words.tr:
n. 北极地区；
adj. 北极的；
words.ex: Polar bears live in the arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极地区。
words.en: The Arctic is the area around the Earth's North Pole, characterized by cold temperatures and ice.

words.ex: The aroma of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜面包的香味充满了厨房。
words.en: An aroma is a strong, pleasant smell.

words.ex: The flowers are aromatic and fill the garden with scent.
words.ex_cn: 这些花是芳香的，使花园充满香气。
words.en: Having a pleasant and distinctive smell.

words.ex: The astral plane is believed to be a level of existence beyond the physical world.
words.ex_cn: 人们相信星界是超越物质世界的一个存在层面。
words.en: Relating to or resembling the stars.

words.ex: The old house has a mysterious aura.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子有一种神秘的氛围。
words.en: An aura is a distinctive atmosphere or quality that seems to surround and be generated by a person, thing, or place.

words.ex: Applications arrived in an avalanche after the job posting.
words.ex_cn: 职位发布后，申请纷至沓来。
words.en: An avalanche is a large mass of snow, ice, and rocks that falls quickly down the side of a mountain.

words.ex: The Earth rotates around its axis.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕其轴旋转。
words.en: An axis is an imaginary line through the middle of something, especially one that it turns around.

words.ex: The village is a backwater with no modern facilities.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄是个穷乡僻壤，没有现代设施。
words.en: A backwater is a part of a river where the water is stagnant or moves very slowly, or a place that is isolated and not influenced by new ideas or events.

words.ex: Many people jumped on the bandwagon of eco-friendly products.
words.ex_cn: 许多人赶上了环保产品的潮流。
words.en: A bandwagon is an activity, group, movement, etc. that has become successful or fashionable and so attracts many new people.

words.tr:
n. 巨浪；如巨浪翻腾的东西
v. （像巨浪般）汹涌；翻腾
words.ex: The billow crashed against the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 巨浪拍打着岩石。
words.en: A billow is a large wave or surge of water. It can also refer to the act of swelling or rolling like a wave.

words.ex: A blizzard covered the town in snow.
words.ex_cn: 一场暴风雪将整个小镇覆盖在雪中。
words.en: A blizzard is a severe snowstorm with strong winds.

words.ex: The children walked carefully through the bog.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们小心地走过沼泽。
words.en: A bog is an area of wet muddy ground that is too soft to support a heavy body.

words.ex: The soldier wore camouflage to hide in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 士兵穿着伪装服在森林中隐藏自己。
words.en: Camouflage is the way in which some animals are colored and shaped so that they cannot easily be seen in their natural surroundings.

words.ex: A cascade of complaints flooded the office.
words.ex_cn: 大量投诉涌进了办公室。
words.en: A cascade is a small waterfall or a series of small waterfalls. As a verb, it means to flow or fall in or like a cascade.

words.ex: The children explored a dark cavern.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们探索了一个黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: A cavern is a large cave or a large chamber in a cave.

words.ex: The dentist found a cavity in his tooth.
words.ex_cn: 牙医在他的牙齿上发现了一个腔。
words.en: A cavity is a hole or space inside something.

words.ex: The sea was choppy, making it difficult to sail.
words.ex_cn: 海面波涛汹涌，使得航行变得困难。
words.en: If the sea or a river is choppy, the water moves in a lot of small waves because it is windy or because the current is strong.

words.ex: The glass showed a clear cleavage after it fell.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃掉落后出现了明显的裂纹。
words.en: Cleavage refers to the act of splitting or dividing something, especially along a natural line or grain. It can also refer to the space between a woman's breasts, especially as revealed by a low-cut garment.

words.tr: n. 保护；节约（自然资源）；
words.ex: The park is for the conservation of wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是为了保护野生动物。
words.en: The protection and preservation of the natural environment and wildlife.

words.tr: n. 星座；一群杰出人物；一系列（相关的想法、事物）
words.ex: He saw the Orion constellation in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 他在夜空中看到了猎户座。
words.en: A constellation is a group of stars which form a pattern and have a name.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；外形；等高线
v. 画轮廓（画等高线）
adj. 显示轮廓的
words.ex: The map shows the contour of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图显示了山的轮廓。
words.en: The outline of a figure, body, or mass, especially the curved shape of a surface.

words.ex: Salt water causes corrosion on metal.
words.ex_cn: 盐水会导致金属腐蚀。
words.en: Corrosion is the process in which a metal is gradually destroyed by a chemical reaction, usually with oxygen or water.

words.ex: The cosmic rays come from outer space.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙射线来自外太空。
words.en: Relating to the universe or cosmos, especially as distinct from the earth.

words.ex: He loves to watch the cosmos at night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在夜晚观看宇宙。
words.en: The cosmos refers to the universe seen as a well-ordered whole, or to any system or structure that is complex and orderly.

words.ex: The bomb left a deep crater in the road.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹在道路上炸出了一个深深的弹坑。
words.en: A crater is a large hole in the ground, typically caused by an explosion or the impact of a meteorite.

words.ex: The moon looks like a crescent tonight.
words.ex_cn: 今晚的月亮像一弯新月。
words.en: A crescent is a curved shape that is wider in the middle and pointed at the ends, like the shape of the moon in its first or last quarter.

words.ex: The game has a cyclic pattern of wins and losses.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏有输赢循环的模式。
words.en: Something that is cyclic happens in cycles or regularly repeats.

words.ex: The economy has a cyclical pattern of growth and decline.
words.ex_cn: 经济有增长和衰退的周期性模式。
words.en: Relating to or occurring in cycles; regularly repeated.

words.ex: He used a disposable cup for his coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一次性杯子喝咖啡。
words.en: Something that is disposable is intended to be thrown away after use.

words.tr: n. 分解；分裂；溶解；解体；解除；死亡
words.ex: The dissolution of sugar in water is quick.
words.ex_cn: 糖在水中的分解很快。
words.en: The act or process of ending or breaking up an organization, agreement, or legal arrangement.

words.ex: He felt stuck in the doldrums after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到陷入低谷。
words.en: The doldrums are a state of inactivity or stagnation, especially in reference to a period of time or a geographical area known for its calm winds.

words.ex: The children played on the big dune near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海边的大沙丘上玩耍。
words.en: A dune is a hill of sand near the sea or in a desert, formed by the wind.

words.ex: The dustcart comes every Tuesday morning.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾车每周二早上来。
words.en: A dustcart is a vehicle used by local councils to collect household waste.

words.tr:
n. 漩涡；涡流
v. 起漩涡；旋转；杂乱无章地移动
words.ex: The river has a small eddy near the rock.
words.ex_cn: 河里石头附近有一个小漩涡。
words.en: An eddy is a circular movement of water, air, or smoke that is different from the main current.

words.tr: n. 废水；污物；水流 adj. 流出的
words.ex: The factory releases effluent into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂将废水排入河中。
words.en: Effluent is liquid waste material that comes out of factories or sewage works.

words.ex: The embryo grows inside the mother's womb.
words.ex_cn: 胚胎在母亲的子宫内生长。
words.en: An embryo is an unborn animal or human being in the very early stages of development.

words.ex: Malaria is endemic in some parts of Africa.
words.ex_cn: 疟疾在非洲某些地区是地方性的。
words.en: If a disease or condition is endemic in a particular area, it is frequently or regularly found among the people living there.

words.ex: The equator divides the Earth into two halves.
words.ex_cn: 赤道将地球分为两半。
words.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the Earth, equally distant from the North Pole and the South Pole, dividing the Earth into the Northern Hemisphere and the Southern Hemisphere.

words.tr: n. 昼夜平分日（指春分或秋分）
words.ex: The equinox happens in March and September.
words.ex_cn: 春分和秋分发生在三月和九月。
words.en: Either of the two times in the year when the sun crosses the celestial equator, when day and night are of equal length.

words.ex: Water causes erosion of the soil.
words.ex_cn: 水会导致土壤腐蚀。
words.en: The process by which the surface of the earth is worn away by the action of water, glaciers, winds, waves, etc.

words.ex: The exodus of people from the city happened after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 洪水之后，大批人离开了这座城市。
words.en: An exodus is a situation in which many people leave a place at the same time.

words.ex: The expanse of the desert stretched far beyond the horizon.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠的辽阔延伸到了地平线之外。
words.en: An expanse is a wide and open area or surface.

words.tr: adj. 地球外的；地外的；外星球的；
words.ex: The movie shows an extraterrestrial life form.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了一种地球外的生命形式。
words.en: An extraterrestrial is a creature that comes from or exists outside the planet Earth.

words.ex: The area was once a vast fen.
words.ex_cn: 这片区域曾经是一片广阔的沼泽。
words.en: A fen is a type of wetland which accumulates peat deposits. Fens are usually fed by mineral-rich surface water or groundwater. They are characterised by their water chemistry, which is neutral or alkaline, with relatively high dissolved mineral levels but few other plant nutrients.

words.ex: The small house is on a foothill near the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这栋小房子位于山脚下的山坡上。
words.en: A foothill is a low hill at the base of a mountain or mountain range.

words.ex: The fishermen walk on the foreland at low tide.
words.ex_cn: 渔民在低潮时走在前沿地上。
words.en: A foreland is a piece of land that juts out into the sea, often forming a cape or headland.

words.ex: The children were playing on the foreshore, collecting shells.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在前滩上玩耍，收集贝壳。
words.en: The part of a shore that lies between the high-water mark and the low-water mark.

words.tr: adj. 寒冷的；冷淡的；性冷淡的（女子）
words.ex: The water is frigid in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天的水很冰冷。
words.en: Frigid means extremely cold in temperature or lacking warmth or enthusiasm.

words.ex: The frontal bone is at the front of the skull.
words.ex_cn: 额骨位于头骨的前部。
words.en: Relating to the front or facing part of something, especially the forehead or the forward part of the brain.

words.ex: The glacial landscape was covered in snow.
words.ex_cn: 冰河地貌被雪覆盖着。
words.en: relating to, resulting from, or denoting the presence or agency of ice, especially in the form of glaciers.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.tr:
int. 喂；哈喽；
n. “喂”的招呼声或问候声；
words.ex: Hello, can you hear me?
words.ex_cn: 喂，你能听到我吗？
words.en: used as a greeting or to begin a telephone conversation

words.tr: n. 大破坏；大毁坏；大混乱；
words.ex: The storm caused havoc in the small town.
words.ex_cn: 风暴给这个小镇带来了大破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as havoc, you mean that it causes a great deal of disorder, confusion, or destruction.

words.ex: The city was covered in haze this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上这座城市被雾霾笼罩。
words.en: Haze is a light mist or fog, especially one caused by the heat of the sun or by pollution.

words.ex: The lighthouse is on the headland.
words.ex_cn: 灯塔位于海角上。
words.en: A headland is a narrow piece of land that projects from a coastline into the sea.

words.tr: n. 核心地带；中心地区
words.ex: He grew up in the heartland of America.
words.ex_cn: 他在美国的腹地长大。
words.en: The heartland of a country or region is the area that is most important to it in terms of its economy, culture, or politics.

words.ex: The children played on a small hillock near the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边的小山丘上玩耍。
words.en: A hillock is a small hill or mound.

words.ex: The humidifier helps to humidify the dry air.
words.ex_cn: 加湿器有助于使干燥的空气变得湿润。
words.en: To humidify means to add moisture or water vapor to the air or to a gas, making it more humid.

words.ex: The soil has rich humus.
words.ex_cn: 这种土壤富含腐殖质。
words.en: A dark, rich, fertile soil formed by the decomposition of plant and animal matter.

words.ex: An icicle hangs from the roof.
words.ex_cn: 一个冰锥挂在屋顶上。
words.en: An icicle is a pointed piece of ice that is formed when dripping water freezes, typically hanging from a surface.

words.ex: The small village is idyllic with green fields and quiet streams.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄有着绿色的田野和宁静的溪流，十分宁静美好。
words.en: An idyllic place or experience is extremely pleasant, beautiful, and peaceful, often in a way that seems too good to be true.

words.ex: There was a large influx of tourists during the summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天期间涌入了大量游客。
words.en: An influx of people or things is a large number of them arriving somewhere at the same time.

words.ex: The small boat docked at the inlet.
words.ex_cn: 小船停靠在小水湾。
words.en: An inlet is a narrow strip of water that leads from a sea or lake into the land or between islands.

words.ex: The iris of her eye is blue.
words.ex_cn: 她的眼睛虹膜是蓝色的。
words.en: The iris is a flat, colored, ring-shaped membrane behind the cornea of the eye, with an adjustable circular opening (pupil) in the center.

words.ex: The map shows an isotherm at 20 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 地图上标出了20度的等温线。
words.en: A line on a map connecting points having the same temperature at a given time or on average over a given period.

words.tr: n. 废旧杂物；无价值的东西；
words.ex: He cleaned up the junk in his garage.
words.ex_cn: 他清理了车库里那些废旧杂物。
words.en: Old or discarded articles that are considered useless or of little value.

words.ex: The children swam in the clear lagoon.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在清澈的潟湖里游泳。
words.en: A lagoon is a body of water separated from larger bodies of water by a natural barrier such as a sandbar, coral reef, or barrier island.

words.ex: The city is at a latitude of 40 degrees north.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市位于北纬40度。
words.en: Latitude is the distance of a place north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The ship's longitude is 45 degrees west.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船的经度是西经45度。
words.en: Longitude is the distance of a place east or west of the Greenwich meridian, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The lunar surface is covered with dust.
words.ex_cn: 月球表面覆盖着尘土。
words.en: Of or relating to the moon.

words.ex: The statue is made of white marble.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像由白色大理石制成。
words.en: Marble is a type of very hard rock which is used for making statues and for building. It is usually white with dark lines in it.

words.ex: The birds live in a quiet marsh.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟生活在一片宁静的沼泽中。
words.en: A marsh is an area of low-lying land which is flooded in wet seasons or at high tide, and typically remains waterlogged at all times.

words.ex: His metabolism is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 他的新陈代谢非常快。
words.en: Metabolism is the set of life-sustaining chemical transformations within the cells of living organisms.

words.tr:
n. 泥潭；泥沼；困境
v. 使陷进泥坑里
words.ex: The car got stuck in the mire.
words.ex_cn: 汽车陷在泥沼里了。
words.en: Mire refers to an area of wet, soggy ground or a difficult situation from which it is hard to extricate oneself.

words.ex: The soil is moist after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后土壤是潮湿的。
words.en: Slightly wet; damp or humid.

words.ex: She uses cream to moisturize her skin.
words.ex_cn: 她用乳霜来滋润皮肤。
words.en: To moisturize means to add moisture to something, especially to the skin, to prevent it from becoming dry.

words.ex: The monsoon brings heavy rain to India each summer.
words.ex_cn: 季风每年夏天给印度带来大雨。
words.en: A monsoon is a seasonal wind in South and Southeast Asia, blowing from the southwest between May and September and bringing rain (the wet monsoon), or from the northeast between October and April (the dry monsoon).

words.ex: The children built a mound of sand at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海滩上堆了一个沙土墩。
words.en: A mound is a large pile of earth or stones; it can also refer to the action of piling up earth or stones.

words.ex: The Nordic countries have strong welfare systems.
words.ex_cn: 北欧国家拥有完善的社会福利体系。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of Scandinavia or its peoples, languages, or cultures.

words.ex: The travelers found an oasis with water and trees.
words.ex_cn: 旅行者们发现了一个有水和树木的绿洲。
words.en: An oasis is a small area in a desert where water and plants are found, making it a place of relief and beauty in an otherwise barren landscape.

words.tr: adj. 西洋的；西方的；欧美的；
words.ex: He likes occidental music more than traditional Chinese music.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢西洋音乐而不是中国传统音乐。
words.en: Relating to the countries of the West, especially Europe and America.

words.ex: She wore a ring with an opal that sparkled in the light.
words.ex_cn: 她戴着一枚镶有猫眼石的戒指，在光线下闪闪发亮。
words.en: A gemstone consisting of a form of hydrated silica, typically semi-transparent and showing many small points of shifting colour against a pale or dark ground.

words.tr: adj. 东方的（尤指中国和日本）
words.ex: He bought an oriental rug at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一张东方地毯。
words.en: Oriental is used to describe things that come from or are associated with eastern Asia, especially China and Japan.

words.ex: They live on the outskirts of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市的郊区。
words.en: The outskirts of a city or town are the parts of it that are farthest away from its center.

words.ex: The peninsula is surrounded by water on three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个半岛三面环水。
words.en: A peninsula is a piece of land that is almost entirely surrounded by water but is connected to the mainland on one side.

words.tr: adj. 平静的；宁静的；温和的；
words.ex: The lake was placid in the morning light.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的阳光下，湖面平静无波。
words.en: A placid person or animal is calm and does not easily become excited, angry, or upset.

words.tr:
n. 平原；
adj. 简单明了的；朴素的；
words.ex: The cows graze on the plain.
words.ex_cn: 牛在平原上吃草。
words.en: If something is plain, it is easy to see, hear, or understand.

words.ex: The sheep graze on a high plateau.
words.ex_cn: 羊群在高高原上吃草。
words.en: A plateau is a large area of high and fairly flat land. It can also refer to a period during which there are no large changes.

words.ex: The polar bear lives in the Arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极。
words.en: relating to the North or South Pole or to the region around it; having opposite extremes or characteristics.

words.ex: The polarity of the magnet is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这个磁铁的极性很清晰。
words.en: Polarity refers to the state of having two opposite or contradictory tendencies, opinions, or aspects.

words.ex: The factory releases a pollutant into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向河里排放一种污染物。
words.en: A pollutant is a substance that pollutes something, especially air, water, or soil.

words.tr: adj. 人口众多的；人口密集的
words.ex: China is a populous country.
words.ex_cn: 中国是一个人口众多的国家。
words.en: If a place is populous, it has a large population.

words.tr: n. 流沙；陷阱；危险而捉摸不定的事物
words.ex: The boy got stuck in quicksand.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩陷在流沙里了。
words.en: Quicksand is an area of loose wet sand that you sink into if you walk on it.

words.ex: The river flows through a deep ravine.
words.ex_cn: 河流流经一个深谷。
words.en: A ravine is a deep, narrow gorge with steep sides, often carved by a river or stream.

words.ex: He is greedy and always wants more candy.
words.ex_cn: 他很贪婪，总是想要更多的糖果。
words.en: If you describe someone as greedy, you mean that they want to have more of something such as food or money than is necessary or fair.

words.ex: He felt sad after the rejection.
words.ex_cn: 在遭到拒绝后，他感到很难过。
words.en: The act of refusing to accept, believe in, or agree with something.

words.ex: The quiet park is restful after a long day.
words.ex_cn: 漫长的一天后，安静的公园有助于休息。
words.en: A restful place or period of time is one that is peaceful and allows you to relax.

words.tr:
v. （使）成波浪状；（使）起涟漪；作潺潺声 
n. 微波；涟漪；潺潺声
words.ex: The wind ripples the surface of the lake.
words.ex_cn: 风使湖面泛起波浪。
words.en: If something ripples, it moves in small waves or if you ripple it, you make it move in small waves.

words.tr: adj. 喧闹的；欢闹的；令人激动的
words.ex: The party was a rip-roaring success.
words.ex_cn: 派对非常成功，热闹非凡。
words.en: If you describe something as rip-roaring, you mean that it is very exciting and full of energy.

words.tr:
v. 吼叫；咆哮
n. 吼叫；咆哮
words.ex: The lion let out a loud roar.
words.ex_cn: 狮子发出了一声响亮的咆哮。
words.en: If something roars, it makes a very loud noise, like the sound of a lion.

words.ex: The scarcity of water caused problems in the village.
words.ex_cn: 水的缺乏给村庄带来了问题。
words.en: A scarcity of something is a situation in which there is not enough of it.

words.ex: The scenic lake attracted many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 风景优美的湖泊吸引了许多游客。
words.en: Relating to or resembling scenery; picturesque.

words.tr:
n. 浮渣；泡沫；社会渣滓
v. 去除浮渣
words.ex: The scum on the pond's surface was disturbing.
words.ex_cn: 池塘表面的浮渣令人不安。
words.en: A layer of dirt or froth on the surface of a liquid.

words.ex: Rivers carry sediment to the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流把沉积物带到大海。
words.en: Material that settles to the bottom of a liquid; matter that has been deposited by some natural process.

words.ex: She sits in the garden with serenity.
words.ex_cn: 她坐在花园里，内心平静。
words.en: The state of being calm, peaceful, and untroubled.

words.ex: The city cleaned the sewage from the streets.
words.ex_cn: 城市清理了街道上的污水。
words.en: Sewage is waste matter such as faeces or dirty water from homes and factories, which flows away through sewers.

words.ex: The city improved its sewerage system last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市去年改进了其排水系统。
words.en: The system of removing waste water and human excrement from homes and other buildings, and the waste material that is removed.

words.tr:
adj. 浅的
n. 浅水处；鱼群；一大群
v. （使）变浅
words.ex: The boat ran aground on the shoal.
words.ex_cn: 船在浅水处搁浅了。
words.en: A shoal is a large number of fish swimming together. It can also refer to a shallow place in a body of water.

words.ex: He climbed the sierra with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友们爬了山。
words.en: A sierra is a mountain range, especially in Spain or Spanish America.

words.ex: The river deposited silt on the banks.
words.ex_cn: 河流在河岸上沉积了淤泥。
words.en: Silt is fine sand, soil, or mud which is carried along by a river and then left on the land.

words.ex: The slime at the bottom of the river smells bad.
words.ex_cn: 河底的污泥闻起来很难闻。
words.en: Slime is a thick, wet, slippery substance, often unpleasant to touch.

words.tr:
adj. 温暖舒适的；紧密的；紧身的；贴身的
n. 酒馆内的雅间
words.ex: The cottage was snug and warm, perfect for a winter retreat.
words.ex_cn: 这间小屋舒适温暖，是冬季度假的完美之地。
words.en: If you feel snug or are in a snug place, you are very warm and comfortable, especially because you are protected from cold or danger.

words.tr:
n. 草地；草坪；草皮
v. 铺草皮于
words.ex: The children played on the sod after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在草地上玩耍。
words.en: Sod refers to a piece of grassy turf or the act of covering the ground with such turf.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.ex: The ship sailed through the strait at night.
words.ex_cn: 船在夜间通过了海峡。
words.en: A strait is a narrow passage of water connecting two seas or two large areas of water.

words.tr: n. 岩层；地层；社会阶层
words.ex: The geologist examined the stratum for fossils.
words.ex_cn: 地质学家检查了岩层以寻找化石。
words.en: A stratum is a layer of material, naturally or artificially formed, often one of a number of parallel layers one upon another.

words.ex: He has a streak of kindness that makes everyone like him.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种善良的性情，让每个人都喜欢他。
words.en: A streak is a long thin mark that is a different colour from the surfaces next to it. It can also refer to a period of time during which a particular kind of behaviour or activity is consistently shown.

words.ex: The stream flows quietly through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 小溪静静地流过森林。
words.en: A stream is a small, narrow river. It can also refer to a continuous flow of liquid, air, or gas, or a continuous flow of data or information.

words.ex: The tiger has black stripes on its orange fur.
words.ex_cn: 老虎的橙色皮毛上有黑色条纹。
words.en: A stripe is a long, narrow band or strip differing in color or texture from the surface on either side of it.

words.ex: The trees surround the house.
words.ex_cn: 树木环绕着房子。
words.en: If something or someone is surrounded by something, that thing is situated all around them.

words.ex: The swamp is full of tall grass and frogs.
words.ex_cn: 这个沼泽里长满了高草和青蛙。
words.en: A swamp is an area of low-lying, uncultivated ground where water collects; a bog or marsh.

words.ex: The hikers struggled across the rough terrain.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者艰难地穿越了崎岖的地形。
words.en: Terrain is used to refer to an area of land or a type of land when you are considering its physical features.

words.ex: The terrestrial animals live on land.
words.ex_cn: 陆地动物生活在陆地上。
words.en: Of, on, or relating to the earth.

words.ex: The thermal blanket keeps you warm.
words.ex_cn: 这个保暖毯让你暖和。
words.en: relating to heat or temperature

words.ex: We heard thunder during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间我们听到了雷声。
words.en: the loud noise that you hear during a storm, usually after a flash of lightning

words.ex: A loud thunderclap woke me up.
words.ex_cn: 一声响亮的雷声把我吵醒了。
words.en: A thunderclap is the sudden loud noise that comes from the sky during a storm.

words.tr: adj. 炎热的；炽热的；情欲强烈的
words.ex: The torrid sun burned the dry land.
words.ex_cn: 炎热的太阳炙烤着干涸的土地。
words.en: If you describe something as torrid, you mean that it is very hot and dry.

words.tr: n. 大片土地；体内管道；
words.ex: The farmer owns a large tract of land near the river.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有靠近河边的一大片土地。
words.en: A tract is a large area of land or a system of connected organs in the body.

words.tr: n. 黄昏；薄暮；暮光；衰退期
words.ex: The birds fly home at twilight.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黄昏时飞回家。
words.en: The time of day immediately following sunset, or the period of time at the end of the day when the sun is just below the horizon, especially the period between sunset and dark.

words.tr:
adj. 向上游的；
adv. 向上游；
words.ex: The fish swam upstream to lay eggs.
words.ex_cn: 鱼逆流而上产卵。
words.en: In the direction that is opposite to the flow of a stream or river.

words.ex: The vernal equinox marks the beginning of spring.
words.ex_cn: 春分标志着春天的开始。
words.en: Relating to or occurring in spring.

words.ex: The water forms a vortex down the drain.
words.ex_cn: 水在排水口形成一个漩涡。
words.en: A vortex is a mass of wind or water that spins around very fast and pulls objects into its empty center.

words.ex: The kids created a whirlwind in the living room.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在客厅里弄出了一片忙乱。
words.en: A whirlwind is a tall, spinning column of air that moves across the land or water surface, often causing destruction. It can also refer to a very intense or fast-paced situation or activity.

words.ex: She bought a wicker basket for the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 她为野餐买了一个柳条篮子。
words.en: Wicker is the material made from weaving thin branches or twigs, especially from willows, used to make baskets, furniture, etc.

chapters.name: 人文社会 语言文学 重点词

words.ex: She accentuates the first syllable when she says the word.
words.ex_cn: 她说这个词时重读第一个音节。
words.en: To accentuate something means to emphasize it or make it more noticeable.

words.ex: He used an analogy to explain how the heart works.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个类比来解释心脏是如何工作的。
words.en: If you make or draw an analogy between two things, you show that they are similar in some way.

words.ex: He posted an anonymous comment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在网上发布了一条匿名评论。
words.en: If you remain anonymous when you do something, you do not let people know that you were the person who did it.

words.ex: He can articulate his ideas clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他能清楚地表达自己的想法。
words.en: If you describe someone as articulate, you mean that they are able to express their thoughts and ideas easily and clearly.

words.ex: The whisper was barely audible.
words.ex_cn: 那耳语几乎听不见。
words.en: If a sound is audible, it is loud enough for you to hear it.

words.ex: The brevity of his speech surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他讲话的短暂让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: Brevity is the use of only a few words to say something, or the quality of being short in time.

words.tr:
n. 漫画；讽刺画；滑稽模仿
v. 画成漫画讽刺
words.ex: He drew a caricature of the teacher with big eyes.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一幅老师大眼睛的漫画。
words.en: A caricature is a drawing or description of someone that exaggerates their appearance or behavior in a humorous or critical way.

words.tr: n. 性格；人物角色；特点；
words.ex: His character is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的性格善良且有耐心。
words.en: The combination of qualities or features that distinguishes one person, group, or thing from another.

words.tr:
adj. 典范的；典型的；
n. 文学经典；名著；优秀的典范；
words.ex: This movie is a classic comedy.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部典范的喜剧。
words.en: A classic is something that is judged to be of the highest quality and outstanding of its kind.

words.ex: The climax of the movie was a big chase scene.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的高潮是一场大追捕场景。
words.en: The climax is the most exciting or important part of a play, film, or piece of music, which usually happens near the end.

words.ex: Children develop cognitive skills as they grow.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在成长过程中发展认知能力。
words.en: Cognitive means relating to the mental process involved in knowing, learning, and understanding things.

words.ex: His speech was coherent and easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲连贯且易于理解。
words.en: If something is coherent, it is well planned, so that it is clear and sensible and all its parts go well with each other.

words.ex: The team showed cohesive behavior during the project.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队在项目期间表现出有凝聚力的行为。
words.en: If something is cohesive, it consists of parts that fit together well and form a united whole.

words.ex: Measles is a communicable disease.
words.ex_cn: 麻疹是一种会传染的疾病。
words.en: A communicable disease is one that can be passed from one person or animal to another.

words.ex: The book has a compact design.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的设计很紧凑。
words.en: A compact object or substance is small and dense, with all its parts closely packed together.

words.ex: He compiles data from many surveys.
words.ex_cn: 他汇编来自许多调查的数据。
words.en: To compile means to collect information from different places and arrange it in a book, report, or list.

words.ex: He compresses the file to save space.
words.ex_cn: 他压缩文件以节省空间。
words.en: To compress something means to press it or squeeze it so that it takes up less space.

words.ex: The word 'home' connotes comfort and safety.
words.ex_cn: ‘家’这个词意味着舒适和安全。
words.en: If a word or name connotes something, it makes you think of a particular idea or quality.

words.tr: v. 到达…的顶点；达到高潮；告终
words.ex: The concert culminated with a loud fireworks show.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会以一场响亮的烟花表演结束。
words.en: If an event or series of events culminates in something, it ends with it, having developed until it reaches this point.

words.tr: v. 慷慨陈词；高声朗诵
words.ex: He likes to declaim poetry in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在全班面前朗诵诗歌。
words.en: To declaim means to speak or recite something in a dramatic or impassioned way, often in public.

words.ex: He will delineate the plan clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他将清晰地描述这个计划。
words.en: To delineate something means to describe or portray it precisely.

words.ex: The symbol x denotes an unknown number.
words.ex_cn: 符号 x 表示一个未知数。
words.en: If one thing denotes another, it is a sign or indication of it.

words.ex: The painting depicts a quiet village at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画描绘了一个宁静的村庄在日落时分的景象。
words.en: To depict someone or something means to show or represent them in a work of art such as a drawing or painting.

words.ex: He is an eminent scientist who won the Nobel Prize.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位获得诺贝尔奖的杰出科学家。
words.en: An eminent person is well-known and respected, especially because they are good at their profession.

words.ex: He wrote a short epigram about love.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一首关于爱情的短小警句。
words.en: A short poem or sentence that expresses something such as a feeling or idea in a short and clever or funny way.

words.ex: She is the epitome of kindness.
words.ex_cn: 她是善良的典型。
words.en: A person or thing that is a perfect example of a particular quality or type.

words.ex: The essence of love is caring for others.
words.ex_cn: 爱的本质是关心他人。
words.en: The essence of something is its basic and most important characteristic which gives it its individual identity.

words.ex: The movie glorifies violence as heroism.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影美化了暴力，将其视为英雄主义。
words.en: To glorify someone or something means to praise them or make them seem more important or better than they really are.

words.tr: n. 有文化修养的人；有高雅趣味的人；
words.ex: He is a highbrow who loves classical music and old novels.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有文化修养的人，喜欢古典音乐和古典小说。
words.en: A highbrow person or thing is interested in or concerned with intellectual or cultural matters, often to the exclusion of more practical or popular interests.

words.tr: adj. 可想象的；可能的；可想到的
words.ex: That was the worst thing imaginable.
words.ex_cn: 那是所能想象到的最糟糕的事情。
words.en: If something is imaginable, you are able to imagine it or believe that it could exist or happen.

words.tr:
adj. 化身的；人体化的
v. 化身为；体现
words.ex: He is the incarnate form of justice.
words.ex_cn: 他是正义的化身。
words.en: If you say that someone is a quality incarnate, you mean that they represent that quality or are typical of it in an extreme form.

words.ex: It's an irony that the fire station burned down.
words.ex_cn: 消防站着火了，这真是讽刺。
words.en: Irony is a subtle form of humor which involves saying things that you do not mean.

words.ex: He is a legendary basketball player.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位传奇的篮球运动员。
words.en: Something or someone that is legendary is very famous and is often talked about in a way that suggests they are almost mythical.

words.ex: The handwriting is legible and easy to read.
words.ex_cn: 字迹清晰，容易辨认。
words.en: If writing or print is legible, it is clear enough to read.

words.ex: He uses simple lexical items in his writing.
words.ex_cn: 他在写作中使用简单的词汇项。
words.en: Relating to the words or vocabulary of a language.

words.ex: He took his words in a literal sense.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的话按字面意思理解。
words.en: If you describe something as the literal truth or a literal fact, you are emphasizing that it is true.

words.ex: He is literally the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他确实是队里最好的球员。
words.en: In a literal manner or sense; exactly.

words.ex: Calling time a thief is a metaphor.
words.ex_cn: 把时间称为小偷是一种隐喻。
words.en: A metaphor is a figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to an object or action to which it is not literally applicable.

words.tr: n. 独白；独角戏；长篇大论
words.ex: He gave a monologue on stage.
words.ex_cn: 他在舞台上发表了一段独白。
words.en: A monologue is a long speech by one person, especially in a play or film, or a long speech by one person during a conversation.

words.ex: The toy store sells many novelty items for children.
words.ex_cn: 玩具店出售许多为儿童设计的新奇物品。
words.en: The quality of being new, original, or unusual; something new, original, or unusual.

words.ex: He wrote an ode to his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的母亲写了一首颂歌。
words.en: A lyric poem, typically one in the form of an address to a particular subject, written in varied or irregular meter.

words.ex: This is the optimal time to plant flowers.
words.ex_cn: 这是种植花卉的最佳时间。
words.en: Most favorable or desirable; best.

words.ex: Phonology is the study of how sounds are organized and used in languages.
words.ex_cn: 音韵学是研究语言中声音如何组织和使用的学科。
words.en: Phonology is the study of the way sounds function in particular languages or in languages generally, including the study of phonemes, syllable structure, stress, accent, and intonation.

words.tr: adj. 务实的；实事求是的；
words.ex: He took a pragmatic approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他采取了务实的方法来解决问题。
words.en: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical rather than theoretical considerations.

words.ex: He is a prolific writer who publishes books every year.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位多产的作家，每年都会出版书籍。
words.en: A prolific artist, writer, or composer produces a large number of works of art, books, or pieces of music.

words.ex: The book begins with a short prologue.
words.ex_cn: 这本书以一个简短的序言开始。
words.en: A prologue is an introduction to a book, play, or other written work that sets the scene or provides background information.

words.ex: The engineer built a prototype of the new car.
words.ex_cn: 工程师制作了这辆新车的原型。
words.en: A prototype is the first or original example of something that has been or will be copied or developed; it is a model or preliminary version.

words.ex: The renaissance brought new art and ideas to Europe.
words.ex_cn: 文艺复兴为欧洲带来了新的艺术和思想。
words.en: The Renaissance was a period in European history marking the transition from the Middle Ages to modernity and covering the 15th and 16th centuries, characterized by an effort to revive and surpass ideas and achievements of classical antiquity.

words.ex: The bridge collapsed due to resonance from the wind.
words.ex_cn: 桥梁因风引起的共振而坍塌。
words.en: Resonance is the quality in a sound of being deep, full, and reverberating.

words.tr:
v. 潦草地写；涂写
n. 潦草的笔迹
words.ex: He scrawled his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上潦草地写了自己的名字。
words.en: If you scrawl something, you write it in a careless and untidy way.

words.ex: He wrote a script for a short movie.
words.ex_cn: 他为一部短片写了剧本。
words.en: A script is the written form of a play, film, or broadcast. It includes the dialogue and stage directions.

words.ex: The word 'bank' has different semantic meanings.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'bank' 有不同的语义含义。
words.en: Semantic is used to describe something that relates to the meanings of words and sentences.

words.ex: He is learning semantics in his linguistics class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在语言学课上学习语义学。
words.en: Semantics is the study of meaning in language, including the ways in which words and sentences convey information.

words.ex: The child made a syntactic error in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在句子中犯了一个句法错误。
words.en: relating to or according to the rules of syntax

words.ex: She transcended her fears to speak on stage.
words.ex_cn: 她超越了自己的恐惧，在舞台上发言。
words.en: If something transcends normal limits or boundaries, it goes beyond them, because it is more significant than them.

words.tr:
adj. 本国的；地方的
n. 方言；土语
words.ex: He wrote the poem in the vernacular language.
words.ex_cn: 他用本国语言写了这首诗。
words.en: The vernacular is the language or dialect spoken by the ordinary people in a particular country or region.

words.ex: He writes a verse every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上写一首诗。
words.en: A verse is one of the parts into which a poem, a song, or a chapter of the Bible or the Koran is divided.

chapters.name: 人文社会 语言文学 认知词

words.ex: He abbreviates the word 'example' as 'ex.'.
words.ex_cn: 他把单词 'example' 缩写为 'ex.'。
words.en: To abbreviate something means to make it shorter, especially by using a particular word or phrase to represent it.

words.ex: He used an abbreviation for 'company' in his note.
words.ex_cn: 他在笔记中用了'company'的缩写。
words.en: An abbreviation is a shortened form of a word or phrase.

words.ex: The story is an allegory about kindness.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事是一个关于善良的寓言。
words.en: An allegory is a story, poem, or picture which can be interpreted to reveal a hidden meaning, typically a moral or political one.

words.tr: n. 暗指；影射；间接提及
words.ex: He made an allusion to Shakespeare in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中提到了莎士比亚。
words.en: An allusion is an indirect reference to someone or something.

words.tr: n. 变位词（相同字母异序词）
words.ex: He solved the anagram quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解出了这个字谜。
words.en: An anagram is a word or phrase formed by rearranging the letters of a different word or phrase, typically using all the original letters exactly once.

words.ex: This old phone is an analogue of the new smartphone.
words.ex_cn: 这部旧手机是这款智能手机的类似物。
words.en: Something that is similar to another thing in design, origin, use, etc., but not exactly the same.

words.ex: He uses a fake name for anonymity.
words.ex_cn: 他用假名来保持匿名。
words.en: The condition of being anonymous; the state of not having one's name or identity known.

words.ex: He read an anthology of short stories last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了一本短篇故事选集。
words.en: An anthology is a collection of writings, such as poems or stories, that have been chosen by someone because they are considered to be the best or most interesting examples of their kind.

words.tr: adj. 感激的；欣赏的；表示赞赏的
words.ex: She was appreciative of his help.
words.ex_cn: 她对他的帮助心怀感激。
words.en: If you are appreciative of something, you are grateful for it.

words.ex: The hero in the story is an archetype of courage.
words.ex_cn: 故事中的英雄是勇气的原型。
words.en: An archetype is a very typical example of a certain person or thing.

words.tr:
n. 亲笔签名；亲笔稿
v. 亲笔签名于；亲笔书写
words.ex: He asked the singer for an autograph.
words.ex_cn: 他向歌手要了一张签名。
words.en: An autograph is a person's own signature, especially that of a famous person, or a manuscript in the author's own handwriting.

words.ex: The baby babbles when she is happy.
words.ex_cn: 当宝宝开心时，她会含糊不清地说话。
words.en: To babble means to talk rapidly and continuously in a foolish, excited, or incomprehensible way.

words.ex: He sang a old ballad about love and war.
words.ex_cn: 他唱了一首关于爱情与战争的老民谣。
words.en: A ballad is a type of song that tells a story, often a folk song or a slow romantic song.

words.tr: adj. 两种语言的；用两种语言的；
words.ex: He is a bilingual student who speaks English and Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个会说英语和西班牙语的双语学生。
words.en: A bilingual person is someone who can speak two languages equally well.

words.ex: He used a blotter to soak up the ink.
words.ex_cn: 他用吸墨纸吸干墨水。
words.en: A blotter is a piece of blotting paper in a pad, used especially in offices for soaking up ink or drying wet writing.

words.ex: He blurted out the secret by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心说出了秘密。
words.en: If someone blurts something, they say it suddenly, after trying hard to keep quiet or to keep it secret.

words.ex: He moved up to a higher bracket after his promotion.
words.ex_cn: 他升职后进入了更高的等级。
words.en: A bracket is a piece of metal, wood, or plastic that is fastened to a wall in order to support something such as a shelf. In writing, brackets are symbols that are used to separate words or numbers.

words.tr: n. 布莱叶盲文（点字法）
words.ex: The book was printed in braille for visually impaired readers.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是为视力受损的读者用布莱叶盲文印刷的。
words.en: A system of writing for blind people in which characters are represented by patterns of raised dots that are felt with the fingertips.

words.tr: n. 小配角；小品文；浮雕宝石
words.ex: She appeared in a cameo role in the film.
words.ex_cn: 她在电影中扮演了一个配角。
words.en: A cameo is a small but noticeable part in a film or play, often played by a famous actor or actress. It can also refer to a piece of jewelry consisting of a raised design on a background of a different color.

words.tr: adj. 引人注目的；动人的；
words.ex: The song has a catchy melody.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌的旋律引人注目。
words.en: A catchy tune or phrase is pleasing and easy to remember.

words.tr: adj. 绝对的；确定无疑的；分类的
words.ex: He gave a categorical no to the offer.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个提议给出了明确的拒绝。
words.en: If you are categorical about something, you state your views very definitely and firmly.

words.ex: He listens to classical music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听古典音乐。
words.en: Classical refers to music, literature, or art that is considered to be of the highest quality and of lasting value, especially from the ancient Greek or Roman periods or from the 18th and early 19th centuries.

words.ex: He used a cliche to describe the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个陈词滥调来形容日落。
words.en: A cliché is an idea or phrase that has been used so much that it is no longer interesting or effective.

words.ex: The climactic scene of the movie surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 电影的高潮场景让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: Relating to the most intense, exciting, or important point of something; reaching a climax.

words.ex: The word 'home' has a warm connotation.
words.ex_cn: ‘家’这个词有温暖的含义。
words.en: An idea or feeling that a word invokes in addition to its literal or primary meaning.

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.ex: The linguist analyzed the English corpus to find common phrases.
words.ex_cn: 语言学家分析了英语语料库以寻找常用短语。
words.en: A corpus is a large collection of written or spoken texts that is used for language research.

words.tr:
adj. 克里奥尔语的；
n. 克里奥尔人（尤指居住在西印度群岛的欧洲人和非洲人的混血儿）；克里奥尔语
words.ex: She spoke with a Creole accent.
words.ex_cn: 她说话带有克里奥尔口音。
words.en: A creole is a stable natural language developed from a mixture of different languages. Creole languages are usually formed in situations where people who do not share a common language are forced to communicate with each other.

words.ex: The word 'this' is a determiner.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'this' 是一个限定词。
words.en: A determiner is a word that is used before a noun to show which particular example of the noun you are referring to.

words.tr: n. 宣言；声明；格言；警句
words.ex: The judge's dictum was clear and final.
words.ex_cn: 法官的宣言清晰而最终。
words.en: A dictum is a formal pronouncement from an authoritative source; it can also be a short statement that expresses a general truth or principle.

words.ex: The word 'boy' has a diphthong.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'boy' 包含一个双元音。
words.en: A diphthong is a sound made by combining two vowels, specifically when it starts as one vowel sound and goes to another, within the same syllable.

words.tr: adj. 分离（性）的；（指连词）转折的
words.ex: The two ideas are disjunctive and cannot be combined.
words.ex_cn: 这两个想法是分离的，无法结合。
words.en: A disjunctive word or phrase is one that indicates a separation or contrast between the parts of a sentence.

words.tr: adj. 史诗的；叙事诗的；宏丽的；
words.ex: The movie tells an epic story of heroes and dragons.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影讲述了一个关于英雄和龙的史诗故事。
words.en: An epic is a long book, poem, or film, whose story extends over a long period of time or tells of great events.

words.ex: The epilog showed what happened to the characters after the story ended.
words.ex_cn: 尾声展示了故事结束后角色们的命运。
words.en: An epilog is a section or speech at the end of a book or play, which serves as a comment on or a conclusion to what has happened.

words.ex: The epilogue showed what happened to the characters after the story ended.
words.ex_cn: 尾声展示了故事结束后角色们的命运。
words.en: An epilogue is a section or speech at the end of a book or play that serves as a comment on or a conclusion to what has happened.

words.tr: n. 爱斯基摩人；爱斯基摩语；
words.ex: The eskimo lives in a snow house.
words.ex_cn: 爱斯基摩人住在雪屋里。
words.en: An Eskimo is a member of the indigenous people of the Arctic regions of Canada, Greenland, Alaska, and eastern Siberia, known for their traditional way of life adapted to extreme cold.

words.ex: He gave a eulogy for his grandmother.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的祖母致了悼词。
words.en: A eulogy is a speech or piece of writing that praises someone or something highly, typically someone who has just died.

words.ex: He used a euphemism to say he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个委婉语来表示他失业了。
words.en: A euphemism is a polite word or expression that is used to refer to things which people may find upsetting or embarrassing to talk about.

words.ex: He used a euphemistic word to say he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个委婉的词来表示他失业了。
words.en: If you describe language as euphemistic, you mean that it is indirect or substitutes mild terms for ones that are considered too harsh, blunt, or offensive.

words.tr:
n. 摘录；摘要
v. 摘录；引用
words.ex: He read an excerpt from the book.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书的一段摘录。
words.en: An excerpt is a short piece of writing or music which is taken from a larger piece.

words.ex: He shouted an exclamation of surprise.
words.ex_cn: 他惊讶地喊了一声。
words.en: An exclamation is a sound, word, or sentence that is spoken suddenly, loudly, or emphatically and that expresses excitement, admiration, shock, or anger.

words.ex: The teacher gave an explanatory note to help students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个解释性的笔记来帮助学生。
words.en: Serving or intended to explain or make clear.

words.ex: The character is fictitious and does not exist in real life.
words.ex_cn: 这个角色是虚构的，现实中不存在。
words.en: Fictitious means invented and not true or not existing.

words.ex: The monster was just a figment of his imagination.
words.ex_cn: 那个怪物只是他想象出来的。
words.en: A figment is something that someone imagines or invents, often something that is not real.

words.tr: adj. 比喻的；象征的；写实的
words.ex: He used figurative language to describe his feelings.
words.ex_cn: 他用了比喻性的语言来描述他的感受。
words.en: If you use a word or expression in a figurative sense, you use it with a more abstract or imaginative meaning than its ordinary literal one.

words.tr: n. 扉页；（书籍前后的）白页
words.ex: He wrote his name on the flyleaf of the book.
words.ex_cn: 他在书的衬页上写了自己的名字。
words.en: A flyleaf is a blank page at the beginning or end of a book, especially one that is next to the inside cover.

words.ex: The foreword explains why the book was written.
words.ex_cn: 序言解释了这本书为何被撰写。
words.en: A foreword is a short introduction at the beginning of a book, usually written by someone other than the author.

words.ex: He is a freelance graphic designer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名自由职业的平面设计师。
words.en: A freelance person is someone who does particular pieces of work for different organizations, rather than working all the time for a single organization.

words.tr:
adj. 全身的；拖地的；标准长度的
adv. （身体）伸展开
words.ex: He wore a full-length mirror to check his outfit.
words.ex_cn: 他穿上一身全身镜来检查自己的穿着。
words.en: Full-length is used to describe something such as a film, play, or book that is not shortened or cut in any way.

words.ex: The teacher explained the generative rules of sentence structure.
words.ex_cn: 老师解释了句子结构的生成规则。
words.en: Generative refers to the ability to produce or create something, often used in the context of technologies or systems that can generate new content, ideas, or solutions.

words.tr: adj. 喉咙的；咽喉的；粗嘎的
words.ex: He spoke in a guttural voice, which was hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种刺耳的喉音说话，让人很难理解。
words.en: A guttural sound is one that is produced in the throat.

words.tr: v. 劈砍；侵入（计算机等）
words.ex: He hacked the tree with an axe.
words.ex_cn: 他用斧头劈砍那棵树。
words.en: To hack means to cut or chop something with rough or heavy blows, or to gain unauthorized access to data in a system or computer.

words.tr: n. 硬封面的书；精装本
words.ex: He bought a hardback book for school.
words.ex_cn: 他为学校买了一本精装书。
words.en: A hardback is a book which has a stiff cover, usually made of cardboard covered in cloth or leather.

words.ex: Ancient Egyptians wrote in hieroglyphics.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人用象形字书写。
words.en: Hieroglyphics are symbols in the form of pictures which are used in some writing systems, especially those of ancient Egypt.

words.ex: He speaks Hindi at home with his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他在家和父母说印地语。
words.en: Hindi is one of the major languages of India, spoken by a large number of people as a first language and by many more as a second language. It is written in the Devanagari script and is one of the two official languages of the Government of India, alongside English.

words.tr: adj. 西班牙的；西班牙和葡萄牙的；拉丁美洲的
words.ex: He is a Hispanic student from Spain.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名来自西班牙的西班牙裔学生。
words.en: relating to Spain or to Spanish-speaking countries, especially those of Latin America.

words.ex: The snake made a loud hiss.
words.ex_cn: 蛇发出了响亮的嘶嘶声。
words.en: To make a sharp sound like that of the letter s prolonged, as a snake does, or as steam does when forced under pressure through a small opening.

words.ex: Please hyphenate the words 'well-being'.
words.ex_cn: 请把 'well-being' 这两个词用连字符连接。
words.en: To hyphenate means to join words or syllables with a hyphen.

words.tr: n. 变音；转调；曲折变化
words.ex: The dog's voice has a happy inflection.
words.ex_cn: 狗的声音带着愉快的语调。
words.en: Inflection refers to the modification of a word to express different grammatical categories such as tense, case, voice, aspect, person, number, gender, and mood.

words.ex: Her intercession helped to resolve the conflict.
words.ex_cn: 她的调解帮助解决了冲突。
words.en: Intercession is the act of intervening on behalf of another, especially in prayer.

words.tr: n. 感叹词；插入之语词
words.ex: He shouted 'Wow!' as an interjection.
words.ex_cn: 他喊了一声‘哇！’作为感叹词。
words.en: An interjection is a word or phrase that expresses a strong feeling or emotion, such as surprise, pleasure, or anger, and is often used in speech to interrupt or emphasize a statement.

words.ex: The bird sang intransitively.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟唱了，没有宾语。
words.en: An intransitive verb is a verb that does not take a direct object.

words.ex: He used too much jargon in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中用了太多行话。
words.en: Special words or expressions that are used by a particular profession or group and are difficult for others to understand.

words.tr:
n. 叮当声；广告歌
v. （使）发出叮当声
words.ex: The bells make a happy jingle in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天里，铃铛发出愉快的叮当声。
words.en: A jingle is a short, simple tune, often with words, that is used to advertise a product or service on the radio or television.

words.ex: The legend says a dragon lives in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 传说有一条龙住在山里。
words.en: A legend is a very old and popular story that may be true or may be imaginary.

words.ex: He works in lexicography at a dictionary company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家词典公司从事词典编纂工作。
words.en: Lexicography is the activity or profession of writing dictionaries.

words.ex: The lexis of the poem is rich and varied.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的词汇丰富多样。
words.en: The total stock of words in a language.

words.ex: He loves reading literary books.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读文学书籍。
words.en: Literary means concerned with or connected with the writing, study, or appreciation of literature.

words.tr:
n. 抒情诗；歌词
adj. 抒情的
words.ex: He wrote a lyric about the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一首关于日落的抒情诗。
words.en: Lyric refers to the words of a song, especially a popular song, or to a short poem that expresses personal feelings and thoughts.

words.tr:
n. 虚构；虚幻；假装
adj. 假装的；虚构的
words.ex: The children play with make-believe dragons.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们玩假想的龙。
words.en: Make-believe is the activity of pretending that something is real or true, especially in children's play.

words.ex: The painting is considered a masterpiece by art critics.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画被艺术评论家视为杰作。
words.en: A masterpiece is a work of art such as a painting, film, or book that is made with great skill and is considered to be the best work of a particular artist or writer.

words.ex: He always follows the maxim 'work hard, play hard'.
words.ex_cn: 他总是遵循‘努力工作，尽情玩耍’这一信条。
words.en: A maxim is a short, easily remembered expression of a basic principle, general truth, or rule of conduct.

words.ex: He wrote a memoir about his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一本关于自己童年的回忆录。
words.en: A memoir is a book or article that you write about someone who you have known, describing what you remember of them and of particular events in which you both took part.

words.ex: He is monolingual and only speaks English.
words.ex_cn: 他只会说英语，不懂其他语言。
words.en: Using or knowing only one language.

words.tr: n. 神话；神话学；神话集；
words.ex: He loves reading Greek mythology.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读希腊神话。
words.en: Mythology is a collection of myths, especially one belonging to a particular religious or cultural tradition.

words.tr:
n. 叙述；叙事；
adj. 叙述性的；
words.ex: He told a simple narrative about his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了一个关于他童年的简单故事。
words.en: A narrative is a story or an account of a series of events.

words.ex: He has a nasal voice when he has a cold.
words.ex_cn: 他感冒时声音有鼻音。
words.en: Nasal is used to describe something relating to the nose or the production of sound through the nose.

words.ex: The building has a neoclassical style with white columns.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑有着带有白色柱子的新古典主义风格。
words.en: Neoclassical refers to a revival of classical styles or influence in art, literature, architecture, or music.

words.ex: The math teacher explained the notation for fractions.
words.ex_cn: 数学老师讲解了分数的记号。
words.en: A system of symbols, letters, or words used to represent something, especially in mathematics, music, or science.

words.ex: He noticed the nuance in her voice.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了她声音中的细微差别。
words.en: A very slight difference in meaning, sound, color, or someone's feelings that is not usually very obvious.

words.tr: n. 欧米加（希腊字母的最后一个字）；最后
words.ex: The teacher wrote omega on the board.
words.ex_cn: 老师在黑板上写了 omega。
words.en: The last letter of the Greek alphabet, often used to denote the end or the ultimate limit of something.

words.ex: The word 'buzz' is an example of onomatopoeia.
words.ex_cn: 单词'buzz'是拟声的一个例子。
words.en: The formation of a word from a sound associated with what is named.

words.tr: n. 编号作品；乐曲；艺术作品
words.ex: The composer's latest opus has received critical acclaim.
words.ex_cn: 这位作曲家的最新作品获得了评论界的好评。
words.en: An opus is a creative work, especially a musical composition or set of compositions numbered in order of publication.

words.ex: The report gives an overview of the project.
words.ex_cn: 这份报告对项目进行了概述。
words.en: An overview is a general summary or review of a subject.

words.ex: The pronunciation of this word involves a palatal sound.
words.ex_cn: 这个词的发音涉及到一个腭音。
words.en: Relating to the palate or the roof of the mouth; (of a sound) made with the blade of the tongue touching the hard palate.

words.ex: The parable of the Good Samaritan teaches compassion and kindness.
words.ex_cn: 好撒玛利亚人的寓言教导了同情和善良。
words.en: A simple story used to illustrate a moral or spiritual lesson, as told by Jesus in the Gospels.

words.ex: This experiment is a paradigm of scientific method.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验是科学方法的范例。
words.en: A paradigm is a model or pattern that is considered to be a typical example of something.

words.tr: adj. 作为插入语的；补充说明的
words.ex: He added a parenthetical note to explain the date.
words.ex_cn: 他加了一个括号内的注释来解释日期。
words.en: A parenthetical remark or section is one that is added to a speech or piece of writing, often as an explanation or afterthought.

words.ex: The word 'running' is a participle.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'running' 是一个分词。
words.en: A participle is a form of a verb that is used in a sentence to modify a noun, noun phrase, verb, or verb phrase, and thus plays a role similar to an adjective or adverb.

words.ex: The storm personifies anger with loud thunder.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴用雷声拟人化了愤怒。
words.en: To represent a thing or abstraction as a person; to embody in a person.

words.ex: They communicated using a pidgin English.
words.ex_cn: 他们使用一种混杂的英语进行交流。
words.en: A pidgin is a simplified language that develops as a means of communication between two or more groups that do not have a language in common.

words.tr: adj. 死后的；死后出版的；遗腹的
words.ex: He received a posthumous award for his bravery.
words.ex_cn: 他因勇敢而被追授了奖项。
words.en: Posthumous means occurring, awarded, or appearing after the death of the originator.

words.tr: n. 附言；附录；补充说明
words.ex: He added a postscript to his letter.
words.ex_cn: 他在信后加了一段附言。
words.en: A postscript is a note appended to a finished letter, article, or book.

words.ex: He read the preface before starting the book.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始读这本书之前读了序言。
words.en: A preface is an introduction at the beginning of a book, which explains what the book is about or why it was written.

words.tr:
n. 前缀
v. 在…前面加
words.ex: He adds a prefix to the word to change its meaning.
words.ex_cn: 他在单词前加上前缀来改变它的意思。
words.en: A prefix is a letter or group of letters added at the beginning of a word to change its meaning.

words.ex: The quiet music was a prelude to the loud concert.
words.ex_cn: 轻柔的音乐是盛大音乐会的前奏。
words.en: A prelude is an introductory piece of music, event, or action that comes before a more important one.

words.tr:
n. 双关语
v. 说双关语
words.ex: He made a bad pun and everyone groaned.
words.ex_cn: 他开了个蹩脚的玩笑，大家都皱起了眉头。
words.en: A pun is a clever and amusing use of a word or phrase with two meanings, or of words with the same sound but different meanings.

words.ex: He forgot the punctuation in his sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记在句子中加标点符号了。
words.en: Punctuation refers to the marks used in writing to separate sentences and their elements and to clarify meaning.

words.tr: n. 合格者；限定词；预选赛
words.ex: He is a qualifier for the final race.
words.ex_cn: 他是进入决赛的选手。
words.en: A qualifier is a word or phrase, especially an adjective, that you use to describe another word in order to limit its meaning or to make it less general.

words.ex: In logic, a quantifier is used to express the quantity of individuals for which a predicate holds.
words.ex_cn: 在逻辑学中，量词用于表达谓词所适用的个体数量。
words.en: A quantifier is a word or phrase which is used before a noun to indicate the amount or quantity.

words.tr: adj. 修辞性的；词藻华丽的；反问的
words.ex: He asked a rhetorical question to make a point.
words.ex_cn: 他问了一个修辞性的问题来阐明观点。
words.en: A rhetorical question is one which is asked in order to make a statement rather than to get an answer.

words.ex: He loves romanticism in old poems.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢旧诗歌中的浪漫主义。
words.en: Romanticism is a movement in the arts and literature which originated in the late 18th century, emphasizing inspiration, subjectivity, and the primacy of the individual.

words.ex: He told a long saga about his grandfather's adventures.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了一个关于他祖父冒险的漫长故事。
words.en: A long, detailed story of connected events, especially one that is passed from one generation to the next.

words.tr: n. 可能发生的情况；设想；
words.ex: It's a possible scenario that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天会下雨是一个可能发生的情况。
words.en: A scenario is a description of a possible course of action or events.

words.ex: This book has five sections.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有五个部分。
words.en: A section of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.ex: The movie had a sequel that came out last year.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影有一部去年上映的续集。
words.en: A sequel is a book, film, or play that continues the story of a previous one.

words.ex: He used a simile to compare her eyes to stars.
words.ex_cn: 他用了明喻把她的眼睛比作星星。
words.en: A simile is a figure of speech that directly compares two different things, usually by employing the words 'like' or 'as'.

words.tr: adj. 好用俚语的；俗话多的
words.ex: He uses slangy words when talking to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友聊天时用很口语化的词。
words.en: Using or containing slang; characteristic of slang.

words.ex: The poem has four stanzas.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗有四节。
words.en: A stanza is a group of lines in a poem that are separated from other groups by a space.

words.tr:
n. 超现实主义者
adj. 超现实主义的
words.ex: He is a surrealist painter.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位超现实主义画家。
words.en: A surrealist is someone who creates or appreciates surrealism, an artistic and literary movement that seeks to release the creative potential of the unconscious mind, for example by the irrational juxtaposition of images.

words.ex: The word 'baby' has two syllabic sounds.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'baby' 有两个音节。
words.en: Relating to or consisting of a syllable or syllables.

words.ex: The dove is a symbol of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
words.en: A symbol is a shape or design that is used to represent something such as an idea, a quality, or a process.

words.ex: Happy is synonymous with joyful.
words.ex_cn: 快乐与喜悦是同义的。
words.en: If you say that one thing is synonymous with another, you mean that the two things are very closely associated with each other so that one suggests the other or one cannot exist without the other.

words.ex: He gave a synopsis of the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他简要介绍了这部电影。
words.en: A synopsis is a brief summary or general survey of something.

words.ex: He gave a synoptic view of the history.
words.ex_cn: 他对历史做了概括性的概述。
words.en: Relating to or constituting a synopsis; presenting a summary or general view of a whole.

words.ex: He learned syntax from his English teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他从英语老师那里学习了句法。
words.en: Syntax is the grammatical arrangement of words in a sentence.

words.ex: Her terse reply left no room for further discussion.
words.ex_cn: 她简洁的回答没有留下进一步讨论的余地。
words.en: A terse statement or comment is brief and to the point, often seeming rude or unfriendly because of its brevity.

words.ex: The textual evidence supports the author's argument.
words.ex_cn: 文本证据支持作者的观点。
words.en: Relating to or based on a text.

words.ex: I will protect thee from all harm.
words.ex_cn: 我会保护你免受一切伤害。
words.en: Thee is an archaic or dialect form of 'you', used as the object of a verb or preposition.

words.ex: The movie has a thematic focus on friendship.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的主题聚焦于友谊。
words.en: Relating to or constituting a theme or themes.

words.ex: Thy book is on the table.
words.ex_cn: 你的书在桌子上。
words.en: Used as the possessive form of 'thou', equivalent to 'your' in modern English.

words.ex: He watched the Harry Potter trilogy last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他上周末看了《哈利·波特》三部曲。
words.en: A trilogy is a series of three books, plays, or films that have the same subject or the same characters.

words.tr:
adj. 逐字的；一字不差的
adv. 逐字地；一字不差地
words.ex: He repeated the words verbatim.
words.ex_cn: 他一字不差地重复了那些话。
words.en: Using exactly the same words as were used originally.

words.tr: n. 小花饰；简介；（表演）片段
words.ex: She drew a small vignette on the corner of the letter.
words.ex_cn: 她在信的角落画了一个小花饰。
words.en: A vignette is a brief evocative description, account, or episode.

words.ex: She spoke vocally against the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 她大声反对这项新规定。
words.en: In a way that relates to the voice or is expressed by speaking.

words.tr:
adj. 呼格的（语法）
n. 呼格（词）
words.ex: He used 'friend' as a vocative in his letter.
words.ex_cn: 他在信中用'朋友'作为呼语。
words.en: The vocative case is a grammatical case used for a noun that identifies a person (animal, object, etc.) being addressed and/or is the subject of the sentence.

words.tr: adj. 宽松的；容积大的；部头大的；卷数多的
words.ex: She wore a voluminous dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条宽松的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is voluminous is very large or contains a lot of things.

words.tr: n. 措辞；用词； v. “word”的现在分词；
words.ex: The wording of the notice was clear.
words.ex_cn: 通知的措辞很清晰。
words.en: The way in which words are used to express something, especially in a document or speech.

chapters.name: 人文社会 品味艺术 重点词

words.ex: She adorned her room with flowers.
words.ex_cn: 她用鲜花装饰了房间。
words.en: To adorn something means to make it more beautiful by adding something to it.

words.ex: A problem arose during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议中出现了一个问题。
words.en: If a situation or problem arises, it begins to exist or people start to become aware of it.

words.tr:
n. 试听；试唱；试演；听力
v. 试听；试音；试镜；让…试演
words.ex: He went to an audition for the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加学校话剧的试听。
words.en: An audition is a short performance given by an actor, dancer, or musician so that someone can decide if they are good enough to be in a play, film, or orchestra.

words.ex: The scientist made a breakthrough in cancer research.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家在癌症研究中取得了突破。
words.en: A breakthrough is a significant development or achievement that helps to solve a problem or improve a situation.

words.ex: The view from the mountain is breathtaking.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色令人惊叹。
words.en: If you say that something is breathtaking, you mean that it is extremely beautiful or amazing.

words.tr:
adj. 简短的；简明的；短暂的；
v. 为…提供信息；
n. 摘要；概要；
words.ex: He gave a brief answer.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个简短的答案。
words.en: If something is brief, it lasts only for a short time.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.ex: He composes music in his spare time.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间创作音乐。
words.en: To compose something means to make it by combining parts or elements.

words.ex: The farmer used a drone to check his crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民用无人驾驶飞机检查他的庄稼。
words.en: A drone is a male bee that does not work and exists solely to mate with the queen bee. It can also refer to an unmanned aircraft or ship guided by remote control or onboard computers. Additionally, 'drone' can describe a continuous low humming sound or to speak in a monotonous tone.

words.tr: adj. 惊恐的；恶臭的；时髦的；放克风格的
words.ex: The children felt funky when they heard the loud thunder.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们听到巨大的雷声时感到惊恐。
words.en: Having a strong dance rhythm, in particular that of funk. Also, stylish in an unconventional or quirky way.

words.tr: adj. 锋利的；骤变的；灵敏的；尖刻的；
words.ex: The knife is sharp enough to cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀足够锋利，可以切纸。
words.en: Having a thin edge or a fine point that is capable of cutting or piercing; keen.

words.ex: He tried to impersonate a police officer.
words.ex_cn: 他试图冒充一名警察。
words.en: To impersonate someone means to pretend to be that person, either to deceive people or to entertain them.

words.tr:
adj. 巡回的；流动的
n. 四处奔波的人；流浪者
words.ex: The itinerant worker moves from town to town for jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这位流动工人为了工作从一个城镇搬到另一个城镇。
words.en: Someone who is itinerant travels from place to place, usually because they have no permanent home or job, or because they are involved in a particular activity that requires this.

words.ex: The child mimics her mother's voice.
words.ex_cn: 孩子模仿她妈妈的声音。
words.en: If someone or something mimics another person or thing, they try to be like them or copy their behavior or characteristics.

words.tr: v. 改编为管弦乐；策划；精心安排
words.ex: He orchestrated the folk song for a symphony orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他将这首民歌改编为管弦乐。
words.en: To orchestrate something means to organize or arrange it in a very detailed and carefully planned way, especially in order to achieve a particular effect or result.

words.tr: n. 受公众注意的程度；简介；轮廓；
words.ex: The celebrity's profile rose after the TV interview.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人经过电视采访后，受公众注意的程度提高了。
words.en: A profile is a side view of something, especially a person's face, or a brief description of someone or something.

words.tr:
v. （声音）颤抖
n. 颤抖的声音
words.ex: His voice quavers when he is nervous.
words.ex_cn: 当他紧张时，他的声音会颤抖。
words.en: If someone's voice quavers, it is unsteady because the person is uncertain, nervous, or upset.

words.tr:
n. 说唱乐
v. 说唱；敲击
words.ex: He loves to rap about his life in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢说唱自己在城市里的生活。
words.en: A type of music characterized by rhythmic and/or rhyming speech that is chanted or rapped.

words.ex: The rendition of the song by the singer moved everyone.
words.ex_cn: 歌手对这首歌的演出打动了所有人。
words.en: A rendition of a play, poem, or piece of music is a performance of it.

words.ex: She tied the box with a thin string.
words.ex_cn: 她用一根细线把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A string is a thin piece of rope or cord, or a series of things connected together.

words.ex: The drummer changed the tempo of the song.
words.ex_cn: 鼓手改变了这首歌的拍子。
words.en: The speed at which a piece of music is played or the rate or speed of motion or activity.

words.ex: The lab technician transcribes the DNA sequence into RNA.
words.ex_cn: 实验室技术员将DNA序列转录成RNA。
words.en: To transcribe something means to write it down or to copy it from one form of recording to another.

words.tr: n. 多才多艺；多样性；多功能
words.ex: The tool shows great versatility in different tasks.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具在不同任务中表现出极大的多功能性。
words.en: The ability to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities.

chapters.name: 人文社会 品味艺术 认知词

words.ex: The pianist is the accompanist for the singer.
words.ex_cn: 这位钢琴家是歌手的伴奏者。
words.en: An accompanist is a musician who plays a part in supporting a singer or another musician, especially by playing the piano.

words.tr: n. 音响；声学；音响效果；
words.ex: The room has good acoustics for music.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的音响效果适合音乐。
words.en: Acoustics is the scientific study of sound, including its production, transmission, and effects.

words.ex: He studies architecture at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习建筑学。
words.en: Architecture is the art and science of designing buildings and other physical structures.

words.ex: Noah built an ark to save animals from the flood.
words.ex_cn: 诺亚建造了一艘方舟来拯救动物免受洪水之灾。
words.en: An ark is a large boat mentioned in the Bible, built by Noah to save his family and two of every kind of animal from the Flood.

words.ex: He wrote an autobiographic book about his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一本关于自己童年的自传体书籍。
