words.en: Indigenous people or things belong to the country in which they are found, rather than coming there or being brought there from another country.

words.tr: v. 大批出没于；成群滋扰；遍布于；寄生
words.ex: The bugs infest the old house.
words.ex_cn: 这些虫子侵袭了这栋老房子。
words.en: If creatures such as insects or rats infest a place, they are present in large numbers and usually cause damage or disease.

words.ex: The teacher tried to infuse confidence into the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师试图向学生注入信心。
words.en: If you infuse a quality into someone or something, you fill them with it. If a quality infuses something, it is present throughout it.

words.ex: The teacher will inspect our homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会检查我们的作业。
words.en: If you inspect something, you look at it very carefully, usually in order to find out something about it.

words.ex: The colors intermingle in the painting.
words.ex_cn: 画中的颜色混合在一起。
words.en: If things intermingle, they mix together or are mixed together.

words.ex: Oil helps to lubricate the engine parts.
words.ex_cn: 油有助于润滑发动机部件。
words.en: To apply a substance such as oil or grease to (something) in order to minimize friction and allow smooth movement.

words.ex: He tried to manipulate the results to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他试图操纵结果来赢得比赛。
words.en: To manipulate something means to handle or control it skillfully, often in a way that is considered unfair or dishonest.

words.tr:
n. 制造；
v. （用机器大量）制造；虚构；捏造；
words.ex: The manufacture of cars needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的制造需要很多工人。
words.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

words.ex: The dog gave a small nip to his leg.
words.ex_cn: 狗轻轻咬了他的腿一口。
words.en: To nip means to pinch, squeeze, or bite something quickly and sharply. It can also refer to taking a small amount of a drink.

words.tr:
n. 光泽；上光剂；
v. 擦亮；润色；
words.ex: The polish of the wooden table made it shine.
words.ex_cn: 木桌的光泽让它闪闪发亮。
words.en: If you polish something, you make it smooth and shiny by rubbing it with a cloth or a special substance. Polish is also a substance that you use to make things smooth and shiny.

words.tr: adj. 富有成效的；多产的；生产的；
words.ex: He had a productive day and finished all his work.
words.ex_cn: 他度过了富有成效的一天，完成了所有工作。
words.en: Producing or able to produce large amounts of goods, crops, or other commodities.

words.ex: The proportion of students who passed the test was high.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生比例很高。
words.en: A proportion is a part of a whole, or the relationship of one part to another in terms of size, amount, or degree.

words.tr:
n. 耙子；耙地机
v. 用耙子耙；扫掠过；搜索
words.ex: He uses a rake to collect leaves.
words.ex_cn: 他用耙子收集树叶。
words.en: A rake is a garden tool consisting of a row of metal or wooden teeth attached to a long handle. You use a rake to make the earth level or to gather leaves together.

words.tr:
n. 后部；
v. 饲养；抚养；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: The rear of the car was damaged in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的后部在事故中受损了。
words.en: The back part of something, especially a building or vehicle; to bring up and care for a child until they are fully grown.

words.tr: v. 要求归还；收回；开垦；感化
words.ex: He wants to reclaim his lost wallet.
words.ex_cn: 他想要要求归还他丢失的钱包。
words.en: If you reclaim something that you have lost or that has been taken away from you, you succeed in getting it back. If you reclaim land, you make it suitable for use, for example by draining it or by getting rid of unwanted buildings or plants.

words.ex: He refines his writing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天完善自己的写作。
words.en: To refine something means to make it purer or to improve it, especially by removing unwanted substances or by making small changes.

words.ex: The rain rendered the road slippery.
words.ex_cn: 雨水使道路变得滑溜。
words.en: To render something means to cause it to become or to provide it. It can also mean to express or translate something.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.tr:
n. 奖励；报酬；
v. 奖励；回报；
words.ex: He got a reward for winning the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他因赢得比赛而得到了奖励。
words.en: Something given or received in return for a deed or service rendered.

words.tr: n. 车辙；刻板乏味的生活；发情期
words.ex: The car got stuck in a deep rut.
words.ex_cn: 汽车陷在了一个深沟里。
words.en: A rut is a deep, narrow mark made in the ground by a wheel, or a fixed and usually boring way of life or state of mind.

words.tr:
n. 睡眠；
v. 睡觉；
words.ex: He needs more sleep to feel better.
words.ex_cn: 他需要更多的睡眠来感觉好些。
words.en: Sleep is the natural state of rest in which your eyes are closed, your body is inactive, and your mind is unconscious.

words.ex: A sliver of wood stuck in his finger.
words.ex_cn: 一小片木头扎进了他的手指。
words.en: A sliver is a small, thin piece of something that has been cut, broken, or torn off from a larger piece.

words.ex: The children played on the slope behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的斜坡上玩耍。
words.en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.tr:
n. 喷口；水管；水柱
v. 喷出；滔滔不绝地说
words.ex: The kettle has a small spout for pouring water.
words.ex_cn: 这个水壶有一个小喷口用来倒水。
words.en: If something spouts liquid or fire, or if liquid or fire spout out of something, it comes out very quickly with a lot of force.

words.ex: Exercise can strengthen your muscles.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的肌肉。
words.en: To strengthen something means to make it stronger or more effective.

words.ex: The wind strews leaves on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 风把树叶吹得满地都是。
words.en: To scatter or spread things untidily over a surface or area.

words.tr:
n. 东西；原料；
v. 塞；填充；
words.ex: I need to clean up all this stuff.
words.ex_cn: 我需要清理这些东西。
words.en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly. If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it completely with that thing.

words.ex: One apple will suffice for now.
words.ex_cn: 一个苹果现在就足够了。
words.en: If something suffices, it is enough to achieve a purpose or to fulfill a need.

words.ex: We have sufficient food for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们有足够的食物用于这次旅行。
words.en: If something is sufficient for a particular purpose, there is enough of it for the purpose.

words.ex: He surpassed his brother in math scores.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学成绩上超过了他弟弟。
words.en: If one person or thing surpasses another, the first is better than, or has more of a particular quality than, the second.

words.tr: v. 暂停；中止；延期； suspending
words.ex: The school will suspend the class due to snow.
words.ex_cn: 由于下雪，学校将暂停课程。
words.en: If you suspend something, you delay it or stop it from happening for a while or until a decision is made about it.

words.tr:
v. （使）旋转
n. 转环；旋轴
words.ex: The chair can swivel easily.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子可以轻松旋转。
words.en: A swivel is a device that allows something to turn around freely, or to turn something around freely.

words.ex: The mechanic checked the throttle on the car engine.
words.ex_cn: 机械师检查了汽车发动机的节流阀。
words.en: To throttle someone means to kill or injure them by squeezing their throat or tightening something around it and preventing them from breathing. A throttle is a device that controls the amount of fuel going into an engine.

words.tr:
v. 染上点颜色
n. 一丝痕迹；色调
words.ex: The sky has a tinge of pink at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空有一丝粉红色。
words.en: A tinge of a colour, feeling, or quality is a small amount of it.

words.ex: He unraveled the knotted string.
words.ex_cn: 他把打结的绳子拆散了。
words.en: To unravel means to separate or disentangle the threads of a fabric or a rope, or to solve or explain something that is complicated or mysterious.

words.tr:
v. 生产；获利；
n. 产量；
words.ex: This farm yields a lot of wheat each year.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每年生产大量小麦。
words.en: If you yield to someone or something, you stop resisting them. If a tree or plant yields fruit or flowers, it produces them.

chapters.name: 社会万象 工农业 认知词

words.ex: This food contains a harmless additive for flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物含有用于调味的无害添加物。
words.en: An additive is a substance which is added in small amounts to something else in order to improve it, preserve it, or make it more effective.

words.tr:
n. 附属物；
adj. 附属的；
words.ex: The printer is an adjunct to the computer.
words.ex_cn: 打印机是电脑的附属物。
words.en: Something that is added or attached to something else but is not essential to it.

words.ex: He is learning alchemy from an old book.
words.ex_cn: 他正从一本旧书中学习炼金术。
words.en: Alchemy is an ancient practice that aimed to transform base metals into gold and to discover a universal cure for disease and a way of extending life.

words.ex: Lye is a strong alkali used in cleaning.
words.ex_cn: 氢氧化钠是一种用于清洁的强碱。
words.en: An alkali is a chemical compound that neutralizes acids to form salts and turns red litmus paper blue.

words.ex: God is almighty and can do anything.
words.ex_cn: 上帝是全能的，能做任何事。
words.en: The Almighty is used to refer to God. It can also describe something that has very great power or influence.

words.ex: The kitchen has a new washing appliance.
words.ex_cn: 厨房里有一台新的洗衣机。
words.en: An appliance is a device or machine that is used to perform a particular task, especially in the home.

words.tr: n. 人工制品；手工艺品；加工品
words.ex: The museum has an ancient artifact.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有一件古代文物。
words.en: An artifact is an object that is made by a person, especially something of historical or cultural interest.

words.ex: The artisan makes handmade pottery.
words.ex_cn: 这位工匠制作手工陶器。
words.en: An artisan is someone who makes things by hand, especially using traditional methods.

words.ex: The ship took on ballast to stay stable in rough water.
words.ex_cn: 船为了在恶劣水域中保持稳定，装载了压舱物。
words.en: Ballast is heavy material that is carried in a ship or hot-air balloon to make it more stable.

words.ex: The bakery made a new batch of bread this morning.
words.ex_cn: 这家面包店今天早上做了一批新面包。
words.en: A batch is a quantity or consignment of goods produced at one time.

words.ex: The remote needs a new battery.
words.ex_cn: 遥控器需要新电池。
words.en: A battery is a device that produces electricity to provide power for radios, cars, toys, etc.

words.tr:
n. 哔哔声
v. 发哔哔声
words.ex: The machine bleeped when the button was pressed.
words.ex_cn: 当按钮被按下时，机器发出了哔哔声。
words.en: A bleep is a short high-pitched sound, especially one that is made by an electronic device.

words.ex: The email was bogus and tried to steal my password.
words.ex_cn: 这封邮件是假的，试图窃取我的密码。
words.en: If you describe something as bogus, you mean that it is not genuine, true, or real.

words.tr: n. 软帽；汽车发动机罩；阀帽
words.ex: The girl wore a white bonnet to the church.
words.ex_cn: 这个女孩戴着一顶白色软帽去教堂。
words.en: A bonnet is a type of hat that is tied under the chin and was traditionally worn by women and girls. It can also refer to the metal cover over the engine of a car.

words.ex: The enzyme acts as a catalyst in the reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶在反应中充当催化剂。
words.en: A catalyst is a substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without itself undergoing any permanent chemical change. In a broader sense, it can also refer to a person or thing that precipitates a change.

words.tr:
n. 陶瓷制品；陶瓷器；
adj. 陶质的；制陶的；
words.ex: He bought a ceramic bowl at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个陶瓷碗。
words.en: Ceramic is a hard material that is made by baking clay or similar substances at high temperatures. It is used to make things such as tiles, dishes, and statues.

words.tr:
n. 铬；铬合金；铬黄
v. 镀以铬
words.ex: Chrome is a metal used in car parts.
words.ex_cn: 铬是一种用于汽车零件的金属。
words.en: Chrome is a hard, shiny metal that is used to cover other metals to prevent them from rusting and to make them look more attractive.

words.ex: The children played near the cinder pile after the fire.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在火堆后的煤渣堆旁玩耍。
words.en: A cinder is a small piece of partly burnt coal or wood that has stopped giving off flames but still has combustible matter in it.

words.ex: He used a clamp to hold the wood together.
words.ex_cn: 他用夹具把木头固定在一起。
words.en: A clamp is a device that holds two things firmly together. As a verb, to clamp means to hold or fasten something tightly.

words.ex: The cog turned slowly in the machine.
words.ex_cn: 齿轮在机器中缓慢转动。
words.en: A cog is a wheel with teeth around its edge that is used to transmit motion from one part of a machine to another.

words.ex: The engine has four cylinders.
words.ex_cn: 发动机有四个气缸。
words.en: A cylinder is a geometric figure with straight parallel sides and a circular or oval cross section.

words.ex: He wears a jacket made of dacron.
words.ex_cn: 他穿一件由涤纶制成的夹克。
words.en: Dacron is a type of polyester fiber used especially in clothing and home furnishings.

words.ex: The sun can dehydrate your skin quickly.
words.ex_cn: 太阳会很快使你的皮肤脱水。
words.en: To dehydrate something means to remove all the water from it, often in order to preserve it. If you dehydrate, you lose too much water from your body, usually because of illness or extreme heat.

words.tr: n. 抑制因素；阻尼器；风阀；制音器；令人扫兴的人（或物）
words.ex: High prices are a damper on consumer spending.
words.ex_cn: 高价是消费支出的抑制因素。
words.en: A damper is a device that reduces vibration or noise, or something that reduces the strength or effectiveness of something else.

words.tr:
v. 织补
n. 织补
words.ex: She darned her socks with blue thread.
words.ex_cn: 她用蓝色线织补了她的袜子。
words.en: To darn means to repair a hole in a piece of clothing by sewing stitches across the hole.

words.ex: The oil derrick stands tall on the desert.
words.ex_cn: 油井架矗立在沙漠上。
words.en: A derrick is a large machine used in the oil industry for drilling wells, consisting of a tall framework over a borehole, used to support the drilling equipment.

words.tr: adj. 可拆下的；可分开的
words.ex: The keyboard is detachable from the tablet.
words.ex_cn: 这个键盘可以从平板上拆下来。
words.en: If something is detachable, it is designed to be removed from the thing it is attached to.

words.ex: The passengers disembark at the port.
words.ex_cn: 乘客们在港口上岸。
words.en: To disembark means to leave a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle.

words.ex: The old tool fell into disuse after the new one was invented.
words.ex_cn: 新工具发明后，旧工具就被弃而不用了。
words.en: The state of not being used or practiced anymore.

words.tr:
n. 同上；同上符号；很相似的东西
adv. 也一样
words.ex: He likes coffee, and she likes ditto.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，她也喜欢同样的。
words.en: Used to indicate that something already said is applicable a second time.

words.ex: The city improved its drainage system after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 洪水之后，这座城市改进了它的排水系统。
words.en: Drainage is the system or process by which water or other liquids are drained from a place.

words.tr:
v. 疏浚；挖掘
n. 挖泥船；疏浚机
words.ex: They dredge the river to remove mud.
words.ex_cn: 他们疏浚河流以清除淤泥。
words.en: To dredge means to remove mud, sand, or other material from the bottom of a river, lake, etc., in order to make it deeper or to search for something.

words.tr:
n. 导管；管道；管子
v. 通过管道输送
words.ex: The air flows through the duct.
words.ex_cn: 空气通过管道流动。
words.en: A duct is a pipe or tube through which liquid or gas flows.

words.tr:
n. 染料；
v. 给...染色；
words.ex: She bought a natural dye to color her fabric.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一种天然染料来给布料染色。
words.en: A dye is a substance used to change the color of something permanently. To dye something means to change its color by applying a dye.

words.ex: The old factory uses a dynamo to produce electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这家老工厂使用一台发电机来发电。
words.en: A dynamo is a device for converting mechanical energy into electrical energy, typically by rotating coils of copper wire in a magnetic field.

words.tr: adj. 大量挖土的；掘土的
words.ex: The workers used earth-moving machines to dig the foundation.
words.ex_cn: 工人们使用土方机械挖掘地基。
words.en: Relating to or involved in the excavation and moving of large quantities of soil.

words.ex: The workers did earthwork to build a new road.
words.ex_cn: 工人们进行了土方工程来修建一条新路。
words.en: An earthwork is a large artificial bank of soil, especially one built as a fortification.

words.ex: The rubber band shows great elasticity when stretched.
words.ex_cn: 橡皮筋被拉伸时表现出很大的弹性。
words.en: The ability of an object or material to resume its normal shape after being stretched or compressed.

words.tr:
v. 电镀
n. 电镀物品
words.ex: He electroplates the metal with silver.
words.ex_cn: 他用电镀法在金属上镀一层银。
words.en: To coat (a metal object) by electrolytic deposition with a surface layer of a different metal.

words.ex: The river overflowed and broke the embankment.
words.ex_cn: 河水泛滥，冲垮了堤坝。
words.en: An embankment is a thick wall of earth that is built to carry a road or railway over an area of low ground, or to prevent water from a river or the sea from flooding an area.

words.ex: Poverty can engender crime.
words.ex_cn: 贫困会引起犯罪。
words.en: To cause a feeling, situation, or condition to exist.

words.tr: n. （拉丁美洲的）大牧场或大庄园
words.ex: The children play on the estancia with cows and horses.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在牧场里和牛马一起玩耍。
words.en: In Latin America, a large estate or ranch, especially one used for raising cattle.

words.ex: The dog follows its owner every day.
words.ex_cn: 狗每天跟随它的主人。
words.en: To go or come after (a person or thing proceeding ahead); move or travel behind.

words.ex: He uses fertilizer to help his plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥料帮助植物生长。
words.en: A substance that is added to soil to improve the growth of plants.

words.ex: The fishery near the coast provides fresh seafood.
words.ex_cn: 沿海的渔场提供新鲜海产。
words.en: A fishery is an area where fish are caught for commercial purposes, or the industry of catching and selling fish.

words.tr: v. 符合；“fit”的现在分词； adj. 恰当的；适合的；
words.ex: This shoe fits my foot perfectly.
words.ex_cn: 这双鞋很合我的脚。
words.en: Appropriate or suitable for a particular purpose, person, occasion, etc.

words.ex: He grows flax in his garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里种植亚麻。
words.en: Flax is a plant with blue flowers. Its stem is used for making linen and its seeds are used for making linseed oil.

words.tr: n. 泄水闸门；防洪闸门
words.ex: The floodgate opened and water rushed out.
words.ex_cn: 水闸打开了，水涌了出来。
words.en: A floodgate is a gate that can be opened or closed to admit or exclude water, especially one that controls the flow of water in a river or canal. It can also refer to something that controls the release or admission of a large quantity of something.

words.tr:
v. 搜寻；（动物）觅食；
n. 饲料；草料；
words.ex: The bear forages for berries in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这只熊在森林里搜寻浆果。
words.en: If you forage, you search for food or other supplies. Forage can also refer to food for animals, especially when it is grown or collected.

words.tr:
n. 锻造车间；
v. 建立（联系等）；
words.ex: The blacksmith works in the forge every morning.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠每天早上都在锻造车间工作。
words.en: To forge something means to create it, especially by using considerable effort or skill. It can also mean to make or produce something, especially with some difficulty or effort. Additionally, it refers to the act of making a copy or imitation of something with the intent to deceive.

words.ex: The blacksmith heated the metal in the furnace.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠在熔炉里加热金属。
words.en: A furnace is a device that produces heat for warmth or to melt materials.

words.tr:
n. 犁沟；车辙；皱纹
v. 犁耕；使皱眉头
words.ex: The farmer plowed a deep furrow in the field.
words.ex_cn: 农夫在田里犁出了一条深深的犁沟。
words.en: A furrow is a long narrow trench made in the ground by a plow, especially for planting seeds or for irrigation. It can also refer to a deep wrinkle on a person's face.

words.tr: v. 由于保险丝烧断而电路不通；熔接；结合；
words.ex: The light went out because the fuse blew.
words.ex_cn: 灯灭了，因为保险丝烧断了。
words.en: A fuse is a safety device consisting of a strip of wire that melts and breaks an electric circuit if the current exceeds a safe level. As a verb, it means to join or blend to form a single entity.

words.ex: The factory galvanize iron sheets to prevent rust.
words.ex_cn: 工厂对铁片进行镀锌以防止生锈。
words.en: To galvanize someone means to cause them to take action, for example by making them feel very excited, afraid, or angry.

words.ex: The gardener did a graft on the apple tree.
words.ex_cn: 园丁在苹果树上进行了嫁接。
words.en: Graft can refer to the act of joining parts from different plants so that they grow as one plant, or to the act of transferring living tissue from one part of the body to another. It can also refer to the practice of using one's position to gain money or advantages dishonestly.

words.ex: The hallmark of a good teacher is patience.
words.ex_cn: 好老师的标志是耐心。
words.en: A hallmark is a distinctive characteristic or attribute that is typical of a particular person or thing.

words.ex: The handiness of the tool made it easy to use.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具的轻便性使得它易于使用。
words.en: The quality of being useful, convenient, or skillful with the hands.

words.ex: The pottery on display is his handiwork.
words.ex_cn: 展出的陶器是他的手工品。
words.en: Work done by hand; manual work.

words.ex: The hardship helped him harden his spirit.
words.ex_cn: 困难使他的精神变得坚强。
words.en: To make or become hard or harder; to make or become more severe, strict, or unfeeling.

words.tr:
n. 鱼叉
v. 用鱼叉叉
words.ex: The fisherman threw a harpoon at the whale.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫向鲸鱼投掷了一支鱼叉。
words.en: A harpoon is a long spear-like instrument used in fishing to catch large fish or whales.

words.ex: The hatchery is responsible for breeding and releasing fish into the river.
words.ex_cn: 孵化场负责繁殖并将鱼类放流到河流中。
words.en: A hatchery is a place where eggs, especially fish eggs, are hatched.

words.tr: adj. 混乱的；杂乱的；失控的
words.ex: The project went haywire when the main contractor left.
words.ex_cn: 当主要承包商离开时，项目变得一团糟。
words.en: If something goes haywire, it stops working properly and becomes uncontrollable.

words.ex: The farmer owns five hectares of land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有五公顷土地。
words.en: A hectare is a unit of measurement of area, equal to 10,000 square metres or approximately 2.471 acres.

words.tr:
n. 树篱；防范措施
v. 用树篱围住；限制；避免
words.ex: He planted a hedge around his garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园周围种了一排树篱。
words.en: A hedge is a row of bushes or small trees which have been planted along the edge of a garden, field, or road to separate it from another area or to protect it. As a verb, to hedge means to avoid committing oneself or to limit or qualify something by conditions or exceptions.

words.tr:
n. 兽群；
v. 放牧；
words.ex: The herd of cows walked slowly to the pasture.
words.ex_cn: 一群牛缓缓走向牧场。
words.en: A herd is a large group of animals of one kind that live together.

words.ex: The bees built a hive in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在树上建了一个蜂巢。
words.en: A hive is a structure where bees live, consisting of a series of cells in which they store honey and raise their young.

words.tr:
n. 贮藏物；隐藏物
v. 贮藏；囤积
words.ex: The treasure hunter found a hoard of gold coins.
words.ex_cn: 寻宝者发现了一堆金币。
words.en: If you hoard things such as food or money, you save or store them, often in secret, because they are valuable or important to you.

words.tr: v. 抓住；持有；举行；容纳；保存；“hold”的现在分词； n. 土地；
words.ex: He is holding the rope tightly.
words.ex_cn: 他正紧紧地抓住绳子。
words.en: A holding is a piece of land that is owned by someone or the shares that someone owns in a company.

words.tr:
n. 蜂窝；蜂窝状物
v. 使布满小孔；成蜂窝状
words.ex: Bees build their nest in a honeycomb shape.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂用蜂窝形状建造它们的巢。
words.en: A honeycomb is a structure of hexagonal cells made by bees, used to store honey and pollen or to house their eggs and larvae.

words.ex: Beijing is a transport hub in China.
words.ex_cn: 北京是中国的交通中心。
words.en: A hub is the central part of a wheel, rotating on or with the axle, and from which the spokes radiate. It can also refer to a central point of activity or interest.

words.ex: The bag weighs one hundredweight.
words.ex_cn: 这个袋子重一英担。
words.en: A unit of weight equal to 112 pounds in Britain and 100 pounds in the US.

words.ex: He ate a chunk of cheese for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一大块奶酪。
words.en: A chunk of something is a large piece or amount of it.

words.ex: He learned husbandry from his father on the farm.
words.ex_cn: 他从父亲那里学会了畜牧业。
words.en: Husbandry is the careful management of resources, especially in agriculture or farming, to ensure their efficient use and conservation.

words.tr: adj. 液压的；流体的；利用液体压力的；
words.ex: The hydraulic brake system stops the car quickly.
words.ex_cn: 液压制动系统能快速让汽车停下。
words.en: Hydraulic refers to the operation of machinery or systems by the movement and force of liquid, especially water or oil.

words.ex: The dam produces hydroelectricity for nearby towns.
words.ex_cn: 这座水坝为附近的城镇提供水力电气。
words.en: Electricity generated by the movement of water.

words.ex: The city needs better infrastructure for roads and water.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要更好的道路和供水设施。
words.en: The basic physical and organizational structures and facilities (e.g., buildings, roads, power supplies) needed for the operation of a society or enterprise.

words.ex: The doctor checked his daily intake of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他每天的糖摄入量。
words.en: The process of taking something in, especially food, air, or information.

words.ex: Farmers irrigate their fields with water from the river.
words.ex_cn: 农民用河里的水灌溉他们的田地。
words.en: To supply land or crops with water by means of channels or pipes.

words.tr:
n. 防波堤；码头
adj. 乌黑发亮的；黑玉似的
words.ex: The fisherman walks on the jetty to check his nets.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫走在码头上检查他的渔网。
words.en: A jetty is a structure that extends from the shore into the water and is used to protect a harbor or shoreline from the effects of currents, tides, and waves, or to provide a berthing place for vessels.

words.ex: He bought a repair kit for his bike.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一套自行车维修工具。
words.en: A kit is a group of items that are kept together, often in the same container, because they are all used for similar purposes.

words.ex: The knight held a long lance in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 骑士手中握着一支长矛。
words.en: A lance is a long weapon used in the past by soldiers on horseback, consisting of a wooden shaft with a pointed metal end. As a verb, to lance means to pierce or cut open with a sharp instrument, especially a lance.

words.tr:
n. 车床
v. 用车床加工
words.ex: He uses a lathe to shape wood.
words.ex_cn: 他用车床加工木材。
words.en: A lathe is a machine tool that rotates a workpiece about an axis of rotation to perform various operations such as cutting, sanding, knurling, drilling, or deformation with tools that are applied to the workpiece to create an object with symmetry about that axis.

words.ex: He tried to loosen the tight screw.
words.ex_cn: 他试图拧松那颗紧的螺丝。
words.en: If you loosen something or if it loosens, it becomes less tight, less firmly fixed, or less strongly attached.

words.ex: The car had a malfunction in the engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的发动机出现了故障。
words.en: If a machine or device malfunctions, it fails to work properly.

words.ex: He drank a glass of malt.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了一杯麦芽饮料。
words.en: Malt is grain, usually barley, that has been soaked in water, allowed to germinate, and then dried. It is used in brewing and distilling.

words.ex: The manager approved the new project.
words.ex_cn: 经理批准了新项目。
words.en: A manager is a person who is responsible for running part of or the whole of a business organization.

words.ex: Farmers spread manure on the fields to help crops grow.
words.ex_cn: 农民把肥料撒在田里以帮助庄稼生长。
words.en: Manure is organic matter used as fertilizer in agriculture.

words.ex: He had a meager meal after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后吃了一顿很少的饭。
words.en: If you describe an amount or quantity of something as meager, you are critical of it because it is very small or not enough.

words.ex: The floor has a colorful mosaic of flowers.
words.ex_cn: 地板上有一个五彩的花卉镶嵌图案。
words.en: A mosaic is a picture or pattern produced by arranging together small colored pieces of hard material, such as stone, tile, or glass.

words.ex: The pig rolled in the muck.
words.ex_cn: 猪在污物里打滚。
words.en: Muck is dirt or some other unpleasant substance. It can also refer to manure used for fertilizing the land. As a verb, to muck means to spread manure on the land or to make something dirty.

words.tr: n. 游牧民；流浪者；游牧生活；流浪生活
words.ex: The nomad walks with his sheep across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 游牧民带着他的羊群穿越沙漠。
words.en: A nomad is someone who has no permanent home and moves according to the seasons from place to place in search of food, water, and grazing land.

words.tr:
v. 渗出；流出；分泌出
n. 软泥；淤泥；泥浆
words.ex: Mud is oozing from the hole.
words.ex_cn: 泥巴正从洞里渗出来。
words.en: If a liquid oozes from something or if something oozes a liquid, the liquid flows from it slowly and in small quantities.

words.ex: She bought a new outfit for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一套新衣服。
words.en: An outfit is a set of clothes worn together, especially for a particular occasion or purpose.

words.ex: The child outgrew his shoes in one year.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子一年内就长高了，鞋子都穿不下了。
words.en: If you outgrow a particular way of behaving or thinking, you change and become more mature, so that you no longer behave or think in that way.

words.ex: The iron will oxidize in wet air.
words.ex_cn: 铁在潮湿的空气中会氧化。
words.en: To combine or become combined chemically with oxygen.

words.ex: The farmers work in the paddy every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农民每天早上都在稻田里劳作。
words.en: A paddy is a field in which rice is grown. It is typically flooded with water.

words.ex: He planted carrots in a small patch.
words.ex_cn: 他在一小块地上种了胡萝卜。
words.en: A patch is a piece of material used to mend a hole or a weak spot in something, or a small area that is different from the area around it.

words.ex: Farmers use pesticide to kill insects on crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用杀虫剂来杀死作物上的昆虫。
words.en: A pesticide is a chemical substance used to kill pests, especially insects, that damage crops or are harmful to human health.

words.ex: The piston moves up and down in the engine.
words.ex_cn: 活塞在发动机中上下移动。
words.en: A piston is a component of reciprocating engines, reciprocating pumps, gas compressors and pneumatic cylinders, among other similar mechanisms. It is the moving component that is contained by a cylinder and is made gas-tight by piston rings.

words.ex: He used a plunger to unclog the sink.
words.ex_cn: 他用活塞来疏通水槽。
words.en: A plunger is a device consisting of a rubber cup on the end of a stick, used to clear blocked pipes by means of suction.

words.ex: They prefabricate house parts in a factory.
words.ex_cn: 他们在工厂里预制房屋部件。
words.en: To manufacture sections of (a building, especially a house) in a factory prior to their assembly on site.

words.ex: The machine purifies water by removing dirt.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器通过去除杂质来净化水。
words.en: To purify something means to make it clean and pure by removing dirty or harmful substances from it.

words.ex: The purity of the water is checked every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天都会检查水的纯净度。
words.en: The quality or state of being pure, especially in terms of being free from anything that contaminates, pollutes, or dilutes.

words.tr: n. 筹集者；提出者；饲养者
words.ex: He was known as a successful raiser of funds for charity.
words.ex_cn: 他以成功为慈善事业筹款而闻名。
words.en: A raiser is a person or thing that raises something, especially funds or animals.

words.tr:
v. 领会；抓紧；
n. 领会；
words.ex: I couldn't grasp the meaning of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 我没能领会这首诗的含义。
words.en: To grasp something means to take it in your hand and hold it firmly.

words.tr: adj. 精炼的； v. 改进；“refine”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The oil company produced refined gasoline.
words.ex_cn: 这家石油公司生产了精炼的汽油。
words.en: If you say that someone is refined, you mean that they are very polite and have good manners and good taste.

words.ex: The reservoir provides water for the nearby town.
words.ex_cn: 这个水库为附近的城镇提供水源。
words.en: A reservoir is a large quantity of a substance that is stored and can be used when needed.

words.tr: n. 摇杆；摇椅；摇滚歌手
words.ex: He spent the evening gently rocking in his favorite rocker.
words.ex_cn: 他整个晚上都在他最喜欢的摇椅上轻轻地摇晃。
words.en: A rocker is a chair mounted on rockers or springs which allows it to move back and forth, or a musician who plays rock music.

words.tr:
adj. 乡村的；纯朴的；土气的
n. 乡下人；乡巴佬
words.ex: They live in a rustic cabin near the woods.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一间乡村小屋里。
words.en: Rustic is used to describe things that are typical of the countryside rather than the town, or things that are simple and old-fashioned in a way that is considered typical of the countryside.

words.tr:
n. 螺丝钉；
v. 拧紧；
words.ex: He tightened the screw with a screwdriver.
words.ex_cn: 他用螺丝刀拧紧了螺丝钉。
words.en: A screw is a metal object similar to a nail, with a raised spiral line around it. Screws are used to fasten things together.

words.tr: v. 沸腾；翻涌；骚动；激昂；大发雷霆
words.ex: The water began to seethe on the stove.
words.ex_cn: 水在炉子上开始沸腾。
words.en: If you say that someone is seething, you mean that they are very angry, but they are trying not to show it.

words.tr: adj. 劣质的；次品的；卑劣的
words.ex: He bought a shoddy chair that broke after one day.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一把劣质的椅子，一天就坏了。
words.en: If you describe something as shoddy, you mean that it has been done or made carelessly or badly.

words.ex: The farmer stores silage for his cows in winter.
words.ex_cn: 农夫为他的奶牛储存青贮饲料过冬。
words.en: Silage is grass or other green fodder compacted and stored in airtight conditions, typically in a silo, without first being dried, and used as animal feed in the winter.

words.ex: The flame singed her hair.
words.ex_cn: 火焰烧焦了她的头发。
words.en: To burn superficially or lightly; scorch.

words.ex: The factory dumped slag near the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂把矿渣倒在河边。
words.en: Slag is the glass-like by-product left over after a desired metal has been separated (i.e., smelted) from its raw ore. Slag is usually a mixture of metal oxides and silicon dioxide. However, slags can contain metal sulfides and elemental metals.

words.tr:
n. 纺锤；锭子；心轴
v. 装锭子于
words.ex: The spinner turns the spindle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 纺纱工快速转动纺锤。
words.en: A spindle is a rod or pin, tapered at one end and usually weighted at the other, on which fibers are spun by hand into thread and then wound.

words.ex: The squire rode his horse to the castle.
words.ex_cn: 骑士骑马去城堡。
words.en: A squire is a young man who was an assistant to a knight before becoming a knight himself. In modern times, the term can also refer to a man of high social standing in a rural area.

words.tr:
n. 一摞；一叠；一堆；大烟囱；
v. 把…放成整齐的一摞；
words.ex: He put the books in a stack on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书堆成一摞放在桌子上。
words.en: A stack is a pile of things, usually arranged one on top of another.

words.ex: The wind stiffened the cloth on the line.
words.ex_cn: 风把晾衣绳上的布吹硬了。
words.en: to make or become stiff or rigid; to make or become more severe or strict

words.ex: The cow eats straw from the barn.
words.ex_cn: 牛吃谷仓里的稻草。
words.en: A straw is a thin tube of paper or plastic that you use to suck a drink into your mouth.

words.ex: He has a little stubble on his chin.
words.ex_cn: 他的下巴上有一点胡茬。
words.en: Stubble refers to the short, stiff stalks of grain or other crops left in a field after harvesting, or to the short, stiff hairs on a man's face when he has not shaved for a few days.

words.tr: adj. 硫磺的；含有硫磺的
words.ex: The air smelled sulphurous after the volcano erupted.
words.ex_cn: 火山喷发后，空气中有一股硫磺味。
words.en: Relating to or containing sulfur, especially with a valence of 4.

words.ex: The synthesis of ideas helped solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这些想法的综合帮助解决了问题。
words.en: The act of combining different ideas, influences, or objects into a new and coherent whole.

words.ex: The shirt is made of synthetic fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫是合成纤维制成的。
words.en: Synthetic products are made from chemicals or artificial substances rather than from natural ones.

words.ex: The tea has a tannic taste.
words.ex_cn: 这种茶有单宁的苦味。
words.en: Relating to or containing tannin, especially as derived from the bark or galls of oak trees.

words.ex: The house has a small terrace with chairs.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个带椅子的小平台。
words.en: A terrace is a flat area of stone or grass next to a building where people can sit.

words.ex: She bought a towel made of terry.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一条由毛圈织物制成的毛巾。
words.en: A type of fabric with loops that absorb water, used especially for making towels and robes.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of textile, like cotton and silk.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售多种纺织品，比如棉和丝绸。
words.en: Textiles are types of cloth or fabric, especially ones that have been woven.

words.ex: He used tongs to pick up the hot bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用夹子夹起热面包。
words.en: A tool consisting of two movable arms joined at one end, used for picking up and holding things.

words.ex: The wind turbine spins to make electricity.
words.ex_cn: 风力涡轮机旋转以发电。
words.en: A turbine is a machine or engine which uses a stream of air, gas, water, or steam to turn a wheel and produce power.

chapters.name: 社会万象 科技发展 重点词

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.tr: adj. 易接近的；可使用的；简单易懂的；可进入的；
words.ex: The park is accessible by bus.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园乘公交车可达。
words.en: If a place or building is accessible to people, it is easy for them to reach it or get into it. If an object is accessible, it is easy to reach.

words.ex: Interest will accrue over time.
words.ex_cn: 利息会随着时间积累。
words.en: If money or interest accrues, it gradually increases in amount over a period of time.

words.ex: The lab has a new apparatus for measuring temperature.
words.ex_cn: 实验室有一台新的温度测量装置。
words.en: The complex structure of a particular system or organization, or the equipment used for a specific purpose.

words.tr:
adj. 近似的；大约的；
v. 接近；
words.ex: The approximate cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 费用大约是50美元。
words.en: An approximate number, time, or position is close to the correct number, time, or position, but is not exact.

words.ex: He did not avail himself of the opportunity.
words.ex_cn: 他没有利用这个机会。
words.en: If you avail yourself of something, you use it or take advantage of it.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.tr: n. 回路；环行；电路；巡回；
words.ex: The battery connects to the circuit to make the light work.
words.ex_cn: 电池连接到回路，使灯亮起来。
words.en: A circuit is a roughly circular line, route, or movement that starts and finishes at the same place. It can also refer to the complete path that an electric current travels along.

words.ex: Blood circulates in the body.
words.ex_cn: 血液在体内循环。
words.en: To move or cause to move continuously or freely through a closed system or area.

words.ex: He computes the total cost quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快算出总成本。
words.en: If you compute a total, amount, or result, you calculate it.

words.ex: You must concentrate on your homework.
words.ex_cn: 你必须集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you concentrate on something, you give it your full attention and think about it carefully.

words.tr:
n. 混凝土；
adj. 具体的；
words.ex: The workers poured concrete to build the foundation.
words.ex_cn: 工人们浇筑混凝土来建造地基。
words.en: Concrete is a hard, strong construction material made by mixing a cementing material (such as Portland cement) and a mineral aggregate (such as sand and gravel) with sufficient water to cause the cement to set and bind the entire mass. In a broader sense, concrete can also refer to something that is tangible, specific, or real.

words.tr: n. 结构；布局；配置；外形
words.ex: The configuration of the computer is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑的配置非常简单。
words.en: The arrangement of parts or elements in a particular form, figure, or combination.

words.ex: He spends hours in cyberspace every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在虚拟空间里花几个小时。
words.en: Cyberspace is the notional environment in which communication over computer networks occurs.

words.ex: He tried to decipher the secret code.
words.ex_cn: 他试图破译那个秘密代码。
words.en: To decipher something means to convert it from a code into normal language or to understand something that is difficult to understand or that is not obvious.

words.ex: I can detect a change in her mood.
words.ex_cn: 我能察觉到她情绪的变化。
words.en: To detect something means to find it or discover it, often using special equipment or methods.

words.tr:
v. 弥漫；
adj. 分散的；
words.ex: Smoke began to diffuse through the room.
words.ex_cn: 烟开始弥漫在整个房间里。
words.en: If something such as knowledge or information is diffused, or if it diffuses, it is made known over a wide area or to a lot of people.

words.ex: The doctor used drops to dilate her pupils.
words.ex_cn: 医生用了滴眼液来扩大她的瞳孔。
words.en: If you dilate something such as a part of your body, or if it dilates, it becomes larger or wider.

words.ex: The dimension of the box is 10 cm by 5 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的尺寸是10厘米乘5厘米。
words.en: A dimension is a measurement of something in a particular direction, or the scope or scale of something.

words.ex: Carbon dioxide makes the air warm.
words.ex_cn: 二氧化碳使空气变暖。
words.en: A compound containing two atoms of oxygen combined with another element or group.

words.ex: Sugar dissolves in water.
words.ex_cn: 糖在水中溶解。
words.en: If a substance dissolves in liquid or if you dissolve a substance, it becomes mixed with the liquid and disappears.

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 漂移；
words.ex: The drift of the river carries leaves downstream.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流动将树叶冲向下游。
words.en: If something or someone drifts somewhere, they move there slowly or gradually. As a noun, drift can refer to a slow, gradual movement or change, or the general meaning or intent of something.

words.tr: v. 使带电；使电气化；使激动不已
words.ex: The new train system will electrify the entire region.
words.ex_cn: 新的火车系统将使整个地区电气化。
words.en: To electrify something means to make it operate using electricity or to make it more exciting or interesting.

words.ex: He uses an electronic book to read.
words.ex_cn: 他用电子书来阅读。
words.en: Electronic means relating to devices or systems that operate by controlling the flow of electrons, especially in a vacuum, gas, or semiconductor.

words.ex: Water is made of two elements: hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水由两种要素组成：氢和氧。
words.en: An element is a substance that cannot be separated into simpler substances by chemical means and is composed of atoms having the same number of protons.

words.tr: v. 赋予能量；使精力充沛；激励
words.ex: Coffee helps me energize in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 咖啡帮助我在早上恢复活力。
words.en: To energize someone means to give them the enthusiasm, determination, and energy to do something.

words.ex: The extent of his knowledge surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的知识广度让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The area or length to which something extends.

words.ex: He flexed his arm to show his muscle.
words.ex_cn: 他弯曲手臂展示他的肌肉。
words.en: To bend something, especially a part of your body, or to become bent.

words.ex: The company used a new formula to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 公司使用了一个新方案来解决问题。
words.en: A formula is a plan or method that is used to achieve a particular goal, especially in science or mathematics.

words.tr: adj. 基本的；基础的；根本的；
words.ex: Water is a fundamental need for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本需求。
words.en: You use fundamental to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or essential. They affect the basic nature of other things or are the most important element upon which other things depend.

words.tr: n. 测量仪器；规格；评估；
words.ex: The mechanic used a gauge to check the tire pressure.
words.ex_cn: 机械师用一个测量仪器来检查轮胎气压。
words.en: A gauge is a device that measures the amount or quantity of something and shows the measurement in a form that is easy to read, such as a dial or a digital display.

words.ex: The wind generates electricity.
words.ex_cn: 风产生电力。
words.en: To generate something means to cause it to begin and develop.

words.tr:
v. 上釉；上玻璃；浇浆汁于；变呆滞
n. 釉料；光滑面；覆罩的一层
words.ex: The potter glazes the clay bowl before firing it.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠在烧制前给陶碗上釉。
words.en: To glaze means to fit panes of glass into a window frame or similar structure. It can also refer to the process of applying a glossy, often transparent, coating to pottery or other materials.

words.ex: He gropped in the dark for the light switch.
words.ex_cn: 他在黑暗中摸索着找电灯开关。
words.en: If you grope for something that you cannot see, you try to find it by moving your hands around in order to feel it.

words.ex: Heredity determines eye color in humans.
words.ex_cn: 遗传决定人类的眼睛颜色。
words.en: Heredity is the process by which features and characteristics are passed on from parents to their children before the children are born.

words.tr: adj. 密封的；不透气的；与外界隔绝的
words.ex: The container was hermetic to ensure the contents stayed fresh.
words.ex_cn: 这个容器是密封的，以确保内容物保持新鲜。
words.en: If something is hermetic, it is so tightly sealed that no air can get in or out.

words.ex: The universe may be infinite.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙可能是无限的。
words.en: If you describe something as infinite, you are emphasizing that it is extremely great in amount or degree.

words.tr:
adj. 红外线的
n. 红外线
words.ex: The remote uses infrared to change the TV channel.
words.ex_cn: 遥控器使用红外线来切换电视频道。
words.en: Infrared refers to the region of the electromagnetic spectrum with wavelengths longer than visible light but shorter than microwaves, often used in technology for night vision and heat sensing.

words.tr: v. 隔离；使隔热；使隔音；使绝缘
words.ex: The walls insulate the house from cold air.
words.ex_cn: 墙壁将房子与冷空气隔离开。
words.en: To insulate something means to protect it from heat, cold, noise, or electricity by covering it in a material that prevents it from passing through.

words.ex: The intensity of the sunlight made me wear sunglasses.
words.ex_cn: 阳光的强度让我戴上了太阳镜。
words.en: The quality of being intense, especially in terms of concentration, power, or force.

words.ex: The phone has a simple interface.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有一个简单的界面。
words.en: An interface is a point where two systems, subjects, organizations, etc. meet and interact.

words.tr:
v. （使）连锁；（使）相互扣住
n. 互锁设备
words.ex: The puzzle pieces interlock tightly.
words.ex_cn: 拼图块紧密地互锁在一起。
words.en: To interlock means to fit together firmly or closely, or to cause things to fit together in this way.

words.ex: The ion moves quickly in the water.
words.ex_cn: 这个离子在水中快速移动。
words.en: An ion is an atom or molecule with a net electric charge due to the loss or gain of one or more electrons.

words.tr: v. 照射；用放射线处理；使明亮
words.ex: The sun irradiates the earth every day.
words.ex_cn: 太阳每天照射地球。
words.en: To expose to radiation; to illuminate or enlighten.

words.ex: The net is made of a fine mesh.
words.ex_cn: 这个网是由细密的网状物制成的。
words.en: A mesh is a material made of a network of wire or thread to catch or hold things, or to allow things to pass through it.

words.ex: The new policy improves worker mobility.
words.ex_cn: 新政策提高了工人的流动性。
words.en: The ability to move or be moved freely and easily.

words.ex: Water is made of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom in a molecule.
words.ex_cn: 水由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成一个分子。
words.en: A molecule is the smallest particle in a chemical element or compound that has the chemical properties of that element or compound. Molecules are made up of atoms that are held together by chemical bonds.

words.ex: The team gained momentum after scoring the first goal.
words.ex_cn: 球队在进第一个球后获得了势头。
words.en: Momentum is the ability of something to keep increasing, developing, or being more successful.

words.ex: The store offers multiple flavors of ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供多种口味的冰淇淋。
words.en: If something is multiple, it consists of or involves many things of the same kind.

words.ex: The bacteria multiply quickly.
words.ex_cn: 细菌迅速增加。
words.en: If you multiply one number by another, you add the first number to itself as many times as is indicated by the second number. For example, 2 multiplied by 3 is equal to 6.

words.tr:
adj. 平行的；
n. 类似的事物；
words.ex: The two lines are parallel and never meet.
words.ex_cn: 这两条线是平行的，永远不会相交。
words.en: Something that is parallel to something else is similar to it in many ways, or happens at the same time as it.

words.ex: The builder used a plumb to check if the wall was straight.
words.ex_cn: 建筑工人用铅锤检查墙是否垂直。
words.en: To measure the depth of water with a plumb line; to explore or understand something deeply; exactly vertical; completely or directly.

words.ex: This plan is practicable.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划是可行的。
words.en: If a task, plan, or idea is practicable, it can be successfully done or achieved.

words.ex: He follows procedural rules in every game.
words.ex_cn: 他在每场比赛中都遵循程序性规则。
words.en: Procedural means relating to a procedure, especially a legal one.

words.tr: v. 散发；发射（光或热）；辐射
words.ex: The sun radiates heat and light.
words.ex_cn: 太阳散发出热量和光。
words.en: To send out rays or waves, especially of light or heat; to spread out from a central point.

words.ex: The Earth revolves around the Sun.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕太阳转。
words.en: If something revolves or if you revolve something, it moves or turns around a central point or line.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.tr: v. 使浸透；使湿透；使满；使饱和
words.ex: The sponge will saturate if you pour too much water.
words.ex_cn: 如果你倒太多水，海绵会吸满。
words.en: To saturate something means to make it completely wet, or to fill it completely with something so that no more can be added.

words.tr:
n. 规模；等级；比例（尺）；刻度；秤；
v. 改变…大小；
words.ex: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的规模让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A scale is a set of levels or numbers which are used in a particular system of measuring things or are used when comparing things.

words.ex: Salt is soluble in water.
words.ex_cn: 盐可以溶于水。
words.en: A substance that is soluble can be dissolved in a liquid.

words.tr:
v. 分开；分裂；
n. 划分；分歧；
words.ex: The tree split in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 那棵树在风暴中裂开了。
words.en: If something splits or if you split it, it is divided into two or more parts.

words.ex: The chair is stationary and does not move.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子是固定的，不会移动。
words.en: not moving or not intended to be moved

words.tr:
n. 代用品；代替物；
v. 替代；
words.ex: Honey is a good substitute for sugar.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是糖的良好代用品。
words.en: A substitute is something or someone that takes the place or function of another.

words.ex: Smartphones supplanted landline phones.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机取代了固定电话。
words.en: To supplant someone or something means to take the place of them, often by being more powerful or effective.

words.tr:
n. 痕迹；轨迹；微量；
v. 追踪；追溯；仔细查找；
words.ex: There was no trace of blood on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 地板上没有血迹。
words.en: If you trace something such as a pattern or a shape, you draw it carefully over a piece of thin paper. You can also trace someone or something that is missing or has disappeared, by following their movements or actions.

words.tr:
v. 闪耀；闪烁
n. 闪烁
words.ex: The stars twinkle in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜空中闪烁。
words.en: If a star or a light twinkles, it shines with an unsteady light that rapidly and gently changes from bright to faint.

chapters.name: 社会万象 科技发展 认知词

words.ex: The car has an add-on for better sound.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个用于更好音效的附加装置。
words.en: An add-on is something that is added to a product, especially a computer program, to give it extra features or functions.

words.ex: The guitar amplifier makes the sound louder.
words.ex_cn: 吉他放大器让声音变大。
words.en: An amplifier is an electronic device that increases the strength of electrical signals, especially sound signals.

words.ex: The course covers a wide breadth of topics.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程涵盖了广泛的主题。
words.en: The distance or measurement from side to side of something; width.

words.ex: He uses Chrome as his browser.
words.ex_cn: 他用 Chrome 作为他的浏览器。
words.en: A browser is a piece of computer software that you use to search for information on the Internet.

words.ex: The buoyancy of the water helps the boat float.
words.ex_cn: 水的浮力帮助船漂浮。
words.en: Buoyancy is the ability of something to float in a liquid or to rise in air or gas.

words.tr: abbr. 计算机辅助设计；“computer aided design”的缩写
words.ex: He uses CAD to design buildings.
words.ex_cn: 他用计算机辅助设计来设计建筑。
words.en: A cad is a man who behaves dishonorably, especially towards a woman.

words.ex: He played his favorite song on a cassette player.
words.ex_cn: 他用盒式磁带播放器播放了他最喜欢的歌。
words.en: A cassette is a small flat case containing a very long strip of magnetic material that is used to record sound or pictures.

words.tr: n. （电解池的）阴极；（原电池的）正极
words.ex: In a battery, the cathode is the positive terminal.
words.ex_cn: 在电池中，阴极是正极。
words.en: The cathode is the electrode from which a conventional current leaves a polarized electrical device.

words.tr:
n. 芯片；
v. 削成碎片；碎裂；
words.ex: The computer chip is very small.
words.ex_cn: 计算机芯片非常小。
words.en: A chip is a small piece which has been broken off something larger, or a small piece of silicon used to make computer parts.

words.ex: The coefficient of x is 5 in this equation.
words.ex_cn: 在这个方程中，x 的系数是 5。
words.en: A coefficient is a number that measures a particular characteristic of a substance or a system under specified conditions.

words.ex: She wears a necklace made of crystal.
words.ex_cn: 她戴一条水晶制成的项链。
words.en: A crystal is a solid that has a regular, repeating arrangement of atoms. Crystals are often transparent and can be used in jewelry or as decorative objects.

words.ex: The school stores student records in a database.
words.ex_cn: 学校将学生记录存储在数据库中。
words.en: A database is a collection of data that is organized so that it can easily be accessed, managed, and updated.

words.tr:
n. 刻度盘；
v. 拨；
words.ex: He looked at the clock's dial to check the time.
words.ex_cn: 他看着钟的刻度盘来查看时间。
words.en: A dial is the face of a clock or watch, or a similar control on a piece of equipment, which shows you the time or other information. As a verb, to dial means to call a telephone number by pressing the buttons on a telephone.

words.ex: He uses a digital watch to tell time.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块数字手表看时间。
words.en: Digital systems, devices, or technology use electronic signals that are represented by the numbers 1 and 0, indicating 'on' or 'off'.

words.ex: The diode lets electricity flow in one direction.
words.ex_cn: 这个二极管允许电流单向流动。
words.en: A diode is a device that allows current to flow in one direction only.

words.ex: He fixed the electrical wire with tape.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶带修好了电线。
words.en: Relating to electricity or things that use electricity.

words.ex: The electrode conducts electricity in the battery.
words.ex_cn: 电极在电池中传导电流。
words.en: An electrode is a conductor through which electricity enters or leaves an object, substance, or region.

words.ex: He fixed the broken electronics with a small tool.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个小工具修好了坏掉的电子器件。
words.en: The branch of physics and technology concerned with the design of circuits using transistors and microchips, and with the behavior and movement of electrons in a semiconductor, conductor, vacuum, or gas.

words.ex: The electroscope shows if an object is charged.
words.ex_cn: 验电器显示物体是否带电。
words.en: An electroscope is a device used to detect the presence of an electric charge by the movement of a lightweight object or objects within the device.

words.ex: The balloon sticks to the wall because of electrostatic force.
words.ex_cn: 气球因为静电作用粘在墙上。
words.en: Relating to stationary electric charges or fields as opposed to electric currents.

words.ex: He embeds the photo in the document.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片插入到文档中。
words.en: To fix something firmly and deeply in a surrounding mass.

words.ex: He did an exploratory trip to find new places.
words.ex_cn: 他进行了一次探索性的旅行来寻找新地方。
words.en: relating to or involving exploration or investigation

words.tr: n. 织物；（建筑物的）结构；
words.ex: The dress is made of soft fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子是由柔软的织物制成的。
words.en: Fabric refers to cloth or other material produced by weaving together cotton, nylon, wool, silk, or other threads. It can also refer to the basic structure of a building or a system.

words.ex: The boat is made of fiberglass.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船是用玻璃纤维制成的。
words.en: A material consisting of extremely fine filaments of glass that are combined in yarn and woven into fabrics, used in textiles and for insulation and reinforcement of plastics.

words.ex: Firedamp is a significant hazard in coal mines.
words.ex_cn: 沼气是煤矿中的一个重大危险。
words.en: Firedamp is a flammable gas found in coal mines, primarily consisting of methane.

words.ex: The amoeba reproduces by fission.
words.ex_cn: 阿米巴通过分裂生殖进行繁殖。
words.en: Fission is the splitting of an atomic nucleus, resulting in the release of a large amount of energy.

words.tr:
n. 流体；流质；
adj. 流动的；
words.ex: Water is a common fluid.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的流体。
words.en: A fluid is a substance that can flow and change its shape easily, such as a liquid or a gas.

words.ex: The fluidity of the liquid made it easy to pour.
words.ex_cn: 液体的流动性使其易于倾倒。
words.en: The quality of being able to change or be changed easily.

words.ex: The fluorescent lamp lights up the room quickly.
words.ex_cn: 荧光灯很快照亮了房间。
words.en: Fluorescent substances produce bright light of a particular color when they are exposed to light of a different wavelength.

words.tr:
n. 箔；陪衬物
v. 阻止；挫败
words.ex: He used foil to wrap the sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 他用锡纸包住了三明治。
words.en: To prevent someone from succeeding in their plans or intentions, especially by doing something clever or unexpected.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.ex: He bought a gallon of milk from the store.
words.ex_cn: 他从商店买了一加仑牛奶。
words.en: A gallon is a unit of measurement for liquids that is equal to eight pints. In Britain, it is equal to about 4.546 litres. In America, it is equal to about 3.785 litres.

words.ex: The mechanic opened the gearbox to inspect the gears.
words.ex_cn: 机械师打开变速箱检查齿轮。
words.en: A gearbox is a device that is used to change the speed or the direction of movement of a vehicle by controlling the gears.

words.ex: The balloon is filled with helium.
words.ex_cn: 气球里充满了氦气。
words.en: Helium is a chemical element with the symbol He and atomic number 2. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless, non-toxic, inert, monatomic gas, the first in the noble gas group in the periodic table. Its boiling point is the lowest among all the elements.

words.ex: The car burns hydrocarbon fuel.
words.ex_cn: 汽车燃烧碳氢化合物燃料。
words.en: A hydrocarbon is an organic compound consisting entirely of hydrogen and carbon.

words.tr: adj. 盐酸的；含氢和氯的
words.ex: Hydrochloric acid burns the skin.
words.ex_cn: 盐酸会灼伤皮肤。
words.en: Hydrochloric refers to or denotes a compound of hydrogen and chlorine, especially hydrochloric acid.

words.ex: Sodium hydroxide is a strong base.
words.ex_cn: 氢氧化钠是一种强碱。
words.en: A hydroxide is a chemical compound containing an oxygen atom bonded to a hydrogen atom, which can dissociate in water to produce hydroxide ions.

words.ex: The car won't start because the ignition is broken.
words.ex_cn: 汽车无法启动，因为点火器坏了。
words.en: The process of starting the combustion of fuel in an engine.

words.ex: The ball keeps moving because of inertia.
words.ex_cn: 球因为惯性继续移动。
words.en: Inertia is the tendency of a physical object to continue moving in a straight line at a constant speed, or to stay at rest, unless it is acted upon by a force.

words.tr: adj. 不精确的；不准确的
words.ex: The answer is inexact because we used rough measurements.
words.ex_cn: 答案不精确，因为我们使用了粗略的测量。
words.en: If something is inexact, it is not precise or accurate.

words.ex: The company values innovation in its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司重视产品的创新。
words.en: Innovation is the introduction of new ideas, methods, or things.

words.ex: The house has good insulation to keep warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有良好的绝缘层以在冬天保暖。
words.en: Insulation is a material or substance that is used to stop heat, electricity, or sound from going from one place to another.

words.ex: The doctor gave him iodide to help his thyroid.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他碘化物来帮助他的甲状腺。
words.en: A compound of iodine with another element or group, especially a salt of the anion I⁻.

words.ex: He took iodine to help his thyroid.
words.ex_cn: 他服用碘来帮助他的甲状腺。
words.en: A chemical element of the halogen group, essential for the production of thyroid hormones.

words.ex: This isotope is used in medical tests.
words.ex_cn: 这种同位素用于医学检查。
words.en: An isotope is one of two or more forms of the same chemical element. Different isotopes of an element have the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons in their nuclei.

words.tr: n. 操纵杆；（游戏机的）游戏棒
words.ex: The boy moves the character with a joystick.
words.ex_cn: 男孩用操纵杆控制角色移动。
words.en: A joystick is an input device consisting of a stick that pivots on a base and reports its angle or direction to the device it is controlling.

words.ex: The doctor used a laser to fix her eye.
words.ex_cn: 医生用激光修复了她的眼睛。
words.en: A laser is a device that emits light through a process of optical amplification based on the stimulated emission of electromagnetic radiation.

words.tr:
n. 杠杆；杠杆作用；影响力
v. 举债经营；充分利用
words.ex: The mechanic used a lever to lift the car.
words.ex_cn: 机械师用杠杆来抬起汽车。
words.en: Leverage refers to the use of a lever or the mechanical advantage gained by using a lever. In finance, it refers to the use of borrowed capital to increase the potential return of an investment.

words.ex: The magnet picks up the iron nail.
words.ex_cn: 磁铁吸起了铁钉。
words.en: A magnet is a piece of iron or other material which attracts iron or steel towards it.

words.ex: The magnet has a magnetic force.
words.ex_cn: 这块磁铁有磁性。
words.en: If you describe something as magnetic, you mean that it is very attractive to people because it has unusual, powerful, and exciting qualities.

words.ex: The mainspring powers the old clock.
words.ex_cn: 主发条为这座老钟提供动力。
words.en: The mainspring of something is the most important reason or motive for it.

words.ex: The cell has a thin membrane.
words.ex_cn: 细胞有一层薄薄的膜。
words.en: A membrane is a thin layer of tissue or material that covers or lines a part of the body, or separates one area from another.

words.ex: Methane is a gas that comes from cows and landfills.
words.ex_cn: 甲烷是一种来自牛和垃圾填埋场的气体。
words.en: A colorless, odorless flammable gas which is the main constituent of natural gas. It is the simplest member of the alkane series of hydrocarbons.

words.ex: The phone has a small microchip inside.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机里面有一个小芯片。
words.en: A microchip is a very small piece of silicon inside a computer. It has electronic circuits on it and can hold large amounts of information or perform mathematical and logical operations.

words.ex: He ate millet for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了小米。
words.en: Millet is a type of small-seeded grass widely grown around the world as cereal crops or grains for fodder and human food.

words.ex: The pill contains 5 milligrams of medicine.
words.ex_cn: 这颗药丸含有5毫克药物。
words.en: A milligram is a unit of mass equal to one thousandth of a gram.

words.tr: v. 错误地计算或估计；失算；对…判断错误
words.ex: He miscalculate the cost of the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他算错了旅行的费用。
words.en: If you miscalculate, you make a mistake in judging a situation or in making a calculation.

words.ex: The software has five different modules.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件有五个不同的模块。
words.en: A module is one of the separate parts of a course of study, especially at a college or university.

words.ex: The scientist studied a mutant frog with three legs.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究了一只有三条腿的突变青蛙。
words.en: A mutant is an organism or a new genetic character arising or resulting from an instance of mutation.

words.ex: The farmer uses nitrate to help plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用硝酸盐来帮助植物生长。
words.en: A nitrate is a chemical compound that includes the nitrate ion (NO₃⁻), often used in fertilizers and explosives.

words.ex: The nucleus of the team is the captain.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队的核心是队长。
words.en: The central and most important part of an object, movement, or group, forming the basis for its activity and growth.

words.tr:
n. 数字
adj. 数的；表示数的
words.ex: He wrote the numeral five on the board.
words.ex_cn: 他在黑板上写了数字五。
words.en: A numeral is a symbol or group of symbols that represents a number.

words.ex: The test has only numerical answers.
words.ex_cn: 这个测试只有数字答案。
words.en: Numerical means relating to numbers or consisting of numbers.

words.ex: Scientists work at the observatory to study stars.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在天文台工作以研究恒星。
words.en: A building or place equipped for observation of natural phenomena (as in astronomy); also : an institution whose primary purpose is making such observations.

words.ex: He uses optical lenses to see small objects.
words.ex_cn: 他使用光学镜片来看小物体。
words.en: Relating to sight, especially in relation to the physical action of light.

words.ex: The satellite moves in an orbital path around Earth.
words.ex_cn: 卫星在围绕地球的轨道上运行。
words.en: Relating to an orbit or orbits.

words.ex: He used paraffin to light the lamp.
words.ex_cn: 他用煤油点亮了灯。
words.en: A white or colorless, tasteless, odorless, waxy solid derived from petroleum, coal, or shale oil, used in candles, wax paper, polishes, and sealing materials.

words.ex: Dust particles float in the air.
words.ex_cn: 灰尘微粒漂浮在空气中。
words.en: A particle is a very small piece or amount of something.

words.ex: Phosphorus is in some fertilizers.
words.ex_cn: 磷存在于一些肥料中。
words.en: Phosphorus is a chemical element with the symbol P and atomic number 15. It is a nonmetal that is essential for life, found in DNA, RNA, ATP, and the phospholipids that form all cell membranes.

words.ex: The planetary motion follows simple rules.
words.ex_cn: 行星的运动遵循简单的规律。
words.en: Relating to or belonging to a planet or planets.

words.tr:
n. 塑料；
adj. 塑料的；
words.ex: The bottle is made of plastic.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子是塑料做的。
words.en: A plastic is a material which is produced from oil by a chemical process and which is used to make many objects. It is light in weight and does not break easily.

words.tr: n. 钚（放射性化学元素）
words.ex: Plutonium is used in nuclear weapons.
words.ex_cn: 钚用于核武器。
words.en: A radioactive metallic element used especially as a fuel in nuclear reactors and as an explosive in nuclear weapons.

words.ex: The shirt is made of polyester.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫是聚酯做的。
words.en: Polyester is a synthetic material used especially to make cloth.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.ex: The study uses quantitative data to measure results.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究使用定量数据来测量结果。
words.en: Relating to, measuring, or measured by the quantity of something rather than its quality.

words.ex: He is learning quantum physics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习量子物理。
words.en: In physics, a quantum is the minimum amount of any physical entity involved in an interaction.

words.ex: The clock has a quartz crystal inside.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟里面有一个石英晶体。
words.en: Quartz is a hard, crystalline mineral composed of silicon and oxygen atoms. It is one of the most common minerals in the Earth's continental crust.

words.ex: The radioactive material glows in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 这种放射性物质在黑暗中发光。
words.en: Something that is radioactive contains a substance that produces energy in the form of powerful and harmful rays.

words.ex: The ram broke down the wooden door.
words.ex_cn: 撞击装置撞碎了木门。
words.en: A ram is an adult male sheep. As a verb, it means to force something into a place or to hit something with great force.

words.tr: n. 基本原理；基础理论；
words.ex: The rationale for the new rule is to save time.
words.ex_cn: 这个新规则的基本原理是节省时间。
words.en: The fundamental reasons or logical basis for a course of action or belief.

words.tr: n. 反射动作；本能反应；反射作用；
words.ex: The knee jerk is a simple reflex.
words.ex_cn: 膝跳是一种简单的反射动作。
words.en: An automatic and often inborn response to a stimulus that typically involves a nerve impulse passing inward from a receptor to the spinal cord and then outward to an effector (as a muscle or gland) without reaching the level of consciousness.

words.ex: Einstein developed the theory of relativity.
words.ex_cn: 爱因斯坦提出了相对论。
words.en: The theory of relativity, developed by Albert Einstein, fundamentally altered our understanding of space, time, and gravity.

words.tr: adj. 可恢复的；可挽回的；可弥补的
words.ex: The data is retrievable from the backup file.
words.ex_cn: 数据可以从备份文件中恢复。
words.en: Capable of being retrieved or recovered.

words.ex: The retrieval of lost files took a long time.
words.ex_cn: 找回丢失文件花费了很长时间。
words.en: The act of getting something back from somewhere.

words.ex: The wheel rotates slowly.
words.ex_cn: 轮子缓慢地转动。
words.en: To rotate means to turn or cause to turn around an axis or center.

words.ex: He went diving with scuba gear.
words.ex_cn: 他带着水肺去潜水。
words.en: Scuba is an apparatus containing compressed air and used for breathing underwater, typically consisting of a mouthpiece, a demand valve, and one or more tanks of compressed air.

words.ex: Selenium is often used in solar cells.
words.ex_cn: 硒常用于太阳能电池中。
words.en: Selenium is a nonmetal with properties that are intermediate between those of its periodic table column-adjacent chalcogen elements sulfur and tellurium.

words.tr: n. 敏感性；感受力；善感；感情
words.ex: She has great sensibility for music.
words.ex_cn: 她对音乐有很强的感悟力。
words.en: The ability to appreciate and respond to complex emotional or aesthetic influences; sensitivity.

words.ex: His sensitivity to loud noises makes him wear earplugs.
words.ex_cn: 他对噪音的敏感性让他戴耳塞。
words.en: Sensitivity is the quality or condition of being sensitive—the capacity to respond to slight changes, signals, or influences.

words.ex: The robot uses a sensor to detect walls.
words.ex_cn: 机器人使用传感器来检测墙壁。
words.en: A sensor is a device which reacts to certain physical conditions or impressions such as heat or light, and which is used to provide information.

words.tr:
n. 信号；
v. 用信号通知；
words.ex: The traffic light is a signal to stop.
words.ex_cn: 交通灯是一个停止的信号。
words.en: A signal is a gesture, sound, or action which is intended to give a particular message to the person who sees or hears it.

words.ex: The sand contains a lot of silica.
words.ex_cn: 这种沙子含有大量的二氧化硅。
words.en: A hard, unreactive, colorless compound that occurs as the mineral quartz and as a principal constituent of sandstone and other rocks.

words.tr: n. 筒仓；发射井；（危险物品的）地下贮藏库
words.ex: The farm has one silo for storing corn.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场有一个用于储存玉米的筒仓。
words.en: A silo is a tall, round tower used for storing grain, or a similar structure used for storing missiles.

words.ex: The sun softened the ice on the road.
words.ex_cn: 太阳使路上的冰变软了。
words.en: To make or become soft or softer.

words.ex: The submarine uses sonar to find objects underwater.
words.ex_cn: 潜艇使用声呐来发现水下的物体。
words.en: Sonar is a system for detecting objects under water by emitting sound pulses and detecting or measuring their return after being reflected.

words.ex: The colors in the rainbow cover a wide spectrum.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹中的颜色覆盖了广泛的范围。
words.en: A spectrum is a range of a particular type of thing, often a range of colors, ideas, or opinions.

words.tr: v. 使合乎标准；使合规格
words.ex: The school will standardize the test scores next month.
words.ex_cn: 学校下个月将统一评分标准。
words.en: To standardize something means to make it conform to a standard or norm, especially in order to ensure consistency and uniformity.

words.ex: The car remained static at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯前静止不动。
words.en: Something that is static does not move or change.

words.tr:
n. 立体声；立体声音响
adj. 立体声的
words.ex: He plays music on the stereo.
words.ex_cn: 他通过立体声收音机播放音乐。
words.en: A stereo is a sound system that uses two or more separate microphones to record sound and two or more loudspeakers to play it back, so that you hear different parts of the sound coming from different directions.

words.ex: Strontium is a chemical element with the symbol Sr and atomic number 38.
words.ex_cn: 锶是一种化学元素，符号为Sr，原子序数为38。
words.en: A soft silver-white or yellowish metallic element of the alkali metal group, occurring naturally in celestite and strontianite. It is used in fireworks, flares, and in the production of glass for color television tubes.

words.ex: The jet flies at supersonic speed.
words.ex_cn: 这架喷气式飞机以超音速飞行。
words.en: relating to speeds that are faster than the speed of sound

words.ex: The thermocouple measures the temperature of the oven.
words.ex_cn: 热电偶测量烤箱的温度。
words.en: A thermocouple is a device for measuring temperature, consisting of a pair of wires of different metals connected at two points, a voltage being developed between the two junctions in proportion to the temperature difference.

words.ex: The sun produces energy through thermonuclear reactions.
words.ex_cn: 太阳通过热核反应产生能量。
words.en: Thermonuclear refers to the process or phenomena that involve the fusion of atomic nuclei at very high temperatures, as in the sun or in a hydrogen bomb.

words.ex: The doctor examined the tissue under a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 医生在显微镜下检查了组织。
words.en: Tissue is a group of cells that have a similar structure and that work together to perform a specific function.

words.tr: n. 晶体管；晶体管收音机
words.ex: The radio uses a small transistor.
words.ex_cn: 这个收音机使用了一个小晶体管。
words.en: A transistor is a semiconductor device used to amplify or switch electronic signals and electrical power.

words.ex: The signal transmission is clear and strong.
words.ex_cn: 信号传输清晰而强劲。
words.en: The act or process of sending or passing something from one place, person, or thing to another.

words.ex: The magic spell caused the transmutation of the frog into a prince.
words.ex_cn: 魔法咒语让青蛙变成了王子。
words.en: The act or process of changing something completely, especially into something different and better.

words.ex: The government increased transparency about its decisions.
words.ex_cn: 政府提高了决策的透明度。
words.en: The condition of being transparent, especially in a way that allows easy understanding or recognition of something.

words.ex: The doctor used ultrasonic waves to check the baby.
words.ex_cn: 医生使用超声波来检查婴儿。
words.en: Ultrasonic refers to sound waves with frequencies higher than the upper limit of human hearing.

words.ex: The doctor used ultrasound to check the baby.
words.ex_cn: 医生用超声波检查了婴儿。
words.en: Ultrasound is sound which is very high and cannot be heard by humans, used in medical examinations to produce images of the inside of the body.

words.tr: n. 紫外线辐射；紫外光；
words.ex: The ultraviolet from the sun can hurt your skin.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的紫外线会伤害你的皮肤。
words.en: Ultraviolet light or radiation has a wavelength shorter than that of visible light but longer than X-rays.

words.tr:
n. 更新；
v. 更新；升级；
words.ex: The app sent me a new update.
words.ex_cn: 应用程序给我发送了一个新更新。
words.en: To make something more modern or up to date, especially by adding new information or changing its design or style.

words.ex: He found uranium in the old rock sample.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧岩石样本中发现了铀。
words.en: A heavy, silvery-white metallic element, radioactive and toxic, used as a fuel in nuclear reactors and in the manufacture of nuclear weapons.

words.ex: This apple is a variant of the red delicious.
words.ex_cn: 这种苹果是红富士的一个变体。
words.en: A variant is something that is slightly different from other similar things.

words.ex: The car's velocity increased on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在高速公路上的速度增加了。
words.en: Velocity is the speed at which something moves in a particular direction.

chapters.name: 社会万象 体育竞技 重点词

words.ex: The advent of smartphones changed how we communicate.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机的到来改变了我们的交流方式。
words.en: The arrival of a notable person, thing, or event.

words.tr:
n. 弹跳；跳动；
v. 弹跳；反弹；
words.ex: The ball had a high bounce on the concrete.
words.ex_cn: 球在混凝土上弹跳得很高。
words.en: If something bounces or if you bounce it, it moves away from a surface after hitting it.

words.tr: adj. 一定会；密切相关的；有义务的； v. “bind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is bound to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他一定会赢得比赛。
words.en: If one person, thing, or situation is bound to another, they are closely connected with each other, and it is difficult for them to be separated or to escape from each other. If you say that something is bound to happen, you mean that you are sure it will happen, because it is a natural consequence of something that is already known or exists.

words.tr: n. 一回；一次；发作；拳击比赛
words.ex: He had a bout of coughing last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚咳了一阵子。
words.en: A bout of something is a short period of time during which it occurs a lot or is especially severe.

words.tr: n. 冲击；主力；首当其冲
words.ex: The farmers bore the brunt of the drought.
words.ex_cn: 农民们承受了干旱的主要打击。
words.en: The main force or impact of something, especially something unpleasant.

words.tr:
n. 挑战；
v. 提出挑战；
words.ex: Climbing that mountain is a big challenge.
words.ex_cn: 爬那座山是一个巨大的挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.ex: He became the champion of the tennis tournament.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了网球锦标赛的冠军。
words.en: A champion is someone who has won first prize in a competition, contest, or fight.

words.tr:
v. 钉牢；用臂互抱；达成（协议等）；最终解决
n. 钉牢；扭抱
words.ex: He clinched the board to the wall with nails.
words.ex_cn: 他用钉子把木板钉在墙上。
words.en: To settle something conclusively; to secure or fasten something by flattening the ends of nails, screws, etc.

words.ex: Two companies compete for the same customers.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司为争夺相同的客户而竞争。
words.en: If you compete with someone for something, you try to get it for yourself and stop the other person getting it. You can also say that two people compete for something that they both want.

words.tr: adj. 有竞争力的；竞争的；
words.ex: She is a competitive runner who wins many races.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有竞争力的跑步者，赢得了许多比赛。
words.en: Competitive is used to describe situations or activities in which people or firms compete with each other.

words.ex: He contends that education is the key to success.
words.ex_cn: 他主张教育是成功的关键。
words.en: If you contend with someone or contend with something, you have to deal with a difficult situation or problem. If you contend that something is true, you state or argue that it is true.

words.ex: He won the spelling contest.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了拼写比赛。
words.en: A contest is a competition or a struggle for victory between individuals or groups.

words.tr:
n. 折痕；皱痕
v. 起皱；弄皱
words.ex: The paper has a deep crease from folding.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸因为折叠而有一道深深的折痕。
words.en: A crease is a line or mark made on cloth or paper when it is folded or crushed.

words.tr:
n. 跨栏；障碍；难关
v. 越过障碍；克服
words.ex: He jumped over the hurdle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速跳过了跨栏。
words.en: A hurdle is a problem or difficulty that you must deal with before you can achieve something.

words.ex: He will tackle the problem tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会处理这个问题。
words.en: If you tackle a problem or task, you deal with it in a determined way. In sports such as football and rugby, a tackle is an act of trying to take the ball from a player on the other team.

words.ex: The umpire blew the whistle when the player broke the rule.
words.ex_cn: 当球员犯规时，裁判吹响了哨子。
words.en: An umpire is a person whose job is to make sure that a game is played fairly and that the rules are not broken.

chapters.name: 社会万象 体育竞技 认知词

words.tr: n. 特技飞行；特技飞行表演
words.ex: The pilot performs aerobatics in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员在空中表演特技飞行。
words.en: Aerobatics is the practice of performing maneuvers in an aircraft that are not used in normal flight, often for entertainment or competition.

words.ex: She does aerobics every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上做有氧运动来保持健康。
words.en: Aerobics is a form of physical exercise that combines rhythmic aerobic exercise with stretching and strength training routines with the goal of improving all elements of fitness (flexibility, muscular strength, and cardio-vascular fitness).

words.tr: adj. 运动的；身强力壮的；
words.ex: He is an athletic boy who loves running.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱跑步的运动型男孩。
